model.cr_project.bridge_actuals_tracker.name: bridge_actuals_tracker
model.cr_project.bridge_actuals_tracker.description:
**Source:** Manual Files

    This model extracts the snapshotted actuals tracker data and creates a valid_to and valid_from model, to allow a PIT filter
model.cr_project.bridge_actuals_tracker.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

SELECT
    date,
    date_iso,
    revenue_type,
    dbt_updated_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY date ASC, dbt_valid_from ASC) AS row_num,
    IFF(row_num = 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('{{var("low_date")}}'),  dbt_valid_from) AS dbt_valid_from,
    IFNULL(dbt_valid_to, TO_TIMESTAMP('{{var("high_date")}}')) AS dbt_valid_to
FROM
    {{ ref('snapshot_actuals_tracker') }}
ORDER BY date, dbt_valid_from

FROM
    snapshots.snapshot_actuals_tracker
ORDER BY date, dbt_valid_from

model.cr_project.bridge_exchange_rates.name: bridge_exchange_rates
model.cr_project.bridge_exchange_rates.description:
**Source:** Workday

    This model takes exchange rate data with an 'effect_from' and 'effective_to', applied it to a calendar and maps the rate's region
model.cr_project.bridge_exchange_rates.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}


WITH 
dates as (
    select 
        *
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_date')}}
),
exchange_rates as (
    SELECT 
        to_date(DATE_TRUNC('day', EFFECTIVE_FROM)) AS EFFECTIVE_FROM_NEW, 
        to_date(DATE_TRUNC('day', EFFECTIVE_TO)) AS EFFECTIVE_TO_NEW,
        CURRENCY_RATE,
        'REG_SINGAPORE' REGION_BK
    FROM {{ ref('bc_exchange_rates') }}
    WHERE  
        -- Currently in our CR report we only have conversion for Singapore
        SOURCE_CURRENCY ='SGD'        
        AND TARGET_CURRENCY = 'AUD'
        AND CURRENCY_RATE_TYPE  = 'Current'
),
final as (
    SELECT 
            dates.DIM_DATE_SID,
            dim_region.DIM_REGION_SID,
            exchange_rates.effective_from_new AS effective_from, 
            exchange_rates.effective_to_new as effective_to,
            exchange_rates.currency_rate        
    FROM exchange_rates 
    LEFT JOIN dates
        ON dates.date_bk BETWEEN exchange_rates.EFFECTIVE_FROM_NEW AND exchange_rates.EFFECTIVE_TO_NEW
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('dim_region') }}
        ON exchange_rates.REGION_BK = dim_region.REGION_BK
)
select
    *
from final

model.cr_project.bridge_employee_work_da.name: bridge_employee_work_dates
model.cr_project.bridge_employee_work_da.description:
**Source:** Workday

    This model takes the employee and cross-applies the working (weekday) dates in the calendar.
model.cr_project.bridge_employee_work_da.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with 
	employee as (
	    select
	        employee_bk,
            working_hours,
            fte
	    from
             {{ ref( 'bc_employee_current' ) }}
    ), 
    dates as (
        select
            date_bk
        from
            {{ref('ref_calendar_dates')}}
        where
            is_weekday and date_bk >= '2022-07-01'
    ),   
	final as (
	    select
            employee.employee_bk|| '/' || dates.date_bk     as employee_work_date_bk,
            employee.employee_bk,
            dates.date_bk,
            employee.working_hours,
            employee.fte,
            'bridge_employee_work_dates'    as record_source,    
            current_timestamp               as load_date            
	    from
	        employee
        cross join
            dates
	)
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_bridge_opportunity_.name: int_bridge_opportunity_project
model.cr_project.int_bridge_opportunity_.description: This model takes the links from dvbridge_opportunity_project and enriches it from the Project and Opportunity datavault Business Concepts
model.cr_project.int_bridge_opportunity_.raw_code:
SELECT
    hub_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid as DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID,
    hub_opportunity.OPPORTUNITY_BK,
    dvbridge_opportunity_project.h_project_sid as DIM_PROJECT_SID,
    dvbridge_opportunity_project.PROJECT_BK,
    sat_opportunity.stage_bk,
    sat_opportunity.sow_value,
    sat_project_workday_deal_value.deal_value,
    -- If stage of CLOSED_WON, and we have a Workday project, use the Deal value
    -- Not all Opportunities (Ping Stax) have projects therefore h_project_sid will be null, so allow for this
    CASE
        WHEN sat_opportunity.stage_bk = 'CLOSED_WON' AND pit_project_current.h_project_sid IS NOT NULL 
            THEN sat_project_workday_deal_value.deal_value
        ELSE
            sat_opportunity.sow_value
    END AS opportunity_project_value
FROM
    -- int_dim_opportunity to be the base table as the opportunity can exist before the project
    -- NOTE: This currently works, however this may cause an issue with an multiple opportunities mapping to a single project
    --   If this is the case, this may need to be refactored into some CTEs that get all Projects/Opps from lnk_opportunity_project that are in Workday
    --   and then get all Ops not in workday and assure they aren't duplicated via the project_bk
    {{ ref('hub_opportunity') }}    
        left join {{ ref('pit_opportunity_current') }}
            on hub_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid = pit_opportunity_current.h_opportunity_sid
        left join {{ ref('sat_opportunity') }}
            on  pit_opportunity_current.h_opportunity_sid = sat_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid
            and pit_opportunity_current.sat_opportunity_ldts = sat_opportunity.load_date_time

        LEFT JOIN {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project') }}
            ON pit_opportunity_current.h_opportunity_sid = dvbridge_opportunity_project.H_OPPORTUNITY_SID
            left join {{ ref('pit_project_current') }}
                on dvbridge_opportunity_project.h_project_sid = pit_project_current.h_project_sid
                left join {{ ref('sat_project_workday_deal_value') }}
                    on  pit_project_current.h_project_sid = sat_project_workday_deal_value.h_project_sid
                    and pit_project_current.sat_project_workday_deal_value_ldts = sat_project_workday_deal_value.load_date_time

**Source:** Salesforce

# Model: dim_client

## Business Purpose
Contains information about Clients. Serves as the primary location for all client-related information.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Incremental model: if a Client is removed from the source system, it remains within this Dimension.
- Point in Time (PIT) is the time of the dbt job run, using the most recent information.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Source system for Clients
- Used by downstream reporting and fact models

## Key Fields
- Client ID
- Client Name
- Timestamps (for PIT)

## Update Frequency
- Updated with each dbt job run or as new Clients are added/modified.

## Additional Notes
- Ensures historical Clients are retained for reporting and analysis. Client dimension semantic model.

model.cr_project.dim_date.description:
**Source:** Other (Calendar)
    **dim_date** contains information about dates that can be used for the processing and mapping of data.

    This dimension the primary location for all information regarding a Dates that can be pre-calculated.
    The precalculations map concepts such as Year Number, Quarter, Financial Year, etc so that these measures only need to be calculated once
    
    This model is incremental, meaning that if the Client gets removed from the source system, it remainins within this Dimension. Semantic model for Date dimension.
model.cr_project.dim_date.raw_code:
{{config(
    materialized = 'incremental',
    unique_key = 'DIM_DATE_SID'
)}}

WITH 
dates_spine AS (
    select 
      *
    FROM
      {{ ref('int_date')}}
),
final as (
  SELECT
        dates_spine.dim_date_sid
      , dates_spine.DATE_DAY                                            AS DATE
      , dates_spine.DATE_DAY                                            AS DATE_DAY
      , CAST(TO_CHAR(dates_spine.DATE_DAY,'DD/MM/YYYY') as varchar(50)) AS DATE_DAY_AUS
      , CAST(TO_CHAR(dates_spine.DATE_DAY,'MM/DD/YYYY') as varchar(50)) AS DATE_DAY_US
      , dates_spine.PRIOR_DATE_DAY
      , dates_spine.NEXT_DATE_DAY
      , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_DATE_DAY
      , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_OVER_YEAR_DATE_DAY
      , dates_spine.DAY_OF_WEEK
      , dates_spine.DAY_OF_WEEK_ISO
      , CAST(dates_spine.DAY_OF_WEEK_NAME as varchar(50))               AS DAY_OF_WEEK_NAME
      , dates_spine.DAY_OF_WEEK_NAME_SHORT, 
      IS_WEEKDAY
      , IFF(IS_WEEKDAY, 'Y', 'N')                                       AS IS_WEEKDAY_STRING
      , dates_spine.DAY_OF_MONTH
      , dates_spine.DAY_OF_YEAR
      -- Week
        , dates_spine.WEEK_START_DATE
        , dates_spine.WEEK_END_DATE
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_WEEK_START_DATE
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_WEEK_END_DATE
        , dates_spine.WEEK_OF_YEAR
        , dates_spine.ISO_WEEK_START_DATE
        , dates_spine.ISO_WEEK_END_DATE
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_ISO_WEEK_START_DATE
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_ISO_WEEK_END_DATE
        , dates_spine.ISO_WEEK_OF_YEAR
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_WEEK_OF_YEAR
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_ISO_WEEK_OF_YEAR
      -- Month
        , dates_spine.MONTH_OF_YEAR
        , CAST(dates_spine.MONTH_NAME as varchar(50))                                   AS MONTH_NAME
        , CAST(dates_spine.MONTH_NAME_SHORT as varchar(50))                             AS MONTH_NAME_SHORT
        , CAST(TO_CHAR(dates_spine.DATE_DAY,'MON YYYY') as varchar(50))                 AS month_name_SHORT_YEAR
        , dates_spine.MONTH_START_DATE
        , dates_spine.MONTH_END_DATE
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_MONTH_START_DATE
        , dates_spine.PRIOR_YEAR_MONTH_END_DATE
      -- Quarter
        , dates_spine.QUARTER_OF_YEAR
        , dates_spine.QUARTER_START_DATE
        , dates_spine.QUARTER_END_DATE
      , dates_spine.YEAR_NUMBER
      , dates_spine.YEAR_START_DATE
      , dates_spine.YEAR_END_DATE
      -- Financial Year
        , CASE 
            WHEN dates_spine.MONTH_OF_YEAR BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN dates_spine.YEAR_NUMBER
            ELSE dates_spine.YEAR_NUMBER + 1
          END                                                                                       AS fy_number
        , CAST(CONCAT('FY', fy_number) as varchar(50))                                              AS fy_number_string
        , CAST(CONCAT(fy_number - 1, '-07-01')  as varchar(50))                                     AS fy_start_date
        , CAST(CONCAT(fy_number , '-06-30')  as varchar(50))                                        AS fy_end_date
        , DATEDIFF(day, fy_start_date, date) + 1                                                    AS fy_day_number
        , FLOOR((DATEDIFF(day, fy_start_date, dates_spine.DATE_DAY )/7)+1)                          AS fy_week_of_year


        , CASE
            WHEN dates_spine.MONTH_OF_YEAR BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '1'
            WHEN dates_spine.MONTH_OF_YEAR BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN '2'
            WHEN dates_spine.MONTH_OF_YEAR BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '3'
            ELSE '4'
          END                                                                                       AS FY_QUARTER_NUMBER
        , CONCAT('Q', FY_QUARTER_NUMBER)                                                            AS FY_QUARTER_NUMBER_STRING
  FROM 
    dates_spine
 )
select
  *
FROM
  final

with 
    source as (
        select
            employee_bk,
            -- payload
            FIRST_NAME, 
            LAST_NAME, 
            WORK_EMAIL, 
            WORKER_TYPE, 
            WORKER_SUBTYPE, 
            REGION_ID, 
            HIRE_DATE, 
            MANAGER, 
            COST_CENTER_ID, 
            PRIOR_COST_CENTRE, 
            PRIOR_COST_CENTRE_ID, 
            NEW_COST_CENTRE, 
            COST_CENTRE_CHANGE_DATE, 
            FUNCTION, 
            PRACTICE, 
            WORKING_HOURS, 
            LOCATION, 
            TERMINATION_DATE, 
            FTE, 
            SCHEDULED_WEEKLY_HOURS, 
            DEFAULT_WEEKLY_HOURS, 
            BUSINESS_TITLE, 
            JOB_PROFILE, 
            GENERIC_BUSINESS_TITLE, 
            GENERIC_JOB_PROFILE, 
            RECENT_TERMINATION_DATE, 
            HAS_FUTURE_TERMINATION_EVENT,
            -- hashdiff
                CAST(UPPER(md5(CONCAT(
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(FIRST_NAME AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(LAST_NAME AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(WORK_EMAIL AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(WORKER_TYPE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(WORKER_SUBTYPE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(REGION_ID AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(HIRE_DATE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(MANAGER AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(COST_CENTER_ID AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(PRIOR_COST_CENTRE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(PRIOR_COST_CENTRE_ID AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(NEW_COST_CENTRE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(COST_CENTRE_CHANGE_DATE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(FUNCTION AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(PRACTICE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(WORKING_HOURS AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(LOCATION AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(TERMINATION_DATE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(FTE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(SCHEDULED_WEEKLY_HOURS AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(DEFAULT_WEEKLY_HOURS AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(BUSINESS_TITLE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(JOB_PROFILE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(GENERIC_BUSINESS_TITLE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(GENERIC_JOB_PROFILE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(RECENT_TERMINATION_DATE AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^'), '||',
                IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(HAS_FUTURE_TERMINATION_EVENT AS VARCHAR(16))), ''), '^^')
                            
                ))) AS binary) as hashdiff,
            
            
            -- audit_columns
            record_source,
            load_date_time
        from 
        data_mart_int.int_dim_employee
        where
          -- remove the ghost as_of_date from records other than the ghost
            (TO_DATE(as_of_date) = '1900-01-01' and employee_bk = '00000000000000000000000000000000') or
            TO_DATE(as_of_date) <> '1900-01-01'        
        
    ),

        select
            CAST(MD5_BINARY(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST(CONCAT(employee_bk) AS VARCHAR))), '')) AS BINARY(16)) AS dim_employee_sid,
            employee_bk,
            FIRST_NAME,

            FUNCTION,
            PRACTICE,
            WORKING_HOURS,
            LOCATION,
            TERMINATION_DATE,
            FTE,
            SCHEDULED_WEEKLY_HOURS,
            DEFAULT_WEEKLY_HOURS,
            BUSINESS_TITLE,
            JOB_PROFILE,
            GENERIC_BUSINESS_TITLE,
            GENERIC_JOB_PROFILE,
            RECENT_TERMINATION_DATE,
            HAS_FUTURE_TERMINATION_EVENT,-- audit columns
            -- audit_columns
            record_source,
            load_date_time
        from
            source
        where
            -- row_num = 1 and 
            1=1
    )
select 
    *
from final

model.cr_project.int_project_current.description:
# Model: int_project_current

## Business Purpose
Extracts data from Datavault Project Business Concept for Data Mart layer.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Uses most recent information at PIT of dbt run.
model.cr_project.int_project_current.raw_code:
with 
    hub as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('hub_project')}}
    ),
    pit as (
        select 
            * 
        from
            {{ ref('pit_project_current') }}
    ),
    sat_project_salesforce as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('sat_project_salesforce')}}
    ),
    sat_project_workday as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('sat_project_workday')}}
    ),
    sat_project_workday_deal_value as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('sat_project_workday_deal_value')}}
    ),
    final as (
        select
            hub.h_project_sid as dim_project_sid,
            hub.project_bk,
            coalesce(
                sat_project_salesforce.project_name,
                sat_project_workday.project_name,
                'ghost'
            )                                                       as project_name,
            coalesce(
                sat_project_salesforce.project_description,
                sat_project_workday.project_description,
                'ghost'
            )                                                       as project_description,
            sat_project_workday.project_owner                       as project_owner,
            sat_project_workday.project_state                       as project_state,
            sat_project_workday.primary_project_hierarchy           as primary_project_hierarchy,
            sat_project_workday.start_date                          as start_date,
            sat_project_workday.end_date                            as end_date,
            IFNULL(sat_project_workday_deal_value.deal_value, 0)    as deal_value,
            -- audit
            coalesce(
                sat_project_salesforce.record_source,
                sat_project_workday.record_source,
                sat_project_workday_deal_value.record_source,
                hub.record_source
            )                                                       as record_source,
            current_timestamp()                                     as load_date_time
        from
            hub
            join
                pit
                    on
                        hub.h_project_sid = pit.h_project_sid
                left join
                    sat_project_salesforce 
                        on 
                            pit.h_project_sid = sat_project_salesforce.h_project_sid and
                            pit.sat_project_salesforce_ldts = sat_project_salesforce.load_date_time
                left join
                    sat_project_workday 
                        on 
                            pit.h_project_sid = sat_project_workday.h_project_sid and
                            pit.sat_project_workday_ldts = sat_project_workday.load_date_time
                left join
                    sat_project_workday_deal_value 
                        on 
                            pit.h_project_sid = sat_project_workday_deal_value.h_project_sid and
                            pit.sat_project_workday_deal_value_ldts = sat_project_workday_deal_value.load_date_time
    )
select 
    * 
from 
    final

model.cr_project.fact_actual_revenue.description:
**Source:** Workday, Xero, Salesforce CSV Upload
**fact_actual_revenue** contains transactional data regarding all Actual Revenue recieved into Versent, and their corresponding dimensions.

This dimension the primary location for all information regarding a Actual Revenue that can be obtained.

The sources of this information change based on the date of the transtion.

Generally:
- Transaction Date <  2022-05-01 - Xero Revenue - Professional Services
- Transaction Date >= 2022-05-01 - Workday Revenue - Professional Services
- If in the other_regions_actuals csv upload via fact_other_region_actual_revenue - Non professional Services actuals

Exceptions:
- If in bundled.csv and Transaction Date <  2022-05-01, this overrides Xero via model int_fact_xero_revenue_exclude_bundled_projects

model.cr_project.int_bundled_projects_ma.description: This model enriches Bundled revenue, a pre workday revenue source, with Workday compatable fields
model.cr_project.int_bundled_projects_ma.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
WITH 
    stg_opportunity_salesforce AS (
        SELECT
            project_bk,
            opportunity_bk,
            client_account_director_bk,
            client_bk,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PROJECT_BK ORDER BY PROJECT_NAME) row_num
        FROM
            {{ ref('stg_salesforce__opportunity') }}
        QUALIFY row_num = 1
        ),
    other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings as (
        -- de-duplicate rows
        SELECT
            distinct
            region, 
            cost_center_bk
        FROM
            {{ref('other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings')}}
        where old_region = 'PROFESSIONALSERVICES'
    )
SELECT
    bundled_projects.*,
    COALESCE(
        bc_client_current.client_bk, 
        stg_opportunity_salesforce.client_bk,
        '{{var("ghost_record")}}')                                          AS client_bk,
    IFNULL(
        stg_opportunity_salesforce.opportunity_bk,                       
        '{{var("ghost_record")}}')                                          AS opportunity_bk,
    IFNULL(stg_opportunity_salesforce.client_account_director_bk,           '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS client_account_director_bk,
    IFNULL(other_region_workday_region_mappings.region_bk,                  '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS region_bk,
    IFNULL(other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings.cost_center_bk,        '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS cost_center_bk,
    IFNULL(xero_workday_practice_mappings.practice_bk,                      '{{var("ghost_record")}}') AS practice_bk,
    IFNULL(bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping.REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,   'RC_PS_TM') as REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,
    IFNULL(bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping.REVENUE_CATEGORY_NAME, 'Professional Services Revenue - Time & Materials') as REVENUE_CATEGORY_NAME
FROM
    {{ ref('stg_manual_bundled') }} as bundled_projects
    LEFT JOIN stg_opportunity_salesforce
        ON bundled_projects.project_bk = stg_opportunity_salesforce.PROJECT_BK
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('other_region_workday_region_mappings') }}
        on upper(bundled_projects.region) = upper(other_region_workday_region_mappings.region)
    LEFT JOIN other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings
        ON UPPER(bundled_projects.REGION) = UPPER(other_region_workday_cost_center_mappings.REGION)
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('xero_workday_practice_mappings') }}
        ON UPPER(bundled_projects.division) = UPPER(xero_workday_practice_mappings.division)
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping') }}
         ON bundled_projects.project_bk LIKE CONCAT('%', bundled_projects_revenue_category_mapping.HARVEST_CODE_SUFFIX)
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('bc_client_current') }}
        ON UPPER(bundled_projects.CLIENT) = UPPER(bc_client_current.CLIENT_NAME)

with
    bridge_contract_lines as (
        select
            customer_contract_line_bk,

            revenue_category_bk,

            project_bk,
            practice_bk,
            cost_center_bk,
            company_bk,

    bc_contract_lines as (
        select
            customer_contract_line_bk,
            date_bk,                 
            line_status,
            contract_line_type,

            amount,
            recognized_deferred_revenue,
            scheduled_deferred_revenue_to_recognize,
            adjustment_amount,
            billed_amount,
            revenue_override_amount,
            deferred_revenue_balance,
            record_source
        from 
            {{ref('bc_customer_contract_lines')}}
    ),
    final as (
        select
            --when
            bc_contract_lines.date_bk,
            --who
            bridge_contract_lines.cost_center_bk,
            bridge_contract_lines.practice_bk,
            bridge_contract_lines.company_bk,
            bridge_contract_lines.client_bk,
            --what
            bridge_contract_lines.customer_contract_bk,
            bridge_contract_lines.revenue_category_bk,
            bridge_contract_lines.project_bk,
            --where
            bridge_contract_lines.region_bk,
            --how much
            bc_contract_lines.amount,
            bc_contract_lines.recognized_deferred_revenue,
            bc_contract_lines.scheduled_deferred_revenue_to_recognize,
            bc_contract_lines.adjustment_amount,
            bc_contract_lines.billed_amount,
            bc_contract_lines.revenue_override_amount,
            bc_contract_lines.deferred_revenue_balance,  
            bc_contract_lines.currency,
            bc_contract_lines.contract_line_type,
            bc_contract_lines.line_status,        
            bc_contract_lines.record_source  
        from 
            bridge_contract_lines
            join
                bc_contract_lines
                    ON bridge_contract_lines.customer_contract_line_bk = bc_contract_lines.customer_contract_line_bk    
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_employee_absen.description: This model creates a layer to get the Business Keys required to link to other Dimensions.
model.cr_project.int_fact_employee_absen.raw_code:
with
    bridge_employee_absence as (
        select
            employee_absence_bk,
            employee_bk,
            absence_type_bk,start_date,
            end_date,
            unit_of_time,
            unit_quantity,
            status,                 
            record_source
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_employee_absence') }}
    ),

    bc_employee as (
        select
            employee_bk,
            working_hours
        from 
            {{ref('bc_employee_current')}}
    ),
    dates as (
        select
            date_bk
        from
            {{ref('ref_calendar_dates')}}
    ),    
    --create record for each day of the absence period
    employee_absence_date_cross_apply as (
        select
            dates.date_bk,
            bridge_employee_absence.employee_absence_bk,
            bridge_employee_absence.unit_of_time,
            bridge_employee_absence.unit_quantity,
            bridge_employee_absence.status,                 
            bridge_employee_absence.record_source
        from bridge_employee_absence
        join dates
            on dates.date_bk between
            bridge_employee_absence.start_date and
            bridge_employee_absence.end_date  
    ),
    final as (
        select
            --when
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.date_bk,
            --who
            bridge_employee_absence.employee_bk,
            --what
            bridge_employee_absence.employee_absence_bk,
            bridge_employee_absence.absence_type_bk,
            --how much
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_of_time,
            
            case 
                when employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_of_time = 'Days'             
                    then employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity / employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity
                else employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity
            end        as unit_quantity,
            
            case 
                when employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_of_time = 'Days' 
                    then bc_employee.working_hours
                else employee_absence_date_cross_apply.unit_quantity
            end         as working_hours,
            
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.status,
            employee_absence_date_cross_apply.record_source  
        from 
            bridge_employee_absence
            join
                employee_absence_date_cross_apply
                    ON bridge_employee_absence.employee_absence_bk = employee_absence_date_cross_apply.employee_absence_bk
            left join
                bc_employee
                    ON bridge_employee_absence.employee_bk = bc_employee.employee_bk     
    )
select
    *
from
    final

This model takes the Forecasted Hours from bridge__forecasted_hours and groups by:

To allow for forecasting models to know how many hours are assigned to each Project's month.
model.cr_project.agg_forecasted_hours__b.raw_code:
with
    forecasted_hours as (
        select
            project_bk,
            month_start_date,
            primary_project_hierarchy,
            deal_value,
            forecasted_hours
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_forecasted_hours_current') }}
    ),
    forecasted_hours_aggregation as (
        select
            project_bk,
            month_start_date,
            -- There are easily available from the bridge, and so are aggregated here

            max(primary_project_hierarchy)  as primary_project_hierarchy,
            max(deal_value)                 as deal_value,
            sum(forecasted_hours)           as forecasted_hours
        from
            forecasted_hours
        group by
            project_bk,
            month_start_date
    ),
    final as (
        select
            project_bk,
            month_start_date,
            primary_project_hierarchy,
            deal_value,
            forecasted_hours
        from
            forecasted_hours_aggregation
    )
select
    project_bk,
    month_start_date,
    primary_project_hierarchy,
    deal_value,
    forecasted_hours
from
    final

model.cr_project.int__fact_forecast_book.description: This model adds the forecasting hours FTE and also tries to get the FTE and forecasted hours from the WD resource plan in case it is 0 in the forecast.
model.cr_project.int__fact_forecast_book.raw_code:
{{config(
    materialized = 'view'
)}}

with
    employee_working_hours as (
        select
            median(working_hours)           as hours
        from
            {{ref('bc_employee_current')}}
    ), 
    resource_plan_fte as (
        select 
            dvbridge_resource_plan.project_bk,
            dvbridge_resource_plan.project_role_bk,
            dvbridge_resource_plan.employee_bk,
            MAX(bc_resource_plan.percent_allocation)          as fte        
        from  
            {{ref('dvbridge_resource_plan')}} dvbridge_resource_plan
        inner join 
            {{ref('bc_resource_plan')}} bc_resource_plan
            on bc_resource_plan.h_resource_plan_sid = dvbridge_resource_plan.h_resource_plan_sid
        group by 
            dvbridge_resource_plan.project_bk,
            dvbridge_resource_plan.project_role_bk,
            dvbridge_resource_plan.employee_bk
    ),
    stage_probability as (
        select
            stage_bk,
            probability
        from
            {{ref('bc_stage')}}     
    ),    
    forecast_booking as (
        select
            resource_forecast_bk,
            date_bk,
            region_bk,
            employee_bk,
            cost_center_bk,
            practice_bk,
            client_bk,
            client_account_director_bk,
            project_bk,
            project_role_bk,
            revenue_category_bk,
            sales_item_bk,
            opportunity_bk,
            stage_bk,
            ifnull(forecasted_hours,0)      as forecasted_hours,
            project_role_cost_rate,
            contract_billing_rate,
            amount,
            effective_from,
            effective_to,
            record_source
        from
            {{ref('int__fact_forecast_booking__union')}}
    ),    
    final as (
        select 
            forecast_booking.resource_forecast_bk,
            forecast_booking.date_bk,
            forecast_booking.region_bk,
            forecast_booking.employee_bk,
            forecast_booking.cost_center_bk,
            forecast_booking.practice_bk,
            forecast_booking.client_bk,
            forecast_booking.client_account_director_bk,
            forecast_booking.project_bk,
            forecast_booking.project_role_bk,
            forecast_booking.revenue_category_bk,
            forecast_booking.sales_item_bk,
            forecast_booking.opportunity_bk,
            ifnull(forecast_booking.stage_bk,'ghost')       as stage_bk,
            case 
                when forecast_booking.forecasted_hours = 0 then
                    employee_working_hours.hours * ifnull(resource_plan_fte.fte,0)
                else
                    forecast_booking.forecasted_hours
            end                                                     as forecasted_hours,            
            case 
                when forecast_booking.forecasted_hours = 0 then
                    ifnull(resource_plan_fte.fte,0)
                else
                    round((forecast_booking.forecasted_hours / employee_working_hours.hours),2)
            end                                                     as fte,
            case 
                when forecast_booking.forecasted_hours = 0 then
                    ifnull(resource_plan_fte.fte,0) * stage_probability.probability
                else
                    round((forecast_booking.forecasted_hours / employee_working_hours.hours),2) * stage_probability.probability
            end                                                     as weighted_fte,
            forecast_booking.project_role_cost_rate,
            forecast_booking.contract_billing_rate,
            forecast_booking.amount,
            forecast_booking.effective_from,
            forecast_booking.effective_to,
            forecast_booking.record_source             
        from
            forecast_booking
        left join
            employee_working_hours
        left join
            resource_plan_fte
                on forecast_booking.project_bk = resource_plan_fte.project_bk
                    and forecast_booking.project_role_bk = resource_plan_fte.project_role_bk
                    and forecast_booking.employee_bk = resource_plan_fte.employee_bk  
        left join   
                stage_probability
                    on forecast_booking.stage_bk = stage_probability.stage_bk    

    )
    
select 
    *
from 
    final

model.cr_project.int__forecast__project_.name: int__forecast__project__date_spine
model.cr_project.int__forecast__project_.description:
This model created a monthly spine of all months for a Project. Used primarily for int_booking_forecast_fixed_price. It takes:
  - The earliest date between the Project's Start Date, and the Earlist Actuals have been recieved
  - The latest date between the Project's End Date, and the Latest Actuals have been recieved
and then returns all months between the chosen dates This monthly spine then allows for a consolidated view on a Project/Month granularity of Actuals and Forecasted amounts
model.cr_project.int__forecast__project_.raw_code:
{{ 
    config(
        materialized='table', 
    )
}}

with
    project as (
        select
            dim_project_sid,
            project_bk,
            activity_start_month,
            activity_end_month
        from
            {{ ref('bc_project') }}
    ),
    -- To get whether a specific month is ACTUALS based, or FORECAST based
    actuals_tracker as (
        select
            date_bk,
            revenue_type
        from
            {{ ref('int_actuals_tracker_current') }}
    ),
    -- Only obtain first day of every month
    date_spine as (
        select
            month_start_date
        from
            {{ ref('ref_calendar_dates')}}
        where day_of_month = 1
    ),
    -- Cross join date_spine and the project's activity start and end to get get every month for a project
    project_date_spine AS (
        SELECT
            project.dim_project_sid,
            project.project_bk,
            date_spine.month_start_date,
            actuals_tracker.revenue_type
        FROM project
            inner join 
                date_spine
                    on date_spine.month_start_date
                        between project.activity_start_month and project.activity_end_month
                left join
                    actuals_tracker
                        on date_spine.month_start_date = actuals_tracker.date_bk
    ),
    finals as (
        select
            dim_project_sid,
            project_bk,
            month_start_date,
            revenue_type
        from
            project_date_spine
    )
SELECT
    *
FROM
    project_date_spine
ORDER BY project_bk, month_start_date

model.cr_project.int__project_revenue__c.name: int__project_revenue__calendar
model.cr_project.int__project_revenue__c.description: This model contains actuals information, attached to a date spine
model.cr_project.int__project_revenue__c.raw_code:
{% docs int__project_revenue__calendar %}

This table takes all actuals and forecast bookings for a project, and maps it to a consolidated monthly view.
This facilitates the calculating of actuals for a given month from inception, to then subtract this amount from the total SOW to get the amount remaining for the remaining lifetime of a project.
This 'remaining amount' can then be split among the remaining months for Fixed Price projects

Performed via a FROM and TO against DIM_DATE as there can be months between a first payment in actuals and the first forecasted month.

bridge_actuals_tracker is required to discern whether:
 - A given months actuals have been finalized
 - Whether a month can be considered a 'forecast' month, and so that its hours should be used in forecasting

{% enddocs %}
{{ 
    config(
        materialized='table',
    )
}}

WITH
    date_spine AS (
        select
            dim_project_sid,
            project_bk,
            revenue_type,
            month_start_date
        from
            {{ ref('int__forecast__project__date_spine') }}
    ),
    -- Get the a forecasted hours per month to align with date spine
    forecasted_hours_agg AS (
        select
            project_bk,
            month_start_date,
            primary_project_hierarchy,
            deal_value as opportunity_project_value,
            forecasted_hours
        from
            {{ ref('agg_forecasted_hours__by_project_month') }}
    ),
    project_actuals_agg as (
        select
            dim_project_sid,
            month_start_date,
            SUM(revenue_amount) as month_revenue_amount
        from 
            {{ ref('agg_actual_revenue__month_start_date') }}
        group by 
            dim_project_sid, 
            month_start_date

    ),
    -- combine into single view
    merged_forecast_actuals as (
        SELECT
            date_spine.dim_project_sid,
            date_spine.project_bk,

model.cr_project.int_opportunity_exposur.name: int_opportunity_exposure_forecast
model.cr_project.int_opportunity_exposur.description:
This model enriches the opportunity_exposure model with Forecasting information to allow the following forecasting methods to filter on projects
    as well as beginning to replace the mappings that are performed in the int__booking_forecast model
Using this method allows for a single mapping point for models that do and don't use EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_FORECAST
    as non EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_FORECAST models will also need the mapping done in int__booking_forecast

As per March 2026, The `bc_forecast_booking` reference is now filtered to only include the most current version of each forecast record (`current_timestamp() between effective_from and effective_to`), as historical cost rate tracking (SCD2 behaviour) is not required for utilisation or project profitability reporting and only focuses on current/future cost rates.
model.cr_project.int_opportunity_exposur.raw_code:
{{
	config(
    	materialized = 'table'
	) 
}}
WITH
    OPPORTUNITIES AS (
        SELECT
            *
        FROM
            {{ ref('exposure_opportunity') }}
    )
    , ACTUALS_TRACKER_CURRENT AS (
        SELECT
            FORECAST_START_DATE_BK
        FROM
            {{ ref('int_actuals_tracker_current_month') }}
    )
    , FORECAST_LINES AS (
        SELECT
            *,
            1 as force_github
        FROM
            {{ref('bc_forecast_booking')}}
    )
    , OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY AS (
        SELECT
            PROJECT_BK,
            LISTAGG(DISTINCT CONTRACT_BILLING_RATE, ',' ) as PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES
        FROM
            FORECAST_LINES
        WHERE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_FROM AND EFFECTIVE_TO
        GROUP BY PROJECT_BK
    )
    , FINAL AS (
        SELECT
            OPPORTUNITIES.*,
            OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY.PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES,
            (PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES = '0' OR PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES IS NULL) AS NO_PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES,
            (
                PRIMARY_PROJECT_HIERARCHY IN ('Prof Serve: TM')
                AND STAGE_BK = 'CLOSED_WON'
                and WORKDAY_PROJECT_STATE IN ('Active', 'Pending Close', 'Closed')
                AND START_DATE_WORKDAY >= CURRENT_DATE()
                AND (
                    NO_PROJECT_CONTRACT_BILLING_RATES
                    -- OR DEAL_VALUE = 0
                )
            ) AS IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES_BASE,
            COALESCE(IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES_BASE, false) as IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES,
            ACTUALS_TRACKER_CURRENT.FORECAST_START_DATE_BK
        FROM
            OPPORTUNITIES
            LEFT JOIN
                OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY
                    ON OPPORTUNITIES.PROJECT_BK = OPPORTUNITY_FORECAST_SUMMARY.PROJECT_BK
            LEFT JOIN
                ACTUALS_TRACKER_CURRENT
    )
SELECT
    *
FROM
    FINAL
-- WHERE IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES   
-- WHERE IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES IS NULL 
-- WHERE project_bk = 'DBS-035-CLD-TM'

model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast.name: int__booking_forecast
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast.description:
This model is the current mapping area for Project Forecasting that utilizes Workday Forecasted Hours via the Workday API EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_FORECAST
        The name of this model could be changed, as there are other non-forecast hour Forecast methods

        The main mapping that occurs is:
        - contract_rate_sheets via stg_workday__contract_rate_sheet, to see whether Project Rate is Daily or Weekly
        - contract_rate_sheets_override via stg_workday__contract_rate_sheet_override, to see whether a Workday/Project Contract Rate override exists
        - Mappings to other Business Concepts via the Project_BK
        - The Project's attributes (Especially the Deal/SOW) value
        - Various issue flags to see whether the project is in an invliad state
        - This logic could easily be migrated into the opportunity exposure mode
        
        As per February 2025, 
        the cost center in the forecast bookings refers to the cost centre in workday rather in salesforce

        As per March 2026,
        This model now filters `bc_forecast_booking` to only include the most current version of each forecast record
        (`current_timestamp() between effective_from and effective_to`), as historical cost rate tracking (SCD2 behaviour)
        is not required for utilisation or project profitability reporting.
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with 
    contract_rate_sheet_distinct_rows as (
        select
            distinct bcrs.project_billing_rate_sheet_id,
            bcrs.billable_project,
            dcrs.project_bk,
            bcrs.contract_rate_sheet,
            bcrs.effective_date,
            bcrs.project_billing_rate_sheet,
            bcrs.customer_contract_lines,
            bcrs.is_daily_rate
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_contract_rate_sheet') }} dcrs
        inner join
            {{ ref('bc_contract_rate_sheet') }} bcrs
            on dcrs.h_contract_rate_sheet_sid = bcrs.h_contract_rate_sheet_sid    
        where 
            bcrs.effective_date IS NOT NULL
        order by 
            bcrs.project_billing_rate_sheet_id, 
            bcrs.effective_date
        ),
    contract_rate_sheet as (
        select
            project_billing_rate_sheet_id,
            billable_project,
            project_bk,
            contract_rate_sheet,
            TO_TIMESTAMP(effective_date) as effective_from_date,
            dateadd(
                nanosecond, -1, 
                TO_TIMESTAMP(
                    IFNULL(
                        lead(effective_date) 
                            over (
                                partition by project_bk order by project_bk, effective_date
                                ), 
                        TO_DATE('{{var("high_date")}}'
                    )
                ))
            ) as effective_to_date,
            project_billing_rate_sheet,
            customer_contract_lines,
            is_daily_rate = 1 as is_daily_rate
        FROM
            contract_rate_sheet_distinct_rows
        ),
    contract_rate_sheet_rule_break_distinct_rows as (
        SELECT
            DISTINCT contract_rate_sheet,
            effective_date,
            Billable_Project,
            project_bk,
            billing_rate_rule,
            is_daily_rate,
            billing_rate_adjustment_type,
            rate_adjustment_percent,
            rate_adjustment_amount,
            worker_name,
            employee_bk
        FROM
            {{ ref('stg_workday__contract_rate_sheet_rule_break') }}
        WHERE effective_date IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY contract_rate_sheet, effective_date, billing_rate_rule
        ),
    contract_rate_sheet_rule_break as (
        SELECT
            project_bk,
            TO_TIMESTAMP(effective_date)    as effective_from_date,
            dateadd(
                nanosecond, 
                -1, 
                TO_TIMESTAMP(
                    IFNULL(
                        lead(effective_date) over (partition by project_bk, employee_bk order by effective_date), 
                        TO_DATE('{{var("high_date")}}')
                        )
                    )
                )                           as effective_to_date,
            employee_bk,
            worker_name,
            contract_rate_sheet,
            is_daily_rate = 1               as is_daily_rate,
            billing_rate_rule,
            billing_rate_adjustment_type,
            rate_adjustment_percent,
            rate_adjustment_amount
        FROM
            contract_rate_sheet_rule_break_distinct_rows
        ),
    forecast AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM 
            {{ref('bc_forecast_booking')}}
        WHERE 
            current_timestamp() between effective_from and effective_to
        ),
    PROJECT as (
        select * 
        FROM

            {{ref('int_opportunity_exposure_forecast')}}
        ),
    COST_CENTER as (
        select 
            project_bk,
            cost_center_bk
        FROM
            {{ref('bc_cost_center')}}
        join {{ref('bc_project')}} 
            on bc_cost_center.cost_center_name = bc_project.cost_center
        ),
    region as (
        select
            region_bk,
            working_hours
        from
            {{ ref('bc_region') }}
        )
select
    resource_forecast_bk,
    resource_forecast_sid,
    resource_forecast_line_id,
    date_bk,
    CONCAT(LEFT(date_bk, 7), '-01')         AS month_start_date,
    date_sid                                AS dim_date_sid,
    project.stage_bk     as stage_bk,
    project.workday_project_state,
    
    -- To allow reporting on whether the Workday Stage has been set to Active before the Salesforce integration has been set to CLOSED_WON
    --   Projects are only considered for Workday Forecasting ONLY when the Salesforce stage has reached CLOSED_WON. 
    -- Projects marked as 'Started At Risk/STARTED_AT_RISK__C' (Via the Boolean in vw_opportunity) are in COMMIT and 
    --      are integrate dinto workday, but do not meet criteria above, and are filtered.
    -- This test makes sure that after this point, Workday Stages are only in a Post-Closed Won Project State.
    PROJECT.WORKDAY_PROJECT_STATE IN (
        'Active', 'Closed', 'Pending Close'
        ) AND 
        PROJECT.STAGE_BK != 'CLOSED_WON' 
                                            as stage_mismatch,
    
    PROJECT.project_bk IS NULL              AS project_missing_from_workday,
    forecast.project_bk,
    forecast.project_role_bk,
    -- project_role_sid                        AS dim_project_role_sid,
    -- When
        -- Required for Fixed Price calculations
        project.start_date_workday          as start_date,
        project.end_date_workday            as end_date,
        start_date_salesforce,
        end_date_salesforce,
        date_bk between START_DATE_WORKDAY AND END_DATE_WORKDAY                                                     AS is_date_inside_project,
        MIN(forecast.date_bk) OVER (PARTITION BY forecast.project_bk ORDER BY forecast.project_bk)                  AS booking_date_first,
        MAX(forecast.date_bk) OVER (PARTITION BY forecast.project_bk ORDER BY forecast.project_bk)                  AS booking_date_last,    
        MIN(CONCAT(LEFT(date_bk, 7), '-01')) OVER (PARTITION BY forecast.project_bk ORDER BY forecast.project_bk)   AS booking_period_date_earliest,
        MAX(CONCAT(LEFT(date_bk, 7), '-01')) OVER (PARTITION BY forecast.project_bk ORDER BY forecast.project_bk)   AS booking_period_date_latest,
    -- Who
        forecast.employee_bk,
        ifnull(forecast.employee_bk, '{{var("ghost_record")}}')                 AS employee_bk_safe,
        {{ automate_dv.hash('EMPLOYEE_BK_SAFE', 'DIM_EMPLOYEE_SID')}},          
        COST_CENTER.COST_CENTER_BK,
        PROJECT.PRACTICE_BK,
        PROJECT.CLIENT_ACCOUNT_DIRECTOR_BK                   AS owner_id, -- check where this is used, if not delete this line
        IFNULL(PROJECT.CLIENT_ACCOUNT_DIRECTOR_BK, '{{var("ghost_record")}}')  AS CLIENT_ACCOUNT_DIRECTOR_BK,
        PROJECT.PROJECT_OWNER                                                   AS project_owner_workday,
        PROJECT.client_bk,
        project.opportunity_bk,
        forecast.primary_project_hierarchy,
        stg_manual_primary_project_hierarchy_revenue_category_mapping.revenue_category_bk,   
        stg_manual_primary_project_hierarchy_revenue_category_mapping.h_REVENUE_CATEGORY_SID as DIM_REVENUE_CATEGORY_SID,
    -- Where
        PROJECT.region_bk                                                       AS region_bk,
    -- How Much
        PROJECT.DEAL_VALUE                                       AS sow_amount,
        PROJECT.deal_value as opportunity_project_value,
        SUM(forecasted_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY PROJECT.project_bk ORDER BY PROJECT.project_bk)                                     AS total_project_forecasted_hours,
        sum(forecastED_HOURS) over (partition by forecast.PROJECT_BK,  LEFT(forecast.DATE_BK, 7) order by LEFT(forecast.DATE_BK, 7)) AS forecastED_HOURS_MONTH,
        forecast.forecasted_hours,
        IFNULL(forecast.project_role_cost_rate, 0) as project_role_cost_rate, -- IFNULL(0) added to pass test in fact_forecast_booking. Field will be null if not provided from API in vw_project_resource_forecast
        forecast.contract_billing_rate,
        region.working_hours,
        contract_rate_sheet.project_billing_rate_sheet_id,
        contract_rate_sheet.is_daily_rate as contract_is_rate_daily,
        PROJECT.IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES,

    -- Contract Rate Adjustments
        contract_rate_sheet_rule_break.contract_rate_sheet,
        contract_rate_sheet_rule_break.rate_adjustment_amount,
        contract_rate_sheet_rule_break.is_daily_rate as adjustment_is_daily_rate,
       -- Final amount calculation moved to int_booking_forecast_time_and_materials and int_booking_forecast_fixed_price
       
        bridge_actuals_tracker.revenue_type,
    
    -- audit
        forecast.record_source,
        forecast.EFFECTIVE_FROM,
        forecast.EFFECTIVE_TO
FROM forecast
    LEFT JOIN PROJECT
        ON forecast.PROJECT_bk = PROJECT.PROJECT_bk
    LEFT JOIN REGION
            ON project.region_bk = region.region_bk
    LEFT JOIN COST_CENTER
        ON cost_center.project_bk = forecast.project_bk
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_manual_primary_project_hierarchy_revenue_category_mapping') }}
        ON forecast.primary_project_hierarchy = stg_manual_primary_project_hierarchy_revenue_category_mapping.primary_project_hierarchy
    LEFT JOIN contract_rate_sheet
        ON  forecast.project_bk = contract_rate_sheet.project_bk
        AND forecast.date_bk >= contract_rate_sheet.effective_from_date
        AND forecast.date_bk <= contract_rate_sheet.effective_to_date
    LEFT JOIN contract_rate_sheet_rule_break
        ON forecast.project_bk = contract_rate_sheet_rule_break.project_bk
        AND forecast.employee_bk = contract_rate_sheet_rule_break.employee_bk
        AND forecast.date_bk >= contract_rate_sheet_rule_break.effective_from_date
        AND forecast.date_bk <= contract_rate_sheet_rule_break.effective_to_date
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('bridge_actuals_tracker') }}
        ON CONCAT(LEFT(date_bk, 7), '-01') = bridge_actuals_tracker.date
WHERE 
-- Filter out unnamed resources as this is curently what is expected of the business.
-- This can create issues if all resources are unnamed, as project forecast will be missing entirely
-- Decision/Code change to be performed for unnamed resources here https://versent.atlassian.net/browse/EAG-1872
    forecast.employee_bk IS NOT NULL and 
-- FORCE VIEW TO USE CURRENT SNAPSHOT FOR CURRENT JIRA CARD EAG-1748, AS TO LIMIT SCOPE
-- SNAPSHOTS TO BE TAKEN INTO ACCOUTN VIA EAG-1735
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() BETWEEN 
        bridge_actuals_tracker.DBT_VALID_FROM and 
        bridge_actuals_tracker.DBT_VALID_TO
        and
-- AND IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES
    1=1
ORDER BY PROJECT_BK, DATE_BK

model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.name: int__booking_forecast__fixed_price
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.description:
This view contains forecasting data for Professional Services/Tesltra Purple - Fixed Price - Closed Won Projects
      As a PS Fixed Price project has no 'Contract Rates', the 'Remaining Deal Value' of the project is split proportionally between the months and then hours assigned to the project

      Concepts used:
        - Deal Value
        - Actual Tracker (Which montsh are Forecast vs Actuals)
        - Actuals
        - Remaining Deal Value = 'Deal Value' - 'Finalised Actuals'
        - Forecasted Hours grouped by month

      This 'Remaining Deal Value' is split into the remaining Forecast months as per the Actuals Tracker, and then further into the hours assigned into each month, providing each month an hourly rate we can apply to assigned hours

      E.g.:
        $1000 Remaining for 2 months on a project
        Month 1: 10 hours total
        Month 1: 20 hours total
        Total Month Count: 2
        Monthly Amount: $1000 / 2 = $500

        Month 1: $500 -> $500 / 10 hours = $50 hourly rate
        Month 2: $500 -> $100 / 20 Hours = $25 hourly Rate

        As per 14/8/2025, the filter of business unit has been changed to cost center bk to create more robustness on the data when the businness unit name changes
        Included 12 cost centers that are within Professional Services and pruple C&D business units which are 
        'CC100', 'CC101','CC102','CC103','CC104','CC105','CC106','CC107','CC108','CC800','CC801','CC802'

        The cost center filter is the employee's cost center thus the joins with bc_employee and bc_cost center because it allows the utils to i
        include VMS project that are done by Professional Services and Purple poeple .
        
        As per October 2025, 
        All the historical records of the project role cost rate are now included with the respective effective from and effective to dates. 

        As per March 2026,
        A `resource_forecast_bk` column has been added to uniquely identify each forecast booking line.
        This is sourced from `bc_forecast_booking.resource_forecast_bk` via `int_project_forecast`,
        which is itself derived from the Workday project resource forecast line identifier.
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.raw_code:
with
    fixed_priced_booking_forecast as (
        select
            resource_forecast_bk,
            date_bk,
            month_start_date,
            region_bk,
            employee_bk,
            cost_center_bk,
            practice_bk,
            client_bk,
            client_account_director_bk,
            project_bk,
            project_role_bk,
            project_role_cost_rate,
            revenue_category_bk,
            opportunity_bk,

            forecasted_hours,
            primary_project_hierarchy,
            record_source,
            effective_from,
            effective_to
        from
            {{ ref('int_project_forecast') }}
        where
            primary_project_hierarchy in ('Prof Serve: FP','VMS: FP','PingCloud: FP') and
            revenue_type = 'FORECAST' 
            and NOT is_tm_missing_contract_rates
    ),
    -- Forecast for Prof Serve and VMS type of projects will be included
    -- but below will filter forecast for PS employees only.
    booking_forecast as (       
        select
            fixed_priced_booking_forecast.resource_forecast_bk,
            fixed_priced_booking_forecast.date_bk,
            fixed_priced_booking_forecast.month_start_date,
            fixed_priced_booking_forecast.region_bk,
            fixed_priced_booking_forecast.employee_bk,
            fixed_priced_booking_forecast.cost_center_bk,
            fixed_priced_booking_forecast.practice_bk,

model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.name: int__booking_forecast__fixed_price__monthly_rates
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.description:
This model calculates how much a Professional Servcies Fixed Price project ('Prof Serve: FP') should charge per hour for a project
        The main outputs are the project code, and the MONTH_HOURLY_RATE of each PROJECT_BK/MONTH_START_DATE
        Whilst Fixed Price Projects don't have an hourly rate attached, revenue is recognised on a Forecasted Hour basis and so an Hourly rate per month is required to proportionally forecast the amount recieved

        This month hourly rate is calculated by:
          1) Taking all Forecasted Hours, calculating the proportion of hours in a single month vs the total ()
          2) Receiving the Remaining Deal Value (Deal_Value - Actuals)
          3) Multiplying the remaining Deal_Value against this monthly proportion to obtain Monthly_Revenue
          4) Divide this Monthly_Revenue by the hours in the month to obtain the MONTH_HOURLY_RATE that can then be multiplied against Forecasted Hours

        Model Specific Inputs:
          PROJECT_BK
          MONTH_START_DATE
          FORECASTED_HOURS_MONTH
          REMAINING_FORECAST_HOURS
          REMAINING_DEAL_VALUE

        Model Specific Outputs:
          PROJECT_BK
          MONTH_START_DATE
          MONTH_HOURLY_RATE
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.raw_code:
with
    project_calendar as (
        select 
            project_bk,
            month_start_date,
            primary_project_hierarchy,
            revenue_type,
            forecasted_hours_month,
            month_revenue_amount,
            opportunity_project_value,
            month_revenue_amount_cumulative,
            remaining_deal_value
        from
            {{ ref('int__project_revenue__calendar') }}
        where
            primary_project_hierarchy = 'Prof Serve: FP'
    ),
    hours_remaining as (
        select
            project_bk,
            sum(forecasted_hours_month) as remaining_forecast_hours
        from
            project_calendar
        where 
            revenue_type = 'FORECAST'
        group by
            project_bk
    ),
    monthly_rates as (
        SELECT
            project_calendar.project_bk,
            project_calendar.month_start_date,
            project_calendar.primary_project_hierarchy,
            project_calendar.revenue_type,
            project_calendar.forecasted_hours_month,
            project_calendar.month_revenue_amount,
            project_calendar.opportunity_project_value,
            project_calendar.month_revenue_amount_cumulative,
            project_calendar.remaining_deal_value,
            hours_remaining.remaining_forecast_hours,

            -- Calculate each Month's hours as a proportion of all hours remaining on a project
            -- We get ACTUALS and FORECAST months. Only consider FORECAST month's hours for calculation
            iff(
                project_calendar.revenue_type = 'FORECAST', 
                forecasted_hours_month / remaining_forecast_hours,
                0
            )                                                       as current_month_hours_proportion,
            -- Use this proportion to split the revenue over each month proportionally
            current_month_hours_proportion * remaining_deal_value   as monthly_revenue,

            -- From the monthly_revenue, split this further between each day
            -- If monthly_revenue this is null, the day is probably outside of the start and end date of a project, so create a failsafe
            iff(
                forecasted_hours_month > 0,
                ifnull(monthly_revenue / forecasted_hours_month, 0),
                0
            )                                                       as month_hourly_rate

        FROM
            project_calendar
            LEFT JOIN
                hours_remaining
                    on  project_calendar.project_bk = hours_remaining.project_bk
    ),
    final as (
        select
            *
        from
            monthly_rates
    )

select
    *
from
    final
ORDER BY PROJECT_BK, month_start_date

model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.description:
This model recieves a list of Opportunities/Projects with a custom Start_Date, End_Date and Value attached
        The model then splits the remaining value of the project, in a monthly granularity, between the start and end date

        Considerations taken into account:
          - The first and last months only forecast for the days in teh month that are between the Start and End Date
          - Every month is normalised and is calculated as if it were 30 days. This is so that a 28 day month and a 31 day monthe ach recieve the same revenue
          - int__booking_forecast__fixed_price__normalised_spread__projects allows for custom Start Date, End Date and value, meaning that the model is Salesfore/Workday agnostic

        As per March 2026,
        A `resource_forecast_bk` column has been added to uniquely identify each forecast booking line.
        It is generated as `OPPORTUNITY_BK || '|' || DATE_BK`, combining the opportunity and date to form a unique key per project-month.
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

WITH 
INITIAL_DATE_SPINE AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_date')}}
)
-- The the actuals for opportinities, as actuals + forecasting should never exceed the deal_value
, OPPORTUNITY_ACTUALS AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ ref('int_opportunity_actuals') }}
)

-- Filter the opportunities we want, and get the actuals
-- Cap dates to starts on 2022-05-01, the migration month of Workday
-- Not all recognised and forecasted revenue was migrated over, and so Amy has advised to cap forecasting from May, as this is the date that the Contracts were set from
-- Only include projects that have days left in the current forecasting period
, OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED AS (
    SELECT
        *
    FROM
        {{ ref('int__booking_forecast__fixed_price__normalised_spread__projects') }}
)

-- Perform date arithmetic to facilitate date spine corss-join
, OPPORTUNITIY_DATES AS (
    SELECT
        OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED.*,

        -- To calculate proportion of days in the first month
        DATE_TRUNC(MONTH,  OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED.start_date) as project_start_month,
        DATEDIFF(
            day,
            OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED.start_date, 
            LAST_DAY(OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED.start_date)
        ) + 1                                                   AS project_days_in_first_month,

        -- To calculate proportion of days in the last month
         DATE_TRUNC(MONTH,  OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED.end_date) as project_end_month,
         DATE_PART(DAY,  OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED.end_date) as project_days_in_last_month
    FROM
        OPPORTUNITIY_FILTERED
)

-- Get all months that lie within the project
-- Create flags is_first_month and is_last_month to flag when proportion calculations are to happen
, DATE_CROSS_JOIN AS (
    SELECT
        OPPORTUNITIY_DATES.*,      
        INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.date_bk                                         as date_bk,
        INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.dim_date_sid,
        INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.DAYS_IN_MONTH,
        INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.month_start_date = project_start_month       as is_first_month,
        INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.month_start_date = project_end_month         as is_last_month,
        OPPORTUNITY_ACTUALS.REVENUE_AMOUNT                              as ACTUALS_AMOUNT,
        IFNULL(SUM(ACTUALS_AMOUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY PROJECT_BK), 0)   as total_actuals,
        -- We can never exceed the deal value in our calculations. Meaning that the following must always remain true to within a rounding margin of error:
        --   (FORECAST + ACTUALS) = Deal Value
        -- So we use this remaining_deal_value as the amount to split for the remainder of the project, allowing the above to remain true
        opportunity_project_value - total_actuals                                      as remaining_deal_value
    FROM
        OPPORTUNITIY_DATES
        JOIN INITIAL_DATE_SPINE
            ON INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.date_bk BETWEEN project_start_month AND project_end_month
        LEFT JOIN 
            OPPORTUNITY_ACTUALS
                ON OPPORTUNITIY_DATES.DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID = OPPORTUNITY_ACTUALS.DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID
                AND INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.month_start_date = OPPORTUNITY_ACTUALS.month_start_date
    WHERE INITIAL_DATE_SPINE.DAY_OF_MONTH = 1
)

-- Calculate the amount for each month, with a month normalised to 30 days, so that each full month has the same revenue
-- The last month is calculated here assumes no actuals, to which a CTE after will override if need be
, NORMAILISED_DATE_CROSS_JOIN AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        -- Find proportion of the 28-31 day month used in the project, multiply against 30 to get how many days would have seen used in a 30 day month
        CASE
            WHEN IS_FIRST_MONTH THEN project_days_in_first_month / DAYS_IN_MONTH
            WHEN IS_LAST_MONTH THEN project_days_in_last_month / DAYS_IN_MONTH
            ELSE 1
        END as month_proportion,
        month_proportion * 30 as normalised_days_raw,
        FLOOR(normalised_days_raw) as month_days,
        -- Get the total days of a project and the remaining days in the FORECAST periods. This remaining day amount will be value we split remaining revenue between
        sum(month_days) over (partition by PROJECT_BK) as TOTAL_DAYS,
        sum(CASE WHEN DATE_BK >= FORECAST_START_DATE_BK THEN month_days ELSE 0 END) over (partition by PROJECT_BK) as TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING,

        -- From these remaining days, divide by the remaining amount to get our daily amount and multiply across
        IFF(TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING = 0, 0, remaining_deal_value / TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING) as DAILY_AMOUNT,
        month_days * DAILY_AMOUNT as FORECASTED_AMOUNT_RAW,
        ROUND(FORECASTED_AMOUNT_RAW, 2) as FORECASTED_AMOUNT
    FROM
        DATE_CROSS_JOIN
)
, FINAL as (
    SELECT
        OPPORTUNITY_BK || '|' || DATE_BK as RESOURCE_FORECAST_BK,
        DATE_BK,
        OPPORTUNITY_BK,
        PROJECT_BK,
        STAGE_BK,
        FILTER_SOURCE,
        CLIENT_ACCOUNT_DIRECTOR_BK,
        CLIENT_BK,
        REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,
        PRACTICE_BK,
        REGION_BK,
        COST_CENTER_BK,
        SOW_VALUE,
        DEAL_VALUE,
        OPPORTUNITY_PROJECT_VALUE,
        PRIMARY_PROJECT_HIERARCHY,
        START_DATE,
        END_DATE,
        MONTH_DAYS,
        TOTAL_DAYS,
        TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING,
        REMAINING_DEAL_VALUE,
        DAILY_AMOUNT,
        FORECASTED_AMOUNT,
        ACTUALS_AMOUNT,
        -- For visibility, show the ACTUA:S/FORECAST for a given month
        CASE WHEN DATE_BK >= FORECAST_START_DATE_BK THEN FORECASTED_AMOUNT ELSE IFNULL(ACTUALS_AMOUNT, 0) END as amount,
        -- Sum this up to show that FORECAST+ACTUALS=DEAL_VALUE
        -- This may fail for Projects that have completed
        sum(amount) over (partition by PROJECT_BK) as SUMMED_amount,
        SUMMED_amount - opportunity_project_value as difference,
        DATE_BK >= FORECAST_START_DATE_BK AS in_forecast_table,
        'WORKDAY/SALESFORCE' as record_source
    FROM
        NORMAILISED_DATE_CROSS_JOIN   
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    FINAL
-- WHERE PROJECT_BK = 'AMP-003-MGS-FP'
ORDER BY PROJECT_BK, date_bk

-- Calculate the amount for each month, with a month normalised to 30 days, so that each full month has the same revenue
-- The last month is calculated here assumes no actuals, to which a CTE after will override if need be
, NORMAILISED_DATE_CROSS_JOIN AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        -- Find proportion of the 28-31 day month used in the project, multiply against 30 to get how many days would have seen used in a 30 day month
        CASE
            WHEN IS_FIRST_MONTH THEN project_days_in_first_month / DAYS_IN_MONTH
            WHEN IS_LAST_MONTH THEN project_days_in_last_month / DAYS_IN_MONTH
            ELSE 1
        END as month_proportion,
        month_proportion * 30 as normalised_days_raw,
        FLOOR(normalised_days_raw) as month_days,
        -- Get the total days of a project and the remaining days in the FORECAST periods. This remaining day amount will be value we split remaining revenue between
        sum(month_days) over (partition by PROJECT_BK) as TOTAL_DAYS,
        sum(CASE WHEN DATE_BK >= FORECAST_START_DATE_BK THEN month_days ELSE 0 END) over (partition by PROJECT_BK) as TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING,

        -- From these remaining days, divide by the remaining amount to get our daily amount and multiply across
        IFF(TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING = 0, 0, remaining_deal_value / TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING) as DAILY_AMOUNT,
        month_days * DAILY_AMOUNT as FORECASTED_AMOUNT_RAW,
        ROUND(FORECASTED_AMOUNT_RAW, 2) as FORECASTED_AMOUNT
    FROM
        DATE_CROSS_JOIN
)
, FINAL as (
    SELECT
        OPPORTUNITY_BK || '|' || DATE_BK as RESOURCE_FORECAST_BK,
        DATE_BK,
        OPPORTUNITY_BK,
        PROJECT_BK,
        STAGE_BK,
        FILTER_SOURCE,
        CLIENT_ACCOUNT_DIRECTOR_BK,
        CLIENT_BK,
        REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,
        PRACTICE_BK,
        REGION_BK,
        COST_CENTER_BK,
        SOW_VALUE,
        DEAL_VALUE,
        OPPORTUNITY_PROJECT_VALUE,
        PRIMARY_PROJECT_HIERARCHY,
        START_DATE,
        END_DATE,
        MONTH_DAYS,
        TOTAL_DAYS,
        TOTAL_DAYS_REMAINING,
        REMAINING_DEAL_VALUE,
        DAILY_AMOUNT,
        FORECASTED_AMOUNT,
        ACTUALS_AMOUNT,
        -- For visibility, show the ACTUA:S/FORECAST for a given month
        CASE WHEN DATE_BK >= FORECAST_START_DATE_BK THEN FORECASTED_AMOUNT ELSE IFNULL(ACTUALS_AMOUNT, 0) END as amount,
        -- Sum this up to show that FORECAST+ACTUALS=DEAL_VALUE
        -- This may fail for Projects that have completed
        sum(amount) over (partition by PROJECT_BK) as SUMMED_amount,
        SUMMED_amount - opportunity_project_value as difference,
        DATE_BK >= FORECAST_START_DATE_BK AS in_forecast_table,
        'WORKDAY/SALESFORCE' as record_source
    FROM
        NORMAILISED_DATE_CROSS_JOIN   
)
SELECT
    *
FROM
    FINAL
-- WHERE PROJECT_BK = 'AMP-003-MGS-FP'
ORDER BY PROJECT_BK, date_bk

model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.description:
The int__booking_forecast__internal_transformation model requires data from int__booking_forecast
      From the source model, project heirarchy tagged Internal: Transformation will be filtered
      Removed filter condition for int__booking_forecast.project_missing_from_workday not null and  not IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES
      since internal: transformation data does not have salesforce records
      Added condition to replace null values with 'ghost' for region_bk, cost_centre_bk, client_bk, practice_bk, stage_bk, opportunity_bk, and revenue_category

      Materialized to table since exposure parents are expected to be tables or incremental view.

    As per October 2025, 
    All the historical records of the project role cost rate are now included with the respective effective from and effective to dates.
model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
with
    int_booking_forecast as (
        select
            resource_forecast_bk,
            resource_forecast_sid,            
            -- what
                resource_forecast_line_id,
                project_bk,
                project_role_bk,                      
                ifnull(cost_center_bk,'ghost') as cost_center_bk ,
                ifnull(practice_bk, 'ghost') as practice_bk,
                ifnull(opportunity_bk, 'ghost') as opportunity_bk,
                primary_project_hierarchy,
                ifnull(revenue_category_bk, 'ghost') as revenue_category_bk,
                stage_mismatch,
                project_missing_from_workday,
                is_date_inside_project,
                project_owner_workday,
                contract_is_rate_daily,
                is_tm_missing_contract_rates,
                adjustment_is_daily_rate,
                revenue_type,                                        
            -- when
                date_bk,
                month_start_date,
                dim_date_sid,
                start_date,
                end_date,
                start_date_salesforce,
                end_date_salesforce,
                booking_date_first,
                booking_date_last,  
                booking_period_date_earliest,
                booking_period_date_latest,  
            -- where  
                ifnull(region_bk,'ghost') as region_bk,   
                workday_project_state,                      
            -- who
                employee_bk,
                employee_bk_safe,
                dim_employee_sid,
                client_account_director_bk, 
                ifnull(client_bk,'ghost') as client_bk,         
                owner_id,                                                                                   
            -- how 
                ifnull(stage_bk,'ghost') as stage_bk,              
            -- how much 
                sow_amount,     
                opportunity_project_value,
                total_project_forecasted_hours,
                forecasted_hours_month,
                forecasted_hours,
                project_role_cost_rate,
                contract_billing_rate,
                working_hours,      
                project_billing_rate_sheet_id,  
                contract_rate_sheet,
                rate_adjustment_amount,                                                                   
            -- audit        
                effective_from,
                effective_to,
                record_source  
            
        from {{ ref('int__booking_forecast') }}
        where 
            -- Business Confirmation
            -- Sadhi confirmed that Unless Salesforce has been set to CLOSED_WON, Workday stages are to be completly ignored.
            -- After SF is in CLOSED_WON, Workday can take over, however these Workday stages afterwards are superfluous for processing at the moment.

            -- int_booking_forecast provides a full history of rates including ACTUALS period. Only grab rates from months in a Forecast period
            revenue_type = 'FORECAST'
            -- If Project is not in workday, don't allow it to pass. We are unable to obtain key information about it and will produce junk data.
            {# and not int__booking_forecast.project_missing_from_workday
            and not IS_TM_MISSING_CONTRACT_RATES #}
    ),
    final as (
        select
            int_booking_forecast.*,
            dim_revenue_category.dim_revenue_category_sid,
            -- Contract Rates
                -- Null case provided to allow for future error states if required as result can be TRUE/FALSE/NULL, and to allow for explicit case handling
                case
                    when contract_is_rate_daily            then contract_billing_rate / working_hours
                    when not contract_is_rate_daily        then contract_billing_rate
                    when contract_is_rate_daily is null    then contract_billing_rate
                end as contract_billing_rate_hourly,
                case
                    when contract_is_rate_daily            then contract_billing_rate
                    when not contract_is_rate_daily        then contract_billing_rate * working_hours
                    when contract_is_rate_daily is null    then contract_billing_rate
                end as contract_billing_rate_daily,

                -- Contract Rate Adjustments
                case
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate          then rate_adjustment_amount / working_hours
                    when not adjustment_is_daily_rate      then rate_adjustment_amount
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate is null  then rate_adjustment_amount
                end as rate_adjustment_amount_hourly,
                case
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate          then rate_adjustment_amount
                    when not adjustment_is_daily_rate      then rate_adjustment_amount * working_hours
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate is null  then rate_adjustment_amount
                end as rate_adjustment_amount_daily,

                forecasted_hours * contract_billing_rate_hourly  as contract_amount,
                forecasted_hours * rate_adjustment_amount_hourly as adjusted_amount,
            
                -- If this results in a null, chances are the employee_bk is null and so a rate couldn't be found
                IFNULL(adjusted_amount, contract_amount) as amount
        from
            int_booking_forecast
        left join {{ ref('dim_revenue_category') }} as dim_revenue_category
            on int_booking_forecast.revenue_category_bk = dim_revenue_category.revenue_category_bk
        where primary_project_hierarchy = 'Internal: Transformation'
        {# and not is_tm_missing_contract_rates #}
    )

select
    *
from
    final
