model.cr_project.int__booking_forecast__.description:
This model provides forecasting for Workday projects with a PRIMARY_PROJECT_HIERARCHY of Prof Serve: TM
      The Forecasting is based on the Workday API EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_FORECAST, as bases forecasting on Forecasted Hours and a Worker's Contract Rate on said specific Project
      The calculation is done via:

      - Seeing whether an 'Override rate' has been applied, and use this if provided
      - Multiply the worker's Rate by the Hours on a project/day, and the Daily revenue is provided

      If a Contract Rate Sheet is not applied, 0 revenue would be provided. A seperate model 'int__booking_forecast__fixed_price__normalised_spread__projects' provides backup forecasting in this case

    As per October 2025, 
    All the historical records of the project role cost rate are now included with the respective effective from and effective to dates.

with

          select
          *
          from
          {{ ref('int__booking_forecast__time_and_materials__all_stages') }}
          where stage_bk = 'CLOSED_WON'
     )

     *
from
     final

                contract_billing_rate,
                working_hours,      
                project_billing_rate_sheet_id,  
                contract_rate_sheet,
                rate_adjustment_amount,                                                                   
            -- audit        
                effective_from,
                effective_to,
                record_source  
            
        from {{ ref('int__booking_forecast') }}
        where 
            -- Business Confirmation
            -- Sadhi confirmed that Unless Salesforce has been set to CLOSED_WON, Workday stages are to be completly ignored.

            -- int_booking_forecast provides a full history of rates including ACTUALS period. Only grab rates from months in a Forecast period
            revenue_type = 'FORECAST'
            -- If Project is not in workday, don't allow it to pass. We are unable to obtain key information about it and will produce junk data.
            and not int__booking_forecast.project_missing_from_workday
    ),
    final as (
        select
            int_booking_forecast.*,
            -- Contract Rates
                -- Null case provided to allow for future error states if required as result can be TRUE/FALSE/NULL, and to allow for explicit case handling
                case
                    when contract_is_rate_daily            then contract_billing_rate / working_hours
                    when not contract_is_rate_daily        then contract_billing_rate
                    when contract_is_rate_daily is null    then contract_billing_rate
                end as contract_billing_rate_hourly,
                case
                    when contract_is_rate_daily            then contract_billing_rate
                    when not contract_is_rate_daily        then contract_billing_rate * working_hours
                    when contract_is_rate_daily is null    then contract_billing_rate
                end as contract_billing_rate_daily,

                -- Contract Rate Adjustments
                case
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate          then rate_adjustment_amount / working_hours
                    when not adjustment_is_daily_rate      then rate_adjustment_amount
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate is null  then rate_adjustment_amount
                end as rate_adjustment_amount_hourly,
                case
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate          then rate_adjustment_amount
                    when not adjustment_is_daily_rate      then rate_adjustment_amount * working_hours
                    when adjustment_is_daily_rate is null  then rate_adjustment_amount
                end as rate_adjustment_amount_daily,

                forecasted_hours * contract_billing_rate_hourly  as contract_amount,
                forecasted_hours * rate_adjustment_amount_hourly as adjusted_amount,
            
                -- If this results in a null, chances are the employee_bk is null and so a rate couldn't be found
                IFNULL(adjusted_amount, contract_amount) as amount
        from
            int_booking_forecast
        where primary_project_hierarchy in ('Prof Serve: TM', 'VMS: TM')
    )

model.cr_project.int_project_forecast.description:
This view contains the Project Forecasted Hours from the Workday Project Resource Forecast(via Datavault models).
        Uses the Actual Tracker to determine which months are Forecast vs Actuals.

        As per March 2026,
        This model now filters `bc_forecast_booking` to only include the most current version of each forecast record
        (`current_timestamp() between effective_from and effective_to`), as historical cost rate tracking (SCD2 behaviour)
        is not required for utilisation or project profitability reporting.
model.cr_project.int_project_forecast.raw_code:
with 
forecast_hours as (
    select 
            bc.resource_forecast_bk,
            bc.date_bk,
            --bcfh.month_start_date,
            concat(LEFT(bc.date_bk, 7), '-01')      as month_start_date,
            bc.forecasted_hours,
            bc.employee_bk,
            bc.project_bk,
            bc.project_role_bk,
            bc.project_role_cost_rate,
            bc.effective_from,
            bc.effective_to,
            bc.record_source
    from 
        {{ ref('bc_forecast_booking') }} bc
    where
        current_timestamp() between bc.effective_from and bc.effective_to
),
project as (
    select
        project_bk,
        primary_project_hierarchy,
        opportunity_bk,
        stage_bk,
        region_bk,
        cost_center_bk,
        practice_bk,
        client_bk,
        client_account_director_bk,
        is_tm_missing_contract_rates
    from
        {{ ref('int_opportunity_exposure_forecast') }}
),
manual_revenue_category_mapping as (
    select
        primary_project_hierarchy,
        revenue_category_bk
    from
        {{ ref('stg_manual_primary_project_hierarchy_revenue_category_mapping') }}

),
bridge_actuals_tracker as (
    select
        date,
        revenue_type,
        dbt_valid_from,
        dbt_valid_to
    from
        {{ ref('bridge_actuals_tracker') }}
),
final as(
    select
        forecast_hours.resource_forecast_bk,
        forecast_hours.date_bk,
        forecast_hours.month_start_date,
        forecast_hours.project_role_cost_rate,
        forecast_hours.forecasted_hours,
        forecast_hours.employee_bk,
        forecast_hours.project_bk,
        forecast_hours.project_role_bk,
        forecast_hours.record_source,
        project.primary_project_hierarchy,
        project.opportunity_bk,
        project.stage_bk,
        project.region_bk,
        project.cost_center_bk,
        project.practice_bk,
        project.client_bk,
        project.client_account_director_bk,
        project.is_tm_missing_contract_rates,
        manual_revenue_category_mapping.revenue_category_bk,
        bridge_actuals_tracker.revenue_type,
        bridge_actuals_tracker.dbt_valid_from,
        bridge_actuals_tracker.dbt_valid_to,
        forecast_hours.effective_from,
        forecast_hours.effective_to
    from
        forecast_hours
    left join
        project
        on forecast_hours.project_bk = project.project_bk
    left join
        bridge_actuals_tracker
        on forecast_hours.month_start_date = bridge_actuals_tracker.date
    left join 
        manual_revenue_category_mapping
        on project.primary_project_hierarchy = manual_revenue_category_mapping.primary_project_hierarchy
    where
    current_timestamp() between 
        bridge_actuals_tracker.dbt_valid_from and 
        bridge_actuals_tracker.dbt_valid_to 
)
select 
    *   
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_journal_lines_.description:
This model creates a layer to get the Business Keys required to link to other Dimensions.
    This model also extracts the Opportunity business keys from the Datavault and maps other BKs from manual files.
    This model applies exchange rates from stg_workday__exchange_rates to Workday Journal lines. 
    This allows for the Revenue_Amount to be in AUD.
model.cr_project.int_fact_journal_lines_.raw_code:
with
    bridge_journal_lines as (
        select
            journal_line_bk,
            journal_bk,
            region_bk,
            project_bk,
            cost_center_bk,
            practice_bk,            
            client_bk,
            revenue_category_bk,            
            sales_item_bk,
            account_bk,
            company_bk,
            spend_category_bk
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_journal_lines') }}
    ),
    bc_journal_lines as (
        select
            journal_line_bk,
            date_bk,                 
            status,
            currency,
            ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit,
            ledger_debit_amount,
            ledger_credit_amount,
            client_salesforce_position,
            record_source
        from 
            {{ref('bc_journal_lines')}}
    ),
    opportunity_project as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            project_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project')}}
    ),
    opportunity as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            client_bk,
            client_account_director_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity')}}
    ), 
    exchange_rates as (
        select 
            currency_rate,
            currency_rate_type,
            effective_from,
            effective_to,
            source_currency
        from
            {{ref('bc_exchange_rates')}}
        where
            target_currency = 'AUD' and
            currency_rate_type = 'Average'
    ),
    manual_spend_category_revenue_category as (
        select
            spend_category_bk,
            revenue_category_bk

        from
            {{ref('stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category')}}
    ), 
    final as (
        select
            --when
            bc_journal_lines.date_bk,
            --who
            bridge_journal_lines.cost_center_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.practice_bk,

            --client_bk logic
            bc_journal_lines.client_salesforce_position,
            bridge_journal_lines.client_bk              as journal_client_bk,
            opportunity.client_bk                       as opportunity_client_bk,                      
            iff(bc_journal_lines.client_salesforce_position >= 1,
                bridge_journal_lines.client_bk,
                coalesce(
                    opportunity.client_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}'
                    )
                )                                       as client_bk,  
            bridge_journal_lines.account_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.company_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.client_account_director_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as client_account_director_bk,         
            --what
            bridge_journal_lines.journal_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.opportunity_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as opportunity_bk,
            bc_journal_lines.journal_line_bk,
            iff(bridge_journal_lines.revenue_category_bk <> 'ghost',
                bridge_journal_lines.revenue_category_bk, 
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category.revenue_category_bk
                )                                       as revenue_category_bk,            
            bridge_journal_lines.spend_category_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.project_bk,
            bridge_journal_lines.sales_item_bk,
            --where
            bridge_journal_lines.region_bk,
            --how much
            bc_journal_lines.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit,
            bc_journal_lines.ledger_debit_amount,
            bc_journal_lines.ledger_credit_amount,            
            bc_journal_lines.currency,
            ifnull(bc_journal_lines.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit * exchange_rates.currency_rate,
                   bc_journal_lines.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit) * -1      as revenue_amount,

            exchange_rates.source_currency,
            exchange_rates.currency_rate                 as exchange_rate,
            exchange_rates.effective_from                as exchange_rate_effective_from,
            exchange_rates.effective_to                  as exchange_rate_effective_to,
            bc_journal_lines.status,                   
            bc_journal_lines.record_source  
        from 
            bridge_journal_lines
            join
                bc_journal_lines
                    on bridge_journal_lines.journal_line_bk = bc_journal_lines.journal_line_bk
            left join
                opportunity_project
                    on bridge_journal_lines.project_bk = opportunity_project.project_bk
            left join
                opportunity
                    on opportunity_project.opportunity_bk = opportunity.opportunity_bk  
            left join
                exchange_rates
                    on bc_journal_lines.date_bk 
                        between exchange_rates.effective_from and exchange_rates.effective_to
                        and bc_journal_lines.currency = exchange_rates.source_currency
            left join
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category
                    on
                        bridge_journal_lines.spend_category_bk = manual_spend_category_revenue_category.spend_category_bk                                                
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_opportunity_fi.raw_code:
with
    bridge_opportunity_field_history as (
        select
            LNK_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID, 
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID, 
            OPPORTUNITY_BK, 
            H_OPPORTUNITY_SID, 
            RECORD_SOURCE, 
            LOAD_DATE_TIME
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity_field_history') }}
    ),
    bc_opportunity_field_history as (
        select
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID, 
            DATA_TYPE, 
            FIELD, 
            IS_DELETED, 
            NEW_VALUE, 
            OLD_VALUE, 
            CREATED_BY_ID, 
            CREATED_DATE, 
            RECORD_SOURCE, 
            LOAD_DATE_TIME
        from 
            {{ref('bc_opportunity_field_history')}}
    ),
    opportunity_field_history as (
        select
            bridge_opportunity_field_history.opportunity_bk,
            DATE(created_date) as date_bk,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.data_type,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.field,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.is_deleted,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.new_value,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.old_value,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.created_date,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.created_by_id,
            bc_opportunity_field_history.record_source,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP  AS load_date_time
        from 
            bridge_opportunity_field_history
            join
                bc_opportunity_field_history
                    on bridge_opportunity_field_history.h_opportunity_field_history_sid = bc_opportunity_field_history.h_opportunity_field_history_sid 
        where field in ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
            
    ),
    pivottable as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            date_bk,
            created_by_id,
            created_date,
            "'Amount'" as amount,
            "'StageName'" as stage_name,
            "'Start_Date__c'" as start_date__c,
            "'End_Date__c'" as end_date__c,
            record_source
        from
            opportunity_field_history
             PIVOT
            (
            Max(new_value)
            FOR Field IN ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
            ) AS pivottable
            order by created_date desc
 
    ),
    final AS (
        SELECT 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK, DATE_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE desc) as rowNum,
            opportunity_bk,
            date_bk,
            created_date,
            created_by_id,
            LAST_VALUE(amount IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount,
            LAST_VALUE(stage_name IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS stage_name,
            LAST_VALUE(start_date__c IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS start_date,
            LAST_VALUE(end_date__c IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY OPPORTUNITY_BK ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS end_date,
            record_source,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as load_date_time
        FROM  
            pivottable
        order by created_date desc
    )
select
    opportunity_bk || '/' || date_bk as opportunity_field_history_bk,
    opportunity_bk,
    date_bk,
    created_date,
    created_by_id,
    amount,
    stage_name,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    record_source,
    load_date_time
from
    final
where rowNum = 1

model.cr_project.int_fact_project_revenu.description:
# Model: int_fact_project_revenue__bks

## Business Purpose
Creates an intermediate layer that assembles business keys and performs necessary transformations for the project revenue fact table.
This model enriches journal line data with opportunity relationships, applies exchange rate conversions, and resolves client attribution logic.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations

### Exchange Rate Conversion
- Applies average exchange rates from `bc_exchange_rates` to convert all amounts to AUD
- Joins on date and source currency to find applicable rate
- Revenue amount calculation: `(ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit * exchange_rate) * -1`
- Rounds to 2 decimal places as NUMBER(18,2)

### Revenue Category Mapping
- Primary source: `bridge_project_revenue.revenue_category_bk`
- Fallback: Maps from spend category using `stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category`
- Uses manual mapping when revenue category is 'ghost'

### Data Filtering
- **Only includes Posted journal lines** (`status = 'Posted'`)
- Excludes cancelled transactions

## Sources & Dependencies

### Direct Dependencies
- `dvbridge_project_revenue` - Links to dimensions (journal, region, project, cost center, practice, client, revenue category, sales item, account, company, spend category)
- `bc_project_revenue` - Core revenue transaction data with amounts and metadata
- `dvbridge_opportunity_project` - Links projects to opportunities
- `dvbridge_opportunity` - Opportunity details including client and account director
- `bc_exchange_rates` - Currency conversion rates (filtered to AUD target, Average rate type)
- `stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category` - Manual mapping between spend and revenue categories

## Key Fields

### Grain
- `project_revenue_bk` - Unique identifier for each revenue transaction

### Measures
- `revenue_amount` - Converted AUD amount (posted transactions only)
- `exchange_rate` - Applied conversion rate
- `currency` - Original transaction currency

### Attributes
- `operational_transaction`, `header_memo`, `line_memo` - Transaction details
- `source`, `record_source` - Data lineage
- `status` - Journal status (filtered to 'Posted')
- `exchange_rate_effective_from`, `exchange_rate_effective_to` - Rate validity period

## Additional Notes
- Ghost records are used for missing optional relationships
- All revenue amounts are standardized to AUD for consistent reporting
- Complex client attribution logic supports both direct journal entries and opportunity-linked projects
- Manual revenue category mapping provides flexibility for unmapped spend categories
model.cr_project.int_fact_project_revenu.raw_code:
with
    bridge_project_revenue as (
        select
            project_revenue_bk,
            journal_bk,
            region_bk,
            project_bk,
            cost_center_bk,
            practice_bk,            
            client_bk,
            revenue_category_bk,            
            sales_item_bk,
            account_bk,
            company_bk,
            spend_category_bk
        from
            {{ ref('dvbridge_project_revenue') }}
    ),
    bc_project_revenue as (
        select
            project_revenue_bk,
            date_bk,                 
            status,
            currency,
            ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit,
            operational_transaction, 
            header_memo, 
            line_memo,
            client_salesforce_position,
            source,
            record_source
        from 
            {{ref('bc_project_revenue')}}
    ),
    opportunity_project as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            project_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project')}}
    ),
    opportunity as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            client_bk,
            client_account_director_bk
        from
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity')}}
    ), 
    exchange_rates as (
        select 
            currency_rate,
            currency_rate_type,
            effective_from,
            effective_to,
            source_currency
        from
            {{ref('bc_exchange_rates')}}
        where
            target_currency = 'AUD' and
            currency_rate_type = 'Average'
    ),
    manual_spend_category_revenue_category as (
        select
            spend_category_bk,
            revenue_category_bk

        from
            {{ref('stg_manual_spend_category_revenue_category')}}
    ), 
    final as (
        select
            --when
            bc_project_revenue.date_bk,
            --who
            bridge_project_revenue.cost_center_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.practice_bk,

            --client_bk logic
            bc_project_revenue.client_salesforce_position,
            bridge_project_revenue.client_bk              as journal_client_bk,
            opportunity.client_bk                       as opportunity_client_bk,                      
            iff(bc_project_revenue.client_salesforce_position >= 1,
                bridge_project_revenue.client_bk,
                coalesce(
                    opportunity.client_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}'
                    )
                )                                       as client_bk,  
            bridge_project_revenue.account_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.company_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.client_account_director_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as client_account_director_bk,         
            --what
            bridge_project_revenue.journal_bk,
            ifnull(opportunity.opportunity_bk, 
                    '{{var("ghost_record")}}')          as opportunity_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.project_revenue_bk,
            iff(bridge_project_revenue.revenue_category_bk <> 'ghost',
                bridge_project_revenue.revenue_category_bk, 
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category.revenue_category_bk
                )                                       as revenue_category_bk,            
            bridge_project_revenue.spend_category_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.project_bk,
            bridge_project_revenue.sales_item_bk,
            --where
            bridge_project_revenue.region_bk,
            --how much         
            bc_project_revenue.currency,
            CAST(
                ROUND(
                    IFNULL(
                        bc_project_revenue.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit
                        * exchange_rates.currency_rate,
                        bc_project_revenue.ledger_budget_debit_minus_credit
                    ) * -1,
                    2
                ) AS NUMBER(18,2)
            ) AS revenue_amount,
            bc_project_revenue.operational_transaction, 
            bc_project_revenue.header_memo, 
            bc_project_revenue.line_memo,
            bc_project_revenue.source,
            exchange_rates.source_currency,
            exchange_rates.currency_rate                 as exchange_rate,
            exchange_rates.effective_from                as exchange_rate_effective_from,
            exchange_rates.effective_to                  as exchange_rate_effective_to,
            bc_project_revenue.status,                   
            bc_project_revenue.record_source  
        from 
            bridge_project_revenue
            join
                bc_project_revenue
                    on bridge_project_revenue.project_revenue_bk = bc_project_revenue.project_revenue_bk
            left join
                opportunity_project
                    on bridge_project_revenue.project_bk = opportunity_project.project_bk
            left join
                opportunity
                    on opportunity_project.opportunity_bk = opportunity.opportunity_bk  
            left join
                exchange_rates
                    on bc_project_revenue.date_bk 
                        between exchange_rates.effective_from and exchange_rates.effective_to
                        and bc_project_revenue.currency = exchange_rates.source_currency
            left join
                manual_spend_category_revenue_category
                    on
                        bridge_project_revenue.spend_category_bk = manual_spend_category_revenue_category.spend_category_bk 
        where  bc_project_revenue.status = 'Posted'                                          
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_fact_sow_amount__ad.name: int_fact_sow_amount__add_fte
model.cr_project.int_fact_sow_amount__ad.description:
This intermediate model enhances the sow amount data by calculating the estimated FTE percentage and weighted values(for Amount and FTE).
    - FTE formula is daily_amount / average_bill_rate( currently set to $2000)
    - Weighted values are calculated by multiplying the value with the Opportunity's Stage probability.
model.cr_project.int_fact_sow_amount__ad.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='view'
    ) }}
with 
    opportunity_history as(
        select
            *
        from
            {{ref('ens_opportunity_daily_amount')}}
    ),
    employee_working_hours as (
        select
            median(working_hours) as hours
        from
            {{ref('bc_employee_current')}}
    ),
    stage_probability as (
        select
            stage_bk,
            probability
        from
            {{ref('bc_stage')}}     
    ),
    average_bill_rate as (
        select 2000 as amount
    ),
    final as (
        select
            opportunity_history.date_bk,
            opportunity_history.opportunity_bk,
            opportunity_history.opportunity_history_bk,
            opportunity_history.service_offering,
            opportunity_history.project_bk,
            opportunity_history.revenue_category_bk,
            opportunity_history.third_party_product,
            opportunity_history.region_bk,
            opportunity_history.start_date,
            opportunity_history.end_date,
            opportunity_history.closed_date,
            opportunity_history.client_bk,
            opportunity_history.practice_bk,
            opportunity_history.business_unit,
            opportunity_history.client_account_director_bk,
            opportunity_history.stage_bk,
            opportunity_history.amount,
            opportunity_history.effective_from,
            opportunity_history.effective_to,
            opportunity_history.record_source,
            opportunity_history.load_date_time,
            opportunity_history.cost_center_bk,            
            opportunity_history.source_currency,
            opportunity_history.exchange_rate_effective_from,
            opportunity_history.exchange_rate_effective_to,
            opportunity_history.exchange_rate,
            opportunity_history.number_of_working_days,
            opportunity_history.daily_amount,
            stage_probability.probability                                                                                as stage_probability,
            opportunity_history.daily_amount * stage_probability.probability                                             as weighted_amount,                                           
            round((opportunity_history.daily_amount / average_bill_rate.amount),2)                                       as fte,
            round((opportunity_history.daily_amount / average_bill_rate.amount),2) * stage_probability.probability       as weighted_fte,
            round((employee_working_hours.hours * (opportunity_history.daily_amount / average_bill_rate.amount)),2)      as hours        
        from 
            opportunity_history
            left join
                average_bill_rate
            left join
                employee_working_hours
            left join   
                stage_probability
                    on opportunity_history.stage_bk = stage_probability.stage_bk
    )
select 
    *
from 
    final

This model merges the current and historical view of an Opportunity.

model.cr_project.int_opportunity_history.raw_code:

select

		stg_salesforce__opportunity.start_date,

	-- where

	-- how

		stg_salesforce__opportunity.forecast_category_name,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_closed,
		stg_salesforce__opportunity.is_won,
	-- how much
		coalesce(
            bc_opportunity_history.amount,
            stg_salesforce__opportunity.amount

		stg_salesforce__opportunity.probability,
	-- who

        {{ ref( 'bc_opportunity_history') }}

model.cr_project.int_fact_time_sheet__bk.name: int_fact_time_sheet__bks
model.cr_project.int_fact_time_sheet__bk.description:
This model sources all business keys and attributes directly from `bc_time_sheet`, which now contains the latest timesheet records and all required fields.

## Key Features
- Uses `bc_time_sheet` for both business keys and attributes (project, employee, cost center, practice, project role, etc.)
- Joins timesheet records to client dimension via project and opportunity bridge tables
- Enriches timesheets with cost rates from `bc_project_cost_rate` based on:
  - Employee assignment
  - Project assignment
  - Project role
  - Timesheet date falling within cost rate period
- Uses left join for cost rates since not all timesheets have matching cost rate records

## Cost Rate Logic
Cost rates are matched when the timesheet date falls within the cost rate's start and end date range. If no match is found, `cost_rate` and `cost_rate_currency` will be null.
model.cr_project.int_fact_time_sheet__bk.raw_code:
with
    bridge_opportunity_project as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            project_bk
        from    
            {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project') }}
    ),      
    bridge_opportunity as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            client_bk
        from    
            {{ ref('dvbridge_opportunity') }}
    ),
    -- Project cost rates with resolved overlaps
    bc_project_cost_rate as (
        select
            project_bk,

{{ config(materialized="table") }}

with
    xero_region_mapping as (
        select 
            region,
	        region_bk 
        from 
            {{ ref("xero_workday_region_mappings") }}
    ),
    xero_practice_mapping as (
        select 
            division,
            practice_bk 
        from 
            {{ ref("xero_workday_practice_mappings") }}
    ),
    xero_cost_center_mapping as (
        select 
            cost_center_bk,
            region
        from 
            {{ ref("xero_workday_cost_center_mappings") }}
    ),
    xero_revenue_category_mapping as (
        select
            region,
            division,
            pricing_structure,
            revenue_category
        from {{ ref("xero_workday_revenue_category_mappings") }}
    ),
    revenue_accounts as (
        select
            account_code,
            account_name,
            account_type
        from
            {{ ref('stg_xero__versent__accounts') }}
        where
            account_type = 'REVENUE' --or
            -- account_code = '216'
    ),
    xero as (
        select
            case
                when position('-TM', int__fact_xero_revenue__union.project_bk) > 0
                then 'Time & Materials'
                when position('-FP', int__fact_xero_revenue__union.project_bk) > 0
                then 'Fixed Price'
                else 'Time & Materials'
            end as pricing_structure,
            -- int__fact_xero_revenue__union.account_code,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.region,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.division,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.customer,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.project_bk,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.date_bk,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.document_id,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.description,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.revenue_amount,
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.record_source,
            revenue_accounts.account_code,
            revenue_accounts.account_name,
            revenue_accounts.account_type
        from 
            {{ ref("int__fact_xero_revenue__union") }}
        join
            revenue_accounts
            on 
                int__fact_xero_revenue__union.account_code = revenue_accounts.account_code
        where
            int__fact_xero_revenue__union.account_code <> '217'

    ),
    salesforce_history as (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over (
                partition by int_opportunity_history.project_bk order by effective_from
            ) rnk
        from {{ ref("int_opportunity_history") }}
        where to_varchar(effective_to, 'yyyy') = '2900' and stage_bk = 'CLOSED_WON'
    ),
    final as (
        select
            xero.*,
            coalesce(
                xero_region_mapping.region_bk, 
                'ghost')                                as region_bk,
            coalesce(
                xero_practice_mapping.practice_bk, 
                'ghost')                                as practice_bk,
            coalesce(
                xero_cost_center_mapping.cost_center_bk, 
                'ghost'
            )                                           as cost_center_bk,
            coalesce(
                xero_revenue_category_mapping.revenue_category, 
                'ghost'
            )                                           as revenue_category_bk,
            stg_opportunity_salesforce.client_bk        as salesforce_client,
            coalesce(
                bc_client_current.client_bk,
                stg_opportunity_salesforce.client_bk,
                stg_seeds__xero__customer_mapping.client_bk,
                'ghost'
            )                                           as client_bk,
            xero.customer                               as client_name,
            coalesce(
                stg_opportunity_salesforce.opportunity_bk, 
                'ghost'
            )                                           as opportunity_bk,
            stg_opportunity_salesforce.stage_bk
        from xero
        left join 
            xero_region_mapping 
                on 
                    xero.region = xero_region_mapping.region
        left join
            xero_practice_mapping 
                on xero.division = xero_practice_mapping.division
        left join
            xero_cost_center_mapping 
                on xero.region = xero_cost_center_mapping.region
        left join
            xero_revenue_category_mapping
            on 
                xero.region = xero_revenue_category_mapping.region and 
                equal_null(xero.division, xero_revenue_category_mapping.division) and 
                xero.pricing_structure = xero_revenue_category_mapping.pricing_structure
        -- map client names
            left join
                {{ ref("bc_client_current") }}
                on 
                    upper(xero.customer) = upper(bc_client_current.client_name)
            left join
                {{ ref('stg_seeds__xero__customer_mapping') }}
                on
                    xero.customer = stg_seeds__xero__customer_mapping.client_name
        left join
            salesforce_history stg_opportunity_salesforce
            on 
                xero.project_bk = stg_opportunity_salesforce.project_bk and 
                stg_opportunity_salesforce.rnk = 1

    )
select
    -- When
        date_bk,
    -- Where
        region as old_region_raw,
        upper(trim(region)) as old_region,
        region_bk,
    -- Who
        cost_center_bk,
        division,
        practice_bk,
        salesforce_client,
        client_bk,
        client_name,
    -- How
        revenue_category_bk,
    -- What
        account_code, -- for tests only
        account_name,
        account_type,
        document_id,
        description,
        pricing_structure,
        project_bk,
        opportunity_bk,
        stage_bk,
    -- How Much
        revenue_amount as amount,
    -- Audit
        record_source
from final

                on xero.region = xero_cost_center_mapping.region
        left join
            xero_revenue_category_mapping
            on 
                xero.region = xero_revenue_category_mapping.region and 
                equal_null(xero.division, xero_revenue_category_mapping.division) and 
                xero.pricing_structure = xero_revenue_category_mapping.pricing_structure
        -- map client names
            left join
                datavault__business.bc_client_current
                on 
                    upper(xero.customer) = upper(bc_client_current.client_name)
            left join
                staging.stg_seeds__xero__customer_mapping
                on
                    xero.customer = stg_seeds__xero__customer_mapping.client_name
        left join
            salesforce_history stg_opportunity_salesforce
            on 
                xero.project_bk = stg_opportunity_salesforce.project_bk and 
                stg_opportunity_salesforce.rnk = 1

    )
select
    -- When
        date_bk,
    -- Where
        region as old_region_raw,
        upper(trim(region)) as old_region,
        region_bk,
    -- Who
        cost_center_bk,
        division,
        practice_bk,
        salesforce_client,
        client_bk,
        client_name,
    -- How
        revenue_category_bk,
    -- What
        account_code, -- for tests only
        account_name,
        account_type,
        document_id,
        description,
        pricing_structure,
        project_bk,
        opportunity_bk,
        stage_bk,
    -- How Much
        revenue_amount as amount,
    -- Audit
        record_source
from final

model.cr_project.bc_absence_type.description:
# Model: bc_absence_type

## Business Purpose
Assembles the full business concept for Absence Type at a Point In Time (PIT) of the dbt run. Enriches hub and satellite data with the deductible supply hours classification carried in the dedicated datavault satellite.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Joins `hub_absence_type`, `pit_absence_type`, and `sat_absence_type` (including the `sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours` attributes via the PIT/BC join) to produce the current-state record per absence type.

## Sources & Dependencies

# Model: bc_absence_type_current

## Business Purpose
Provides the current, deduplicated view of each absence type by selecting only the latest `as_of_date` record per `h_absence_type_sid` from `bc_absence_type`. Intended for use by downstream dimension models that require a single row per absence type.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Deduplicates `bc_absence_type` using `QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h_absence_type_sid ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) = 1`.
- Applies `IFNULL` defaults: `'ghost'` for string columns, `false` for `is_deductible_from_supply_hours`, and `'Keep'` for `deductible_from_supply_hours`.

## Sources & Dependencies
- `bc_absence_type` — business concept model

## Key Fields
- `h_absence_type_sid` — hashed surrogate key (unique in this model)
- `absence_type_bk` — natural Business Key from Workday
- `absence_name` — display name of the absence type
- `is_deductible_from_supply_hours` — boolean; `true` if the absence type reduces supply hours
- `deductible_from_supply_hours` — `Remove` if deductible, `Keep` if not

## Update Frequency
- Updated with each dbt job run.

model.cr_project.pit_absence_type.compiled_code:
with 
-- ##### generated_as_of_dates
    sat_absence_type_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_absence_type
    ),
    sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours
    ),
    union_sat_as_of_dates as (        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_absence_type_as_of_date
        union        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_as_of_date
        
    ),
    generated_as_of_dates as (
        select distinct *
        from union_sat_as_of_dates
    ),
-- ##### generated_as_of_dates 
    rows_as_of_dates as (
        select
            hub.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID,
            as_of_dates.as_of_date
        from
            datavault__raw.hub_absence_type hub
        left join
            generated_as_of_dates as_of_dates             
            on hub.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID  = as_of_dates.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
          
    ),
    sat_absence_type_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_absence_type
    ),
    sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours
    ),          
    row_sats as (
        select
            rows_as_of_dates.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID,
            rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date,
            -- ghost
            
    CAST(MD5_BINARY(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST('ghost' AS VARCHAR))), '')) AS BINARY(16)) AS hk_ghost,
            cast('1900-01-01 00:00:00' as timestamp) as early_date,
            sat_absence_type_src.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID as sat_absence_type_pk,
            sat_absence_type_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_absence_type_ldts,
            sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_src.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID as sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_pk,
            sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_ldts  
        from
            rows_as_of_dates
            left join
                 sat_absence_type_effective_dates as sat_absence_type_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID = sat_absence_type_src.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_absence_type_src.effective_from
                    and sat_absence_type_src.effective_to
            left join
                 sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_effective_dates as sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID = sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_src.H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_src.effective_from
                    and sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_src.effective_to       

    ),
    final as (
        select
            H_ABSENCE_TYPE_SID,
            coalesce(as_of_date, early_date) as as_of_date,            
                coalesce(sat_absence_type_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_absence_type_pk,
                coalesce(sat_absence_type_ldts, early_date) as sat_absence_type_ldts,            
                coalesce(sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_pk,
                coalesce(sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_ldts, early_date) as sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_ldts    
        from
            row_sats 
    )    
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.pit_account_current.compiled_code:
-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_account

WITH as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT * FROM datavault__business.pit_as_at_current_date
),

last_safe_load_datetime AS (
    SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_account
            
        ) AS l
),

as_of_grain_old_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_account_current
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.H_ACCOUNT_SID
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_account AS h

    
    WHERE h.LOAD_DATE_TIME >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_account_current AS a
    INNER JOIN datavault__raw.hub_account as b
        ON a.H_ACCOUNT_SID = b.H_ACCOUNT_SID
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM new_rows_pks AS a
    INNER JOIN backfill_as_of AS b
        ON (1=1)
),

backfill AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_account_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_account_LDTS

    FROM backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_account AS sat_account_src
            ON a.H_ACCOUNT_SID = sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID
            AND sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_account AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b
    ON (1=1)
),

new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_account_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_account_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_account AS sat_account_src
            ON a.H_ACCOUNT_SID = sat_account_src.H_ACCOUNT_SID
            AND sat_account_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_ACCOUNT_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE
),

pit AS (
    SELECT * FROM new_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM overlap_pks
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM backfill
    
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM pit

model.cr_project.dvbridge_time_sheet.description:
# Model: dvbridge_time_sheet

## Business Purpose
Assembles Time Sheet business concept data, selecting only the latest record per timesheet at the point-in-time of the dbt run from the tlnk_time_sheet

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Sources data exclusively from the tlnk_time_sheet model.
- Uses window functions to select only the most recent record for each timesheet (partitioned by TIMESHEET_SID), based on EFFECTIVE_FROM or LOAD_DATE_TIME.
- Provides a deduplicated, up-to-date view of time sheet records for downstream consumption.

model.cr_project.bc_employee.name: bc_employee
model.cr_project.bc_employee.description:
# Model: bc_employee

## Business Purpose
Assembles the data for the Employee business concept at a Point In Time (PIT) of the DBT project, including all historical records.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Joins hub, satellites, and PIT tables to provide a complete Employee view.
- Retains all historical records for analysis.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Employee hub and satellite tables
- PIT tables

## Key Fields
- Employee ID
- All business attributes
- PIT timestamp

## Update Frequency
- Updated with each DBT project run.

## Additional Notes
- Used by downstream marts and reporting layers.

with

    ),
    pit as (
        select

    -- satellites
    sat_employee as (
        with

                select

                    -- payload
                    
                      
                        
        region_id,
        cost_center_id,

                from

            ,final as (  
                select

                from

            )

            select
                *
            from 
                final
    ),
    sat_employee_cost_centre_change as (
        with
            sat_employee_cost_centre_change_data as (  
                select 
                    H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
                    LOAD_DATE_TIME,
                    -- payload
                    
                      
                        
        prior_cost_centre,
        new_cost_centre,
        cost_centre_change_date
                    
                from

            )
            ,final as (  
                select 
                    *
                from

            )

            select

    sat_employee_manager as (
        with

                select 
                    H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
                    LOAD_DATE_TIME,
                    -- payload
                    
                      
                        
        manager
                    
                from 
                    datavault__raw.sat_employee_manager
            )
            ,final as (  
                select 
                    *
                from 
                    sat_employee_manager_data
            )

            select
                *
            from 
                final
    )
    ,get_sats as ( 
        select 
            hub.H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            hub.employee_bk,
            pit.as_of_date    
                
                
                ,
        region_id,
        cost_center_id,
        location,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        work_email,
        worker_type,
        worker_subtype,
        hire_date,

                ,

        cost_centre_change_date
                    
                
                
                ,
        manager
                  
            ,current_timestamp() as load_datetime
            ,hub.record_source    
        from
            hub
            join 
                pit 
                    on
                        hub.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = pit.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                -- satellites
                    left join
                        sat_employee
                            on
                                pit.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee.H_EMPLOYEE_SID and

model.cr_project.pit_employee_current.compiled_code:
with 
-- ##### generated_as_of_dates
    sat_employee_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_employee
    ),
    sat_employee_cost_centre_change_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_cost_centre_change
    ),
    sat_employee_manager_as_of_date as (
        select 
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME as as_of_date
        from 
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_manager
    ),
    union_sat_as_of_dates as (        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_employee_as_of_date
        union        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_employee_cost_centre_change_as_of_date
        union        
        select 
            * 
        from
            sat_employee_manager_as_of_date
        
    ),
    generated_as_of_dates as (
        select distinct *
        from union_sat_as_of_dates
    ),
-- ##### generated_as_of_dates 
    rows_as_of_dates as (
        select
            hub.H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            as_of_dates.as_of_date
        from
            datavault__raw.hub_employee hub
        left join
            generated_as_of_dates as_of_dates             
            on hub.H_EMPLOYEE_SID  = as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
          
    ),
    sat_employee_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_employee
    ),
    sat_employee_cost_centre_change_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_cost_centre_change
    ),
    sat_employee_manager_effective_dates AS (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            LOAD_DATE_TIME,
            CASE 
                WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME) = 1 
                THEN TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00')
                ELSE LOAD_DATE_TIME
            END AS effective_from,
            DATEADD(
            'millisecond', -1,
            LEAD(LOAD_DATE_TIME, 1, TO_TIMESTAMP('2999-01-01 00:00:01')) OVER (
                PARTITION BY H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                ORDER BY LOAD_DATE_TIME
            )
            ) AS effective_to
        FROM
            datavault__raw.sat_employee_manager
    ),          
    row_sats as (
        select
            rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date,
            -- ghost
            
    CAST(MD5_BINARY(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(CAST('ghost' AS VARCHAR))), '')) AS BINARY(16)) AS hk_ghost,
            cast('1900-01-01 00:00:00' as timestamp) as early_date,
            sat_employee_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID as sat_employee_pk,
            sat_employee_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_employee_ldts,
            sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_pk,
            sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_ldts,
            sat_employee_manager_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID as sat_employee_manager_pk,
            sat_employee_manager_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME as sat_employee_manager_ldts  
        from
            rows_as_of_dates
            left join
                 sat_employee_effective_dates as sat_employee_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_employee_src.effective_from
                    and sat_employee_src.effective_to
            left join
                 sat_employee_cost_centre_change_effective_dates as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.effective_from
                    and sat_employee_cost_centre_change_src.effective_to
            left join
                 sat_employee_manager_effective_dates as sat_employee_manager_src
                on rows_as_of_dates.H_EMPLOYEE_SID = sat_employee_manager_src.H_EMPLOYEE_SID
                and rows_as_of_dates.as_of_date between sat_employee_manager_src.effective_from
                    and sat_employee_manager_src.effective_to       

    ),
    final as (
        select
            H_EMPLOYEE_SID,
            coalesce(as_of_date, early_date) as as_of_date, 
            'Workday' as record_source,            
                coalesce(sat_employee_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_employee_pk,
                coalesce(sat_employee_ldts, early_date) as sat_employee_ldts,            
                coalesce(sat_employee_cost_centre_change_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_pk,
                coalesce(sat_employee_cost_centre_change_ldts, early_date) as sat_employee_cost_centre_change_ldts,            
                coalesce(sat_employee_manager_pk , hk_ghost) as sat_employee_manager_pk,
                coalesce(sat_employee_manager_ldts, early_date) as sat_employee_manager_ldts    
        from
            row_sats 
    )    
select
    *
from
    final

-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_exchange_rates

WITH as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT * FROM datavault__business.pit_as_at_current_date
),

last_safe_load_datetime AS (
    SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_exchange_rates
            
        ) AS l
),

as_of_grain_old_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_exchange_rates_current
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_exchange_rates AS h

    
    WHERE h.LOAD_DATE_TIME >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_exchange_rates_current AS a
    INNER JOIN datavault__raw.hub_exchange_rates as b
        ON a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID = b.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM new_rows_pks AS a
    INNER JOIN backfill_as_of AS b
        ON (1=1)
),

backfill AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_exchange_rates_src.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_exchange_rates_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_exchange_rates_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_exchange_rates_LDTS

    FROM backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_exchange_rates AS sat_exchange_rates_src
            ON a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID = sat_exchange_rates_src.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID
            AND sat_exchange_rates_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_exchange_rates AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b
    ON (1=1)
),

new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_exchange_rates_src.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_exchange_rates_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_exchange_rates_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_exchange_rates_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_exchange_rates AS sat_exchange_rates_src
            ON a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID = sat_exchange_rates_src.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID
            AND sat_exchange_rates_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_EXCHANGE_RATES_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE
),

pit AS (
    SELECT * FROM new_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM overlap_pks
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM backfill
    
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM pit

model.cr_project.bc_forecast_booking.description:
# Model: bc_forecast_booking

## Business Purpose
This business concept model provides a historical view of project forecast bookings with effective date ranges. It tracks resource allocations, forecasted hours, and billing rates over time, enabling analysis of project staffing and cost projections.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Deduplicates records using `ROW_NUMBER()` partitioned by `resource_forecast_bk` and `cost_rate_as_of`, keeping the latest load per effective date
- Calculates `effective_to` dates using `LEAD()` window function to create non-overlapping time ranges
- Identifies the latest deletion date per `resource_forecast_sid` using `ROW_NUMBER()` with `QUALIFY`
- Excludes all deleted records (`is_deleted = 'True'`) and their history up to and including the deletion date
- Includes recreated forecast lines: if a forecast with the same resource forecast line key is recreated after deletion, records with `effective_from` dates after the deletion date will be included

## Sources & Dependencies
- `tlnk_forecast_booking`: Transaction link containing forecast booking records with historical tracking and deletion flags

## Key Fields
- `tlnk_forecast_booking_sid`: Surrogate key for the forecast booking link
- `resource_forecast_sid`: Surrogate key for the resource forecast
- `resource_forecast_bk`: Business key for the resource forecast
- `effective_from`: Start of the validity period for this record
- `effective_to`: End of the validity period for this record (exclusive)
- `forecasted_hours`: Projected hours for the resource allocation
- `project_role_cost_rate`: Cost rate for the project role
- `contract_billing_rate`: Billing rate as per contract
- `is_deleted`: Indicates if the record has been deleted

## Update Frequency
This view is refreshed based on the underlying `tlnk_forecast_booking` table update schedule.

## Additional Notes
- Uses `mutually_exclusive_ranges` test to ensure no overlapping effective date ranges per resource forecast
- The high date default is controlled by the dbt variable `high_date`
- Custom test `record_after_deletion_check` in file `test/generic/bc_forecast_booking_records_after_deletion` validates that deletion logic correctly includes the records that is being recreated after deletion

WITH as_of_dates AS (

    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv__forecasted_hours

    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_forecasted_hours__current
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_forecasted_hours AS h

    
    WHERE h.LOAD_DATE_TIME >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_forecasted_hours__current AS a
    INNER JOIN datavault__raw.hub_forecasted_hours as b
        ON a.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID = b.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

            ON a.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID = sat_forecasted_hours_src.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID
            AND sat_forecasted_hours_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_forecasted_hours AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b

),

                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_forecasted_hours_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_forecasted_hours_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_forecasted_hours_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

            ON a.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID = sat_forecasted_hours_src.H_FORECASTED_HOURS_SID

-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_journal_lines

WITH as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT * FROM datavault__business.pit_as_at_current_date
),

last_safe_load_datetime AS (
    SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_journal_lines
            
        ) AS l
),

as_of_grain_old_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_journal_lines_current
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_journal_lines AS h

    
    WHERE h.LOAD_DATE_TIME >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_journal_lines_current AS a
    INNER JOIN datavault__raw.hub_journal_lines as b
        ON a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID = b.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM new_rows_pks AS a
    INNER JOIN backfill_as_of AS b
        ON (1=1)
),

backfill AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_journal_lines_src.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_journal_lines_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_journal_lines_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_journal_lines_LDTS

    FROM backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_journal_lines AS sat_journal_lines_src
            ON a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID = sat_journal_lines_src.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID
            AND sat_journal_lines_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_journal_lines AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b
    ON (1=1)
),

new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_journal_lines_src.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_journal_lines_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_journal_lines_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_journal_lines_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_journal_lines AS sat_journal_lines_src
            ON a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID = sat_journal_lines_src.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID
            AND sat_journal_lines_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_JOURNAL_LINE_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE
),

pit AS (
    SELECT * FROM new_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM overlap_pks
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM backfill
    
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM pit
