model.cr_project.ens_opportunity_and_his.name: ens_opportunity_and_history
model.cr_project.ens_opportunity_and_his.description:
# Business Purpose
Enterprise view combining current opportunity data with historical changes for time-based analysis.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Calculates effective_to using LEAD window function partitioned by h_opportunity_sid.
- Most recent history record defaults effective_to to high_date.
- Coalesces historical with current data when history unavailable.

## Sources & Dependencies
- bc_opportunity, bc_opportunity_history
- dvbridge_opportunity, dvbridge_opportunity_history, dvbridge_opportunity_project

## Key Fields
- opportunity_bk, opportunity_history_bk
- effective_from, effective_to (calculated via LEAD)
- amount, stage_bk (from history or current)

## Update Frequency
- As per dbt run (materialized as table).

## Additional Notes
- Effective dates form mutually exclusive ranges per opportunity_bk.
- Left join ensures all opportunities appear even without history.
model.cr_project.ens_opportunity_and_his.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table'
) }}

with 
    salesforce_opportunity as (
        select
            bc_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid,
            bc_opportunity.opportunity_bk,
            bc_opportunity.start_date,
            bc_opportunity.end_date,
            bc_opportunity.closed_date,
            bc_opportunity.lastmodifieddate,
            bc_opportunity.next_step,
            bc_opportunity.forecast_category,
            bc_opportunity.forecast_category_name,
            bc_opportunity.is_closed,
            bc_opportunity.is_won,
            bc_opportunity.sow_value        as amount,
            bc_opportunity.business_unit,
            bc_opportunity.pricing_structure,
            bc_opportunity.third_party_product,
            bc_opportunity.service_offering,
            bc_opportunity.type,
            bc_opportunity.is_deleted,
            bc_opportunity.record_source,
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity.region_bk,'ghost')                  as region_bk,
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity.stage_bk,'ghost')                   as stage_bk,            
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity.client_bk,'ghost')                  as client_bk,
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity.practice_bk,'ghost')                as practice_bk,
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity.client_account_director_bk,'ghost') as client_account_director_bk,
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity.cost_center_bk,'ghost')             as cost_center_bk,
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity.revenue_category_bk,'ghost')        as revenue_category_bk,
            ifnull(dvbridge_opportunity_project.project_bk,'ghost')         as project_bk
        from
            {{ref('bc_opportunity')}}
        join
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity')}}
                on bc_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid = dvbridge_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid
        left join
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity_project')}}
                on bc_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid = dvbridge_opportunity_project.h_opportunity_sid
    ),
    opportunity_history_raw as (
        select
            dvbridge_opportunity_history.h_opportunity_sid,
            dvbridge_opportunity_history.stage_bk,
            ifnull(bc_opportunity_history.opportunity_history_bk,'ghost')   as opportunity_history_bk,
            bc_opportunity_history.amount,
            bc_opportunity_history.created_date,
            bc_opportunity_history.effective_from,
            bc_opportunity_history.record_source
        from
            {{ref('bc_opportunity_history')}}
        join
            {{ref('dvbridge_opportunity_history')}}
                on bc_opportunity_history.h_opportunity_history_sid = dvbridge_opportunity_history.h_opportunity_history_sid
    ),
    opportunity_history as (
        select
            h_opportunity_sid,
            stage_bk,
            opportunity_history_bk,
            amount,
            created_date,
            effective_from,
            -- Subtract 1 nanosecond from the next record's effective_from to create a non-overlapping,
            -- mutually exclusive effective_to range for each h_opportunity_sid.
            coalesce(
                dateadd(
                    nanosecond, -1,
                    lead(effective_from) over (
                        partition by h_opportunity_sid
                        order by effective_from
                    )
            ), '{{var('high_date')}}') as effective_to, -- end date (e.g. 2900-12-31 00:00:00) when no later effective_from exists
            record_source
        from
            opportunity_history_raw
    ),
    final as (
        select
        -- when
            salesforce_opportunity.start_date,
            salesforce_opportunity.end_date,
            salesforce_opportunity.closed_date,
            salesforce_opportunity.lastmodifieddate     as last_modified_date,
        -- where
            salesforce_opportunity.region_bk,
        -- how
            salesforce_opportunity.is_deleted,
            coalesce(
                opportunity_history.stage_bk,
                salesforce_opportunity.stage_bk
            )                                           as stage_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.next_step,
            salesforce_opportunity.forecast_category,
            salesforce_opportunity.forecast_category_name,
            salesforce_opportunity.is_closed,
            salesforce_opportunity.is_won,
        -- how much
            coalesce(
                opportunity_history.amount,
                salesforce_opportunity.amount
            )                                           as amount,
        -- who
            salesforce_opportunity.client_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.practice_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.client_account_director_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.cost_center_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.business_unit, 
            salesforce_opportunity.pricing_structure,
            salesforce_opportunity.third_party_product,                                        
        -- what
            salesforce_opportunity.opportunity_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.revenue_category_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.service_offering,
            opportunity_history.opportunity_history_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.project_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity.type,            
        -- audit
            coalesce(
                opportunity_history.effective_from,
                to_date('{{var('low_date')}}')
            )                                               as effective_from,
            coalesce(
                opportunity_history.effective_to,
                to_date('{{var('high_date')}}')
            )                                               as effective_to,
            coalesce(
                opportunity_history.record_source,
                salesforce_opportunity.record_source
            )                                               as record_source,
            current_timestamp                               as load_date_time

        from
            salesforce_opportunity
        left join
            opportunity_history
                on salesforce_opportunity.h_opportunity_sid = opportunity_history.h_opportunity_sid
    )
select 
    * 
from 
    final

model.cr_project.ens_opportunity_daily_a.raw_code:
with 
    salesforce_opportunity_and_history as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            opportunity_history_bk,
            project_bk,
            client_bk,
            practice_bk,
            client_account_director_bk,
            stage_bk,
            coalesce(stg_manual__business_unit_cost_center_mapping.cost_center,
                        ens_opportunity_and_history.cost_center_bk)     as cost_center_bk,
            revenue_category_bk,            
            start_date,
            end_date,
            closed_date,
            last_modified_date,
            region_bk,
            is_deleted,
            next_step,
            forecast_category,
            forecast_category_name,
            is_closed,
            is_won,
            amount,
            ens_opportunity_and_history.business_unit,
            ens_opportunity_and_history.service_offering,
            pricing_structure,
            third_party_product,
            type,
            effective_from,
            effective_to,
            ens_opportunity_and_history.record_source,
            ens_opportunity_and_history.load_date_time    
        from
            {{ref('ens_opportunity_and_history')}}
        left join
            {{ref('stg_manual__business_unit_cost_center_mapping')}}
            on ens_opportunity_and_history.business_unit = stg_manual__business_unit_cost_center_mapping.business_unit
                and ens_opportunity_and_history.service_offering = stg_manual__business_unit_cost_center_mapping.service_offering
    ),
    weekday_dates as (
        select
            date_bk
        from
            {{ref('ref_calendar_dates')}}
        where
            is_weekday
    ),
    --create a calendar of dates from the beginning to the end of a project
    opportunity_date_cross_apply as (
        select
            salesforce_opportunity_and_history.*,
            weekday_dates.date_bk      as date_bk
        from
            salesforce_opportunity_and_history
        join
            weekday_dates
            on weekday_dates.date_bk between
                salesforce_opportunity_and_history.start_date and
                salesforce_opportunity_and_history.end_date
    ),
    -- get exchange rate based on region
    region_exchange_rate as (
        select
            bc_region.region_bk,
            bc_region.currency,
            bc_exchange_rates.source_currency,
            bc_exchange_rates.target_currency,
            bc_exchange_rates.currency_rate,
            bc_exchange_rates.effective_from,
            bc_exchange_rates.effective_to
        from 
            {{ref('bc_region')}}
        join 
            {{ref('bc_exchange_rates')}}
            on bc_region.currency = bc_exchange_rates.source_currency
        where
            -- This forces the conversion to be 1 FOR 1 IN ALL other regions, AT this s point USD opportunites
            -- are entered after the applying exchange rate
            bc_exchange_rates.target_currency = 'AUD'
            and bc_exchange_rates.source_currency = 'SGD'
            and bc_exchange_rates.currency_rate_type = 'Current'     
    ),
    --get opportunity's exchange rate based on region
    opportunity_exchange_rate as (
        select
            opportunity_date_cross_apply.*,
            region_exchange_rate.source_currency,
            region_exchange_rate.effective_from             as exchange_rate_effective_from,
            region_exchange_rate.effective_to               as exchange_rate_effective_to,
            coalesce(region_exchange_rate.currency_rate,1)  as exchange_rate
        from
            opportunity_date_cross_apply
        left join
            region_exchange_rate
            on opportunity_date_cross_apply.region_bk = region_exchange_rate.region_bk
            and opportunity_date_cross_apply.date_bk between region_exchange_rate.effective_from and region_exchange_rate.effective_to
    ),
    number_of_working_days as (
        select
            opportunity_bk,
            count(distinct date_bk) as number_of_working_days
        from opportunity_exchange_rate
        group by
            opportunity_bk
    ),
    -- add calculation for opportunity daily amount
    final as (
        select
            opportunity_exchange_rate.opportunity_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.opportunity_history_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.project_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.client_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.practice_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.client_account_director_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.stage_bk,        
            opportunity_exchange_rate.cost_center_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.revenue_category_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.date_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.start_date,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.end_date,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.closed_date,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.last_modified_date,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.region_bk,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.is_deleted,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.next_step,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.forecast_category,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.forecast_category_name,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.is_closed,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.is_won,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.amount,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.business_unit,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.service_offering,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.pricing_structure,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.third_party_product,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.type,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.effective_from,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.effective_to,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.record_source,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.load_date_time,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.source_currency,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.exchange_rate_effective_from,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.exchange_rate_effective_to,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.exchange_rate,
            number_of_working_days.number_of_working_days,
            opportunity_exchange_rate.amount / number_of_working_days.number_of_working_days as daily_amount
        from 
            opportunity_exchange_rate
        inner join
            number_of_working_days
            on number_of_working_days.opportunity_bk = opportunity_exchange_rate.opportunity_bk    
    )
select 
    * 
from 
    final

with 
    hub as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('hub_project')}}
    ),
    pit as (
        select 
            * 
        from
            {{ ref('pit_project_current') }}
    ),
    sat_project_salesforce as (

            *
        from
            {{ ref('sat_project_salesforce')}}
    ),
    sat_project_workday as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('sat_project_workday')}}
    ),

        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('sat_project_workday_deal_value')}}
    ),
    sat_project_activity_dates as (
        select
            *
        from
            {{ ref('sat_project_activity_dates')}}
    ),
    final as (
        select
            hub.h_project_sid,
            hub.h_project_sid as dim_project_sid,
            hub.project_bk,
            coalesce(
                sat_project_salesforce.project_name,
                sat_project_workday.project_name,
                'ghost'
            )                                                       as project_name,
            coalesce(
                sat_project_salesforce.project_description,
                sat_project_workday.project_description,
                'ghost'
            )                                                       as project_description,
            sat_project_workday.project_owner                       as project_owner,
            sat_project_workday.project_state                       as project_state,
            sat_project_workday.primary_project_hierarchy           as primary_project_hierarchy,
            sat_project_workday.start_date                          as start_date,
            sat_project_workday.end_date                            as end_date,
            sat_project_workday.practice_name                       as practice_name,
            sat_project_workday.project_region                      as project_region,
            sat_project_workday.cost_center                         as cost_center,
            IFNULL(sat_project_workday.company, 'ghost')            as company,
            IFNULL(sat_project_workday_deal_value.deal_value, 0)    as deal_value,
            sat_project_activity_dates.activity_start_month         as activity_start_month,
            sat_project_activity_dates.activity_end_month           as activity_end_month,
            sat_project_workday.po_number,
            IFNULL(sat_project_salesforce.discount, sat_project_workday.discount)                       as discount,
            IFNULL(sat_project_salesforce.profitability, sat_project_workday.target_profitability)      as target_profitability,  
            sat_project_workday.project_groups                      as project_groups,
            case
                when sat_project_workday.primary_project_hierarchy ilike '%Internal%' then 'INTERNAL'
                when left(
                    coalesce(
                        sat_project_salesforce.project_name,
                        sat_project_workday.project_name
                    ), 4
                ) = 'VER-'                                          then 'INTERNAL'
                else 'EXTERNAL'
            end                                              as project_type,
            -- audit
            coalesce(
                sat_project_salesforce.record_source,
                sat_project_workday.record_source,
                sat_project_workday_deal_value.record_source,
                hub.record_source
            )                                                       as record_source,
            current_timestamp()                                     as load_date_time
        from
            hub
            join
                pit
                    on
                        hub.h_project_sid = pit.h_project_sid
                left join
                    sat_project_salesforce 
                        on 
                            pit.h_project_sid = sat_project_salesforce.h_project_sid and
                            pit.sat_project_salesforce_ldts = sat_project_salesforce.load_date_time
                left join
                    sat_project_workday 
                        on 
                            pit.h_project_sid = sat_project_workday.h_project_sid and
                            pit.sat_project_workday_ldts = sat_project_workday.load_date_time
                left join
                    sat_project_workday_deal_value 
                        on 
                            pit.h_project_sid = sat_project_workday_deal_value.h_project_sid and
                            pit.sat_project_workday_deal_value_ldts = sat_project_workday_deal_value.load_date_time
                left join
                    sat_project_activity_dates 
                        on 
                            pit.h_project_sid = sat_project_activity_dates.h_project_sid and
                            pit.sat_project_activity_dates_ldts = sat_project_activity_dates.load_date_time
    )
select 
    * 
from 
    final

model.cr_project.bc_project_cost_rate.description:
# Model: bc_project_cost_rate

## Business Purpose
Assembles Project Cost Rate business concept data at PIT of dbt run with overlap resolution applied.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Sources data from staging layer (`stg_workday__project_cost_rate_versent_pty_ltd`)
- Generates surrogate keys for Project Cost Rate hub
- **Resolves overlapping periods** for the same project, employee, and role combination:
  - Detects overlaps by comparing consecutive period end dates with start dates
  - Groups overlapping periods together using running sum logic
  - Collapses overlapping periods by applying business rules:
    - **Start Date**: Earliest start date in overlap group
    - **End Date**: Latest end date in overlap group
    - **Cost Rate**: Lowest cost rate in overlap group
    - **Currency & Source**: First values in overlap group
    - **Load DateTime**: Most recent load time in overlap group
- Returns clean, non-overlapping Project Cost Rate records

## Usage
This model is used by:
- `int_fact_time_sheet_bks`
model.cr_project.bc_project_cost_rate.raw_code:
with
    tlnk as (
        select
            *
        from {{ ref('tlnk_project_cost_rate')}}
    ),
    -- Calculate running maximum end_date to detect all overlap patterns
    with_running_max as (
        select
            tlnk.*,
            max(tlnk.end_date) over (
                partition by tlnk.project_bk, tlnk.employee_bk, tlnk.project_role_bk
                order by tlnk.start_date, tlnk.end_date
                rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding
            ) as max_end_date_so_far
        from tlnk 
    ),

    -- Create groups of overlapping periods using running sum
    -- A new group starts when current start_date is after the running max end_date
    overlap_groups as (
        select
            with_running_max.*,
            sum(
                case
                    when with_running_max.max_end_date_so_far is null  -- First row in partition
                        then 1
                    when with_running_max.start_date > with_running_max.max_end_date_so_far  -- Gap detected
                        then 1
                    else 0  -- Overlap with previous periods
                end
            ) over (
                partition by with_running_max.project_bk, with_running_max.employee_bk, with_running_max.project_role_bk
                order by with_running_max.start_date, with_running_max.end_date
                rows between unbounded preceding and current row
            ) as overlap_group_id
        from with_running_max
    ),

    -- Collapse overlapping periods within each group
    -- Identifiers from row with earliest start_date (for consistency)
    final as (
        select
            project_bk,
            employee_bk,
            project_role_bk,
            overlap_group_id,
            
            -- Aggregated business values 
            min(start_date) as start_date,                          -- Earliest start
            max(end_date) as end_date,                              -- Latest end
            min(cost_rate) as cost_rate,                            -- Lowest rate
            
            -- Identifiers from the row with minimum start_date (for consistency)
            min_by(tlnk_project_cost_rate_sid,start_date) as tlnk_project_cost_rate_sid,
            min_by(project_cost_rate_sid, start_date) as project_cost_rate_sid,
            min_by(project_cost_rate_bk, start_date) as project_cost_rate_bk,
            min_by(cost_rate_currency, start_date) as cost_rate_currency,
            min_by(record_source, start_date) as record_source,
            
            -- Most recent load time
            max(load_date_time) as load_date_time
        from overlap_groups
        group by project_bk, employee_bk, project_role_bk, overlap_group_id
    )

select 
    tlnk_project_cost_rate_sid,
    project_cost_rate_sid, 
    project_cost_rate_bk, 
    project_bk, 
    employee_bk, 
    project_role_bk, 
    start_date, 
    end_date, 
    cost_rate, 
    cost_rate_currency, 
    record_source, 
    load_date_time
from final

-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_project_revenue

WITH as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT * FROM datavault__business.pit_as_at_current_date
),

last_safe_load_datetime AS (
    SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_project_revenue
            
        ) AS l
),

as_of_grain_old_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_project_revenue_current
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.h_project_revenue_sid
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_project_revenue AS h

    
    WHERE h.load_date_time >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_project_revenue_current AS a
    INNER JOIN datavault__raw.hub_project_revenue as b
        ON a.h_project_revenue_sid = b.h_project_revenue_sid
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.h_project_revenue_sid,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM new_rows_pks AS a
    INNER JOIN backfill_as_of AS b
        ON (1=1)
),

backfill AS (
    SELECT
        a.h_project_revenue_sid,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_project_revenue_src.h_project_revenue_sid),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_project_revenue_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_project_revenue_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_project_revenue_LDTS

    FROM backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_project_revenue AS sat_project_revenue_src
            ON a.h_project_revenue_sid = sat_project_revenue_src.h_project_revenue_sid
            AND sat_project_revenue_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.h_project_revenue_sid, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.h_project_revenue_sid,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_project_revenue AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b
    ON (1=1)
),

new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        a.h_project_revenue_sid,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_project_revenue_src.h_project_revenue_sid),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_project_revenue_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_project_revenue_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_project_revenue_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_project_revenue AS sat_project_revenue_src
            ON a.h_project_revenue_sid = sat_project_revenue_src.h_project_revenue_sid
            AND sat_project_revenue_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.h_project_revenue_sid,
        a.AS_OF_DATE
),

pit AS (
    SELECT * FROM new_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM overlap_pks
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM backfill
    
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM pit

    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_stage_salesforce
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_stage_other
        -- depends_on: datavault__raw_int.int_dv_stage_sort_order

WITH as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT * FROM datavault__business.pit_as_at_current_date
),

last_safe_load_datetime AS (
    SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATETIME) AS LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME
    FROM (

        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_stage_salesforce
             UNION ALL 
        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_stage_other
             UNION ALL 
        SELECT MIN(LOAD_DATE_TIME) AS LOAD_DATETIME FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_stage_sort_order
            
        ) AS l
),

as_of_grain_old_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_stage
),

as_of_grain_lost_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_old_entries AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_dates AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

as_of_grain_new_entries AS (
    SELECT a.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    LEFT OUTER JOIN as_of_grain_old_entries AS b
        ON a.AS_OF_DATE = b.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE b.AS_OF_DATE IS NULL
),

min_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(AS_OF_DATE) AS MIN_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates
),

backfill_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a

    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_pks AS (
    SELECT h.H_STAGE_SID
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_stage AS h

    
    WHERE h.LOAD_DATE_TIME >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
),

new_rows_as_of AS (
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS a
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
    UNION
    SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_grain_new_entries
),

overlap_pks AS (
    SELECT a.*
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__business.pit_stage AS a
    INNER JOIN datavault__raw.hub_stage as b
        ON a.H_STAGE_SID = b.H_STAGE_SID
    
    WHERE a.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND a.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
),

overlap_as_of AS (
    SELECT p.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM as_of_dates AS p
    
    WHERE p.AS_OF_DATE >= (SELECT MIN_DATE FROM min_date)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE < (SELECT LAST_SAFE_LOAD_DATETIME FROM last_safe_load_datetime)
        AND p.AS_OF_DATE NOT IN (SELECT AS_OF_DATE FROM as_of_grain_lost_entries)
    
),

backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_STAGE_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM new_rows_pks AS a
    INNER JOIN backfill_as_of AS b
        ON (1=1)
),

backfill AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_STAGE_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_salesforce_src.H_STAGE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_stage_salesforce_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_salesforce_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_stage_salesforce_LDTS,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_other_src.H_STAGE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_stage_other_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_other_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_stage_other_LDTS,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_sort_order_src.H_STAGE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_stage_sort_order_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_sort_order_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_stage_sort_order_LDTS

    FROM backfill_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_stage_salesforce AS sat_stage_salesforce_src
            ON a.H_STAGE_SID = sat_stage_salesforce_src.H_STAGE_SID
            AND sat_stage_salesforce_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_stage_other AS sat_stage_other_src
            ON a.H_STAGE_SID = sat_stage_other_src.H_STAGE_SID
            AND sat_stage_other_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_stage_sort_order AS sat_stage_sort_order_src
            ON a.H_STAGE_SID = sat_stage_sort_order_src.H_STAGE_SID
            AND sat_stage_sort_order_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_STAGE_SID, a.AS_OF_DATE
),

new_rows_as_of_dates AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_STAGE_SID,
        b.AS_OF_DATE
    FROM datavault__raw.hub_stage AS a
    INNER JOIN new_rows_as_of AS b
    ON (1=1)
),

new_rows AS (
    SELECT
        a.H_STAGE_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_salesforce_src.H_STAGE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_stage_salesforce_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_salesforce_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_stage_salesforce_LDTS,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_other_src.H_STAGE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_stage_other_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_other_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_stage_other_LDTS,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_sort_order_src.H_STAGE_SID),
                 CAST('0000000000000000' AS BINARY(16)))
        AS sat_stage_sort_order_PK,

        COALESCE(MAX(sat_stage_sort_order_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME),
                 TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'))
        AS sat_stage_sort_order_LDTS

    FROM new_rows_as_of_dates AS a

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_stage_salesforce AS sat_stage_salesforce_src
            ON a.H_STAGE_SID = sat_stage_salesforce_src.H_STAGE_SID
            AND sat_stage_salesforce_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_stage_other AS sat_stage_other_src
            ON a.H_STAGE_SID = sat_stage_other_src.H_STAGE_SID
            AND sat_stage_other_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

        LEFT OUTER JOIN datavault__raw.sat_stage_sort_order AS sat_stage_sort_order_src
            ON a.H_STAGE_SID = sat_stage_sort_order_src.H_STAGE_SID
            AND sat_stage_sort_order_src.LOAD_DATE_TIME <= a.AS_OF_DATE
    

    GROUP BY
        a.H_STAGE_SID,
        a.AS_OF_DATE
),

pit AS (
    SELECT * FROM new_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM overlap_pks
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM backfill
    
)

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM pit

model.cr_project.bc_standard_cost_rate.name: bc_standard_cost_rate
model.cr_project.bc_standard_cost_rate.description:
# Model: bc_standard_cost_rate

## Business Purpose
This model provides a business core view of standard cost rates, including the effective date ranges for each project role and currency. It enables accurate historical tracking and reporting of cost rate changes.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Calculates the `effective_to` date for each cost rate record based on the next available `effective_from` date for the same project_role_bk and currency.
- Uses window functions to determine the end date of each rate period.
- Ensures that the last record for each group has a high date (`9999-12-31`) as its `effective_to`.
- Sources only the latest, non-deleted records.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Depends on the `tlnk_standard_cost_rate` model for input data.
- Upstream source: `stg_workday__standard_cost_rate`.

## Key Fields
- `project_role_bk`: Identifier for the project role.
- `currency`: Currency of the cost rate.
- `effective_from`: Start date of the cost rate period.
- `effective_to`: End date of the cost rate period.
- `standard_cost_rate`: The cost rate value.
- `record_source`: Source system for the record.
- `load_date_time`: Timestamp when the record was loaded.
model.cr_project.bc_standard_cost_rate.raw_code:
with src as (
    select
        tlnk_standard_cost_rate_sid,
        h_standard_cost_rate_sid, 
        standard_cost_rate_bk, 
        currency,
        project_role_bk,
        effective_from, 
        standard_cost_rate,
        record_source,
        load_date_time
    from {{ ref('tlnk_standard_cost_rate') }}
),

final as (
    select
        tlnk_standard_cost_rate_sid,
        h_standard_cost_rate_sid, 
        standard_cost_rate_bk, 
        currency,
        project_role_bk,
        effective_from,
        coalesce(
            dateadd(
                nanosecond, -1,
                lead(effective_from) over (
                    partition by project_role_bk, currency
                    order by effective_from, load_date_time
                )
            ), '{{var('high_date')}}') as effective_to,
        standard_cost_rate,
        record_source,
        load_date_time
    from src
)

select *
from final

# Model: hub_absence_type

## Business Purpose
Datavault hub containing all Business Keys and their hashed SIDs for the Absence Type Business Object. Serves as the primary key anchor for all absence type data in the data vault.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Stores one record per unique absence type Business Key (`ABSENCE_TYPE_BK`).
- Incremental model: once an absence type is loaded, it is never removed.
- Descriptive attributes are stored in corresponding satellites.

## Sources & Dependencies
- **Source:** Workday
- Depends on: `int_dv_absence_type` (unions Leave of Absence and Time Off types)

## Key Fields
- `h_absence_type_sid` — hashed surrogate key derived from `ABSENCE_TYPE_BK`
- `absence_type_bk` — natural Business Key from Workday (Leave Type ID or Time Off ID)

## Update Frequency
- Updated with each dbt job run as new absence types are added in Workday.

## Additional Notes
- Data covers every Absence Type found in the Workday Leave of Absence and Time Off reports.
- See `sat_absence_type` for descriptive attributes.

# Model: sat_absence_type

## Business Purpose
Datavault satellite containing descriptive attributes for all Absence Types sourced from Workday. Tracks the full history of changes to absence type attributes over time.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Linked to `hub_absence_type` via `h_absence_type_sid`.
- Incremental model: new records are inserted when any payload attribute changes (detected via `ABSENCE_TYPE_HASHDIFF`).

## Sources & Dependencies
- **Source:** Workday
- Depends on: `int_dv_absence_type`
- Related hub: `hub_absence_type`

## Key Fields
- `h_absence_type_sid` — foreign key to `hub_absence_type`
- `absence_name` — display name of the absence type
- `absence_type` — classification (e.g. Leave Of Absence, Time Off)
- `absence_type_group` — grouping category from Workday

## Update Frequency
- Updated with each dbt job run when absence type attributes change in Workday.

## Additional Notes
- Use `pit_absence_type` to retrieve only the most recent record per absence type.

# Model: sat_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours

## Business Purpose
Datavault satellite containing the controlled list of absence types that are deductible from supply hours. Loaded from a manually maintained seed file, this satellite provides the definitive mapping used to determine whether an employee absence should reduce supply hours in downstream calculations.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Linked to `hub_absence_type` via `h_absence_type_sid`.
- Incremental model: new records are inserted when the payload changes (detected via `ABSENCE_TYPE_DEDUCTIBLE_SUPPLY_HOURS_HASHDIFF`).
- Only absence types that appear in this satellite are considered deductible from supply hours.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Depends on: `int_dv_absence_type_deductible_supply_hours`
- Related hub: `hub_absence_type`
- Seed file: `data/landing_manual/absence_type_deductible_supply_hours.csv`

## Key Fields
- `h_absence_type_sid` — foreign key to `hub_absence_type`
- `absence_name` — display name of the deductible absence type as it appears in Workday
- `absence_type_deductible_supply_hours_hashdiff` — change detection hash over the payload

## Update Frequency
- Updated manually when deductible absence types are added or changed in Workday.

## Additional Notes
- Used downstream by `bc_absence_type` to populate `is_deductible_from_supply_hours` and `deductible_from_supply_hours`.
- See `dim_absence_type` for the gold layer representation.

with

    with

                    p0.generated_number * power(2, 0)
                     +

    select *

        ),

    select

),
        dates_with_prior_year_dates as (

                cast(d.date_day as date) as date_day,

        )

 as date

 as date) as iso_week_end_date,

    dateadd(

 as date)

 as date)),

                '-W',
                lpad(concat('', cast(date_part('weekiso', d.date_day) as integer)), 2, '0')
            )
    end as iso_year_week,

        cast(date_part('week', d.prior_year_over_year_date_day) as integer)
        as prior_year_week_of_year,
        cast(date_part('weekiso', d.prior_year_over_year_date_day) as integer)
        as prior_year_iso_week_of_year,

            date_part('month', d.date_day) as integer

-- Generated by AutomateDV (formerly known as dbtvault)

    

WITH source_data AS (
    SELECT a.H_CLIENT_SID, a.CLIENT_HASHDIFF, a.CLIENT_NAME, a.INDUSTRY, a.SECTOR, a.LOAD_DATE_TIME, a.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM datavault__raw_int.int_dv_client AS a
    WHERE a.H_CLIENT_SID IS NOT NULL
),

latest_records AS (
    SELECT current_records.H_CLIENT_SID, current_records.CLIENT_HASHDIFF, current_records.CLIENT_NAME, current_records.INDUSTRY, current_records.SECTOR, current_records.LOAD_DATE_TIME, current_records.RECORD_SOURCE,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY current_records.H_CLIENT_SID
           ORDER BY current_records.LOAD_DATE_TIME DESC
        ) AS rank_num
    FROM REPORTING_ANALYTICS.datavault__raw.sat_client AS current_records
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT source_data.H_CLIENT_SID
        FROM source_data
    ) AS source_records
        ON source_records.H_CLIENT_SID = current_records.H_CLIENT_SID
    QUALIFY rank_num = 1
),

first_record_in_set AS (
    SELECT
    sd.H_CLIENT_SID, sd.CLIENT_HASHDIFF, sd.CLIENT_NAME, sd.INDUSTRY, sd.SECTOR, sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME, sd.RECORD_SOURCE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sd.H_CLIENT_SID
            ORDER BY sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME ASC
    ) AS asc_rank
    FROM source_data AS sd
    QUALIFY asc_rank = 1
),

unique_source_records AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        sd.H_CLIENT_SID, sd.CLIENT_HASHDIFF, sd.CLIENT_NAME, sd.INDUSTRY, sd.SECTOR, sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME, sd.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM source_data AS sd
    QUALIFY sd.CLIENT_HASHDIFF != LAG(sd.CLIENT_HASHDIFF) OVER (
        PARTITION BY sd.H_CLIENT_SID
        ORDER BY sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME ASC
    )
),

records_to_insert AS (
    SELECT frin.H_CLIENT_SID, frin.CLIENT_HASHDIFF, frin.CLIENT_NAME, frin.INDUSTRY, frin.SECTOR, frin.LOAD_DATE_TIME, frin.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM first_record_in_set AS frin
    LEFT JOIN latest_records lr
        ON lr.H_CLIENT_SID = frin.H_CLIENT_SID
        AND lr.CLIENT_HASHDIFF = frin.CLIENT_HASHDIFF
        WHERE lr.CLIENT_HASHDIFF IS NULL
    UNION
    SELECT usr.H_CLIENT_SID, usr.CLIENT_HASHDIFF, usr.CLIENT_NAME, usr.INDUSTRY, usr.SECTOR, usr.LOAD_DATE_TIME, usr.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM unique_source_records AS usr
)

with journal_line as (

        journal_bk,
        journal as journal_name
    from {{ ref('stg_workday__journal_lines') }}

    select distinct
        journal_bk,
        journal_name
    from {{ ref('stg_workday__project_revenue') }}
),

unioned as (
    select
        journal_bk,
        journal_name,
        'workday/journal_lines' as record_source,
        current_timestamp() as load_date_time
    from journal_line

    union all

    select
        journal_bk,
        journal_name,
        'workday/journal_lines_no_filter' as record_source,
        current_timestamp() as load_date_time
    from journal_line_nofilter
),

final as (
    select *
    from unioned
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by journal_bk
        order by
            load_date_time desc,
            record_source asc
    ) = 1
)

select
    journal_bk,
    journal_name,
    record_source,
    load_date_time
from final

with 
	employee as (
	    select
	        employee_bk,
	        location            as location_city
	    from
             {{ ref( 'bc_employee_current' ) }}
    	), 
    location as (
        select
            location_bk,
            location_name       as location_city,
            location_state
        from {{ ref( 'bc_location' ) }}
    ),
	public_holiday as (
	    select
	        public_holiday_bk,
            location            as location_state,
            record_source
	    from
            {{ ref( 'bc_public_holiday' ) }}
        where status <> 'Deleted'
    	), 
	final as (
	    select
            employee_bk,
            location_bk,
            public_holiday_bk,
            public_holiday.record_source
	    from
	        employee
            inner join
                location
                    on

model.cr_project.int_lnk_opportunity_map.description:
This model creates a SID generation layer for the int_lnk_opportunity model, in preparation for lnk_opportunity

We replaced the `left join` with an `inner join` to enforce stricter mapping integrity between Salesforce values and Workday cost centres.  
To prevent data loss from unmapped combinations, we introduced ghost values in the mapping seed file 
for unmatched Region–Business Unit–Practice combinations.

This ensures complete and consistent mappings while maintaining join integrity.
model.cr_project.int_lnk_opportunity_map.raw_code:
with 
	revenue_category as (
	    select
	        map_revenue_category_bk,
	        revenue_category_bk
	    from
	        {{ ref( 'stg_seeds__revenue_category__mapping' ) }}
    	), 
	practice as (
	    select
	        division,
			practice_bk
	    from
	        {{ ref( 'stg_seeds__xero_workday_practice_mappings' ) }}
    	), 	
    cost_center as (
        select
            cost_center_bk,
            region,
            business_unit,
            practice
        from
            {{ ref( 'stg_seeds__salesforce_workday_mappings' ) }}
        ),
	salesforce_opportunity as (
	    select
	        opportunity_bk,
			practice_bk 		as division,
			business_unit,
	        region_bk,
            client_bk,
            stage_bk,
            client_account_director_bk,
			map_revenue_category_bk,
            cost_center_code__c as salesforce_cost_centre_id,
	        record_source
	    from
	        {{ ref( 'stg_salesforce__opportunity' ) }}
    	), 
    bc_cost_center as (
        select
            cost_center_bk,
            salesforce_cost_centre_id,
        from {{ ref('bc_cost_center') }}
    ),
	final as (
	    select
	        salesforce_opportunity.opportunity_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.record_source,
	        salesforce_opportunity.client_account_director_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.client_bk,
	        revenue_category.revenue_category_bk,
	        practice.practice_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.region_bk,
            coalesce(bc_cost_center.cost_center_bk , cost_center.cost_center_bk) as cost_center_bk,
	        salesforce_opportunity.stage_bk
	    from
	        salesforce_opportunity
		        left join
		            revenue_category
		                on
		                    salesforce_opportunity.map_revenue_category_bk = revenue_category.map_revenue_category_bk
		        left join
		            practice
		                on
		                    salesforce_opportunity.division = practice.division
		        join
		            cost_center
		                on
							upper(salesforce_opportunity.region_bk) = cost_center.region and 
							upper(salesforce_opportunity.business_unit) = cost_center.business_unit and 
							upper(salesforce_opportunity.division) = cost_center.practice
                left join bc_cost_center
                    on salesforce_opportunity.salesforce_cost_centre_id = bc_cost_center.salesforce_cost_centre_id
	)
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_lnk_opportunity_fie.raw_code:
with 
    int_dv_opportunity_field_history as (
        select 
            *
        from {{ ref( 'int_dv_opportunity_field_history' ) }}
        where Field IN ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
    ),
    pivottable as (
        select
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID,
            OPPORTUNITY_BK,
            CREATED_DATE,
            CREATED_BY_ID,
            "'Amount'" as AMOUNT,
            "'StageName'" as STAGE_NAME,
            "'Start_Date__c'" as START_DATE__C,
            "'End_Date__c'" as END_DATE__C,
            RECORD_SOURCE
        from
            int_dv_opportunity_field_history
             PIVOT
            (
            Max(NEW_VALUE)
            FOR Field IN ('Amount', 'Start_Date__c','End_Date__c','StageName')
            ) AS pivottable
            -- where opportunityid in ('0069o000003Ei7eAAC')
            order by CREATED_DATE desc
 
    ),
    final AS (
        SELECT 
            H_OPPORTUNITY_FIELD_HISTORY_SID,
            OPPORTUNITY_BK,
            CREATED_DATE,
            CREATED_BY_ID,
            LAST_VALUE(AMOUNT IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS AMOUNT,
            LAST_VALUE(STAGE_NAME IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS STAGE_NAME,
            LAST_VALUE(START_DATE__C IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS START_DATE,
            LAST_VALUE(END_DATE__C IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS END_DATE,
            RECORD_SOURCE
        FROM 
            pivottable
        order by CREATED_DATE desc
    )
select
    *
from
    final

    sd.H_OPPORTUNITY_SID, sd.OPPORTUNITY_HASHDIFF, sd.OPPORTUNITY_NAME, sd.PROJECT_DESCRIPTION, sd.THIRD_PARTY_PRODUCT, sd.SERVICE_OFFERING, sd.TYPE, sd.IS_CLOSED, sd.IS_WON, sd.START_DATE, sd.END_DATE, sd.CLOSED_DATE, sd.DATE_OPPORTUNITY_WAS_CLOSED, sd.CREATED_DATE, sd.IS_DELETED, sd.STARTED_AT_RISK, sd.NEXT_STEP, sd.FORECAST_CATEGORY, sd.FORECAST_CATEGORY_NAME, sd.PRICING_STRUCTURE, sd.LASTMODIFIEDDATE, sd.SOW_VALUE, sd.STAGE_BK, sd.CUSTOMER_LEAD_NAME, sd.PRIMARY_PARTNER_NAME, sd.SECONDARY_PARTNER_NAME, sd.BUSINESS_UNIT, sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME, sd.RECORD_SOURCE,

    SELECT DISTINCT
        sd.H_OPPORTUNITY_SID, sd.OPPORTUNITY_HASHDIFF, sd.OPPORTUNITY_NAME, sd.PROJECT_DESCRIPTION, sd.THIRD_PARTY_PRODUCT, sd.SERVICE_OFFERING, sd.TYPE, sd.IS_CLOSED, sd.IS_WON, sd.START_DATE, sd.END_DATE, sd.CLOSED_DATE, sd.DATE_OPPORTUNITY_WAS_CLOSED, sd.CREATED_DATE, sd.IS_DELETED, sd.STARTED_AT_RISK, sd.NEXT_STEP, sd.FORECAST_CATEGORY, sd.FORECAST_CATEGORY_NAME, sd.PRICING_STRUCTURE, sd.LASTMODIFIEDDATE, sd.SOW_VALUE, sd.STAGE_BK, sd.CUSTOMER_LEAD_NAME, sd.PRIMARY_PARTNER_NAME, sd.SECONDARY_PARTNER_NAME, sd.BUSINESS_UNIT, sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME, sd.RECORD_SOURCE
    FROM source_data AS sd
    QUALIFY sd.OPPORTUNITY_HASHDIFF != LAG(sd.OPPORTUNITY_HASHDIFF) OVER (
        PARTITION BY sd.H_OPPORTUNITY_SID
        ORDER BY sd.LOAD_DATE_TIME ASC
    )

    SELECT frin.H_OPPORTUNITY_SID, frin.OPPORTUNITY_HASHDIFF, frin.OPPORTUNITY_NAME, frin.PROJECT_DESCRIPTION, frin.THIRD_PARTY_PRODUCT, frin.SERVICE_OFFERING, frin.TYPE, frin.IS_CLOSED, frin.IS_WON, frin.START_DATE, frin.END_DATE, frin.CLOSED_DATE, frin.DATE_OPPORTUNITY_WAS_CLOSED, frin.CREATED_DATE, frin.IS_DELETED, frin.STARTED_AT_RISK, frin.NEXT_STEP, frin.FORECAST_CATEGORY, frin.FORECAST_CATEGORY_NAME, frin.PRICING_STRUCTURE, frin.LASTMODIFIEDDATE, frin.SOW_VALUE, frin.STAGE_BK, frin.CUSTOMER_LEAD_NAME, frin.PRIMARY_PARTNER_NAME, frin.SECONDARY_PARTNER_NAME, frin.BUSINESS_UNIT, frin.LOAD_DATE_TIME, frin.RECORD_SOURCE

Added this layer to map the new values of the updated Stage names. This was necessary as there were changes in the stage name in 2021 and the old
    stage names are retained in the Opportunity History records.
model.cr_project.int_dv_opportunity_hist.raw_code:
with
    salesforce_opportunity_history as (
        select  
            opportunity_history_bk,
            opportunity_bk,
            created_date,
            stage_name,
            amount,
            created_date                                        as effective_from,
            record_source,
            load_date_time
        from 
             {{ref('stg_salesforce__opportunity_history')}}
    ),
    -- In 2021 the names of some stages were renamed, see stage_old_to_new_name_mapping.csv for examples.
    -- On top  of this salesforce saves the old name in the history table so don't pick up the new ones.
    -- This will map the old stage name to the new one.    
    opportunity_history_stage_mapping as (
        select 
            old_stage_name,
            new_stage_name                 
        from
            {{ref('stg_manual__opportunity_stage_mapping')}}
    ),
    final as (
        select
            salesforce_opportunity_history.opportunity_history_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity_history.opportunity_bk,
            salesforce_opportunity_history.created_date,
            salesforce_opportunity_history.stage_name,
            coalesce(
                opportunity_history_stage_mapping.new_stage_name, 
                salesforce_opportunity_history.stage_name
                )                                           as new_stage_name,
            salesforce_opportunity_history.amount,
            salesforce_opportunity_history.effective_from,    
            salesforce_opportunity_history.record_source,
            salesforce_opportunity_history.load_date_time
        from
            salesforce_opportunity_history
        left join
            opportunity_history_stage_mapping
            on salesforce_opportunity_history.stage_name = opportunity_history_stage_mapping.old_stage_name
    )
select
    *            
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_dv__project__activi.description:
This model takes the earliest and latest dates for Projects from most sources, and finds thae min/max of all sources.
    This will then be provided to sat_project_activity_dates
model.cr_project.int_dv__project__activi.raw_code:
with 
    journal_line_dates as (
        select
            project_bk,
            min(month_start_date)   as earliest_month,
            max(month_start_date)   as latest_month
        from
            {{ ref('stg_workday__journal_lines') }}
        where project_bk is not null
        group by project_bk
    ),
    project_booking_dates as (
        select
            project_bk,
            min(month_start_date)   as earliest_month,
            max(month_start_date)   as latest_month
        from
            {{ ref('stg_workday__project_resource_forecast') }}
        group by project_bk
    ),
    workday_dates as (
        select
            project_bk,
            start_date_month,
            end_date_month
        from
            {{ ref('stg_workday__projects') }}
    ),
    final as (
        select 
            workday_dates.project_bk,
            least(
                ifnull(journal_line_dates.earliest_month,    workday_dates.start_date_month),
                ifnull(project_booking_dates.earliest_month, workday_dates.start_date_month),
                workday_dates.start_date_month
            ) as ACTIVITY_START_MONTH,
            greatest(
                ifnull(journal_line_dates.latest_month,     workday_dates.end_date_month),
                ifnull(project_booking_dates.latest_month,  workday_dates.end_date_month),
                workday_dates.start_date_month
            ) as ACTIVITY_END_MONTH,
            'int_dv__project__activity_dates__source'    as record_source,
            to_timestamp_ltz(current_timestamp)          as load_date_time

        from
            workday_dates
            left join
                journal_line_dates
                    on workday_dates.project_bk = journal_line_dates.project_bk
            left join
                project_booking_dates
                    on workday_dates.project_bk = project_booking_dates.project_bk
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.int_dv__project__ghost.description:
# Model: stg_ghost

## Business Purpose
This model provides both the BK and SIDs for a ghost record for use in all Datavault hubs. It ensures that no null SIDs exist, allowing for NON NULL constraints on Facts.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Handles null mappings caused by failed joins, missing mappings, or missing fields in previous models.
- Allows explicit assignment of a Ghost value in Dimensions for Facts, making null situations more apparent.
- Ensures a Ghost record is always available for joins in Tableau and other reporting tools.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Used by all Datavault hubs and downstream Fact models.
- Referenced in Tableau and other reporting layers.

## Key Fields
- BK (Business Key)
- SID (Surrogate ID)

## Update Frequency
- Updated as required when new null mapping scenarios are identified.

## Additional Notes
- Applying a Ghost record helps maintain data integrity and clarity in reporting.

- `PROJECT_SID`, `EMPLOYEE_SID`, `PROJECT_ROLE_SID`: Hub references

- h_timesheet_sid: Surrogate key for the time sheet.
- record_source: Indicates the origin system of the record.
- load_date_time: Timestamp when the record was loaded.

    ),

        select

            project_name
        from
            {{ ref('dim_project') }}
    ),

            dim_revenue_category_sid,

        -- Who
            dim_client_sid,
            dim_practice_sid,
            dim_cost_center_sid,

            dim_opportunity_sid,

                    dates

            -- Where
                join
                    region

            -- How
                join
                    stage
                    on
                        rep_revenue.dim_stage_sid = stage.dim_stage_sid
                join
                    account_category
                    on
                        rep_revenue.dim_revenue_category_sid = account_category.dim_revenue_category_sid
            -- Who
                join
                    client
                    on 
                        rep_revenue.dim_client_sid = client.dim_client_sid
                join
                    practice
                    on 
                        rep_revenue.dim_practice_sid = practice.dim_practice_sid
                join
                    cost_center
                    on 
                        rep_revenue.dim_cost_center_sid = cost_center.dim_cost_center_sid
            -- What
                join
                    opportunity
                    on 
                        rep_revenue.dim_opportunity_sid = opportunity.dim_opportunity_sid
                join
                    project
                    on 
                        rep_revenue.dim_project_sid = project.dim_project_sid


    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.rep_revenue_r1_r4_sow_f.description:
# Model: rep_revenue_r1_r4_sow_filtered

## Business Purpose
Provides a focused view of Statement of Work (SOW) revenue data from rep_revenue_r1_r4 with a 3-year rolling window for performance optimization and targeted analysis specifically for DataRails usage.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Filters for fact_sow_amount source records only (table_source = 'fact_sow_amount').
- Applies 3-year rolling date filter starting from January 1st, three years prior to current year.
- Joins with dim_date to filter on actual date values rather than surrogate keys.
- Example: As of January 2026, includes records from January 1, 2023 onwards.

## Sources & Dependencies
- rep_revenue_r1_r4
- dim_date

## Key Fields
- All fields from rep_revenue_r1_r4
- table_source: Always 'fact_sow_amount'
- dim_date_sid: Links to dim_date for date filtering

## Update Frequency
- As per dbt run.

## Additional Notes
- Materialized as table for improved query performance.
- Reduces data volume for downstream reporting and analysis.
- Date filter recalculates dynamically based on current year start date.

    materialized = 'table'
)}}

    rep_revenue_r1_r4.*
from
    {{ ref('rep_revenue_r1_r4') }}
    inner join
        {{ ref('dim_date') }}
        on rep_revenue_r1_r4.dim_date_sid = dim_date.dim_date_sid
where
    rep_revenue_r1_r4.table_source = 'fact_sow_amount'
    and dim_date.date >= dateadd(year, -3, date_trunc('year', current_date()))
    and current_date >= rep_revenue_r1_r4.effective_from
    and current_date < rep_revenue_r1_r4.effective_to

                f.dim_cost_center_sid,
                f.dim_client_sid,
                f.dim_practice_sid,

                f.dim_project_sid,
                f.dim_revenue_category_sid,
                f.daily_amount,
                f.exchange_rate,
                f.record_source,
                f.load_date_time,
                f.effective_from,
                f.effective_to,
                f.fte,
                f.hours,
                f.weighted_amount,
                f.weighted_fte
        from  
                {{ ref('fact_sow_amount') }} f
        join 
                {{ ref('dim_stage') }} 
                on f.dim_stage_sid = dim_stage.dim_stage_sid
        where
                dim_stage.stage_bk <> 'CLOSED_WON'
    ),
    -- solution for identifying the current stage of the opportunity until we implement scd2 in the dim_opportunity
    opportunity_current_stage as (
        select
            dim_opportunity_sid,
            dim_stage_sid,
            effective_from         
        from   
            fact_sow_amount
        qualify Row_Number() Over (
            Partition By 
                dim_opportunity_sid
            Order By 
                effective_from desc) = 1
    ),
    final as (
        select
            fact_sow_amount.*
        from
            fact_sow_amount
        join 
            opportunity_current_stage   -- included effective_from(opportunity_history.created_date) to avoid duplicates when opportunity changes to a stage more than once
                on  fact_sow_amount.dim_opportunity_sid = opportunity_current_stage.dim_opportunity_sid
                    and fact_sow_amount.dim_stage_sid = opportunity_current_stage.dim_stage_sid
                    and fact_sow_amount.effective_from = opportunity_current_stage.effective_from
    )

        select

model.cr_project.stg_ghost.name: stg_ghost
model.cr_project.stg_ghost.description:
# Model: stg_ghost

## Business Purpose
This model provides both the BK and SIDs for a ghost record for use in all Datavault hubs. It ensures that no null SIDs exist, allowing for NON NULL constraints on Facts.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Handles null mappings caused by failed joins, missing mappings, or missing fields in previous models.
- Allows explicit assignment of a Ghost value in Dimensions for Facts, making null situations more apparent.
- Ensures a Ghost record is always available for joins in Tableau and other reporting tools.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Used by all Datavault hubs and downstream Fact models.
- Referenced in Tableau and other reporting layers.

## Key Fields
- BK (Business Key)
- SID (Surrogate ID)

## Update Frequency
- Updated as required when new null mapping scenarios are identified.

## Additional Notes
- Applying a Ghost record helps maintain data integrity and clarity in reporting.

## Additional Notes

model.cr_project.stg_manual_actuals_trac.name: stg_manual_actuals_tracker
model.cr_project.stg_manual_actuals_trac.description:
This view obtains data from the Manual S3 CSV upload 'actuals_tracker.csv'
      
      Finance have a process of approving actuals for a month.
      If a month's actuals have not been approved, and is in a incomplete month, we dont want to include these Actuals in calculations

      The Actuals Tracker allows for the filtering of months in Actuals and Forecast models being PRE and POST this demarkation month.

      After the file is modified in S3 bucket, an SQL query should be created with 
      ```sql
        CREATE OR REPLACE EXTERNAL TABLE EXT_ACTUALS_TRACKER
            LOCATION = @MANUAL_FILES_API_STAGE/
            AUTO_REFRESH = FALSE
            PATTERN = "manual_uploads/actuals_tracker/data/actuals_tracker(?:.*)(?:.csv)"
            FILE_FORMAT = CSV_FMT;

        GRANT OWNERSHIP ON EXTERNAL TABLE EXT_ACTUALS_TRACKER TO ROLE REPORTING_ANALYTICS_DBA;
        GRANT SELECT ON EXTERNAL TABLE EXT_ACTUALS_TRACKER TO ROLE REPORTING_ANALYTICS_PROD_SUPPORT_DBA;
     ```
     See full implementation context and history in:
     [EAG-1745](https://versent.atlassian.net/browse/EAG-1745)
     [EAG-1200](https://versent.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/EAG/boards/358?selectedIssue=EAG-3200)

     This model includes a recency test specified in manual_schema.yml to ensure data freshness based on the file_timestamp column.
     The threshold has been updated to 360 days to reflect the expected update frequency of the source file, with the change in the value of interval
     This change is linked to [EAG-3193](https://versent.atlassian.net/jira/software/projects/EAG/boards/358?selectedIssue=EAG-3193)
     Related dbt docs here: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-utils/tree/1.3.0/#recency-source

- Manual file upload
- Workday Journals

- Opportunity/Project ID
- Actual values

- No longer updated; legacy only.

## Additional Notes
- Check with finance for automation and reconciliation.

                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Feb' THEN 2
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Mar' THEN 3
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Apr' THEN 4
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'May' THEN 5
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Jun' THEN 6
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Jul' THEN 7
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Aug' THEN 8
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Sep' THEN 9
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Oct' THEN 10
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Nov' THEN 11
                    WHEN substring(temp.month,1,3) = 'Dec' THEN 12
                END AS Month_Num,

                temp.TOW,
                temp.division,
                temp.open_close,
                temp.CAD,

                CASE 
                    temp.business_unit 
                    WHEN 'PROFESSIONALSERVICES' THEN 'PROFESSIONAL SERVICES' 
                    ELSE temp.business_unit 
                END as business_unit,
                case
                    when POSITION('-TM', PROJECT_BK) > 0 THEN 'Time & Materials'
                    when POSITION('-FP', PROJECT_BK) > 0 THEN 'Fixed Price'
                    else 'Time & Materials'
                end as pricing_structure,   
                temp.service_offering,
                temp.third_party_product,
                TRY_TO_NUMBER(regexp_replace(temp.revenue,',')) AS revenue,
                CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() as load_date_time,
                record_source
        FROM    (   
                    SELECT *
                    FROM pivot
                    unpivot(
                        revenue for month in (  "Jul-19", "Aug-19", "Sep-19", "Oct-19", "Nov-19", "Dec-19", "Jan-20", "Feb-20", "Mar-20", "Apr-20", "May-20", "Jun-20",

                    )
                ) temp
    ),
    final as (
        select 
            CONCAT(YEAR, '-', lpad(MONTH_NUM, 2, '0'), '-', '01') as date_bk,
            concat_ws(
                '|',        
                upper(BUSINESS_UNIT),
                upper(SERVICE_OFFERING),

            old_region,
            client_name,

            open_close,
            cad,
            region,
            business_unit,
            service_offering,
            third_party_product,
            revenue,
            load_date_time,
            record_source
        from
            other_regions
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_manual_other_region.description:
# Model: stg_manual_other_regions_forecast

## Business Purpose
Obtains forecasting data manually uploaded to S3 csv via 'Other Regions Forecast'.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Manually entered opportunities/projects: VMS Projects, AWS Resell, Pingcloud Contracts.
- Used while automation is under development or being phased out.

## Sources & Dependencies
- S3 manual CSV upload

## Key Fields
- Opportunity/Project ID
- Forecast values

## Update Frequency
- Updated as new manual forecasts are uploaded.

## Additional Notes
- Manual process to be phased out as automation improves.

    final as (
        select
            stage_bk,
            stage_name,
            is_active,
            probability,
            'stages.csv'                            as record_source 
        from
            seed
    )
select
    *
from
    final

# Model: int_manual__target

## Business Purpose
Obtains data from the manual S3 CSV upload 'target.csv' for target forecasting.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Target Forecast is an educated prediction aligned with Group Strategy.
- See models/marts/data_mart/facts/target_forecast/fact_target_forecast.yml for more details.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Manual S3 CSV upload: target.csv
- See also: fact_target_forecast model

## Key Fields
- Forecast values
- Project/Opportunity ID

## Update Frequency
- Updated as new target forecasts are uploaded.

## Additional Notes
- See fact_target_forecast model for more details.

model.cr_project.stg_salesforce__opportu.description:
This model extracts Opportunity data from the Salesforce API and exposes it to the Data Warehouse.
    It renames Salesforce field names to that of the Data Warehouse's BK naming schemes.

    The test test_salesforce_workday_cost_enter_mapping() is executed within this model to ensure that all Salesforce entries for region, business, and 
    practice are correctly mapped to corresponding Workday values. 
    These mappings are essential for deriving the appropriate cost centre in Workday for each opportunity.

model.cr_project.stg_workday__exchange_r.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Exchange Rate data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Exchange_Rates**
    This data allows for historical Workday transactions of many curriencies to be converted into the current days AUD exchange rate
    The data is used in conjunction with Workday Actuals in (int_fact_actual_revenue) and pre-CLOSED_WON forcasting in fact_sow_amount
model.cr_project.stg_workday__exchange_r.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_EXCHANGE_RATES REFRESH;",
) }}
with 
    default_exchange_rate_union as (
        SELECT 
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(f.value:Currency_Rate_Timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SSTZH:TZM'
                )                                       as Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
            TO_TIMESTAMP(
                TO_VARCHAR(f.value:Created_Moment), 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SS.FF9TZH:TZM'
                )                                       as Created_Moment,                    
            f.value:Currency_Rate::varchar(50)          as Currency_Rate,
            f.value:Currency_Rate_Month::varchar(50)    as Currency_Rate_Month,
            f.value:Source_Currency::varchar(50)        as Source_Currency,
            f.value:Target_Currency::varchar(50)        as Target_Currency,
            f.value:Currency_Rate_Type::varchar(50)     as Currency_Rate_Type,
            f.value:Currency_Rate_Year::varchar(50)     as Currency_Rate_Year, 
            f.value:Financial_Year::varchar(50)         as Financial_Year,
            METADATA$FILENAME                           as record_source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_exchange_rates') }}, table(flatten(value)) f

        UNION

        SELECT
            TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
            TO_TIMESTAMP('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as Created_Moment,
            1                       as Currency_Rate,
            1                       as Currency_Rate_Month,
            'AUD'                   as Source_Currency,
            'AUD'                   as Target_Currency,
            'Average'               as Currency_Rate_Type,
            '1900'                  as Currency_Rate_Year,
            '2022 - YE Jun'         as Financial_Year,
            'stg_workday_exchange_rates'     as record_source

        ORDER BY Source_Currency, Target_Currency, CURRENCY_RATE_TIMESTAMP
    ),

    effective_dates as (
        select
            *,
            case 
                when 
                    currency_rate_type = 'Average' then date_trunc('month', currency_rate_timestamp)
                        -- we do this because the average for the month is calculated and entered into workday as the last day of the month
                        -- we want to have a range from the start of the month to the end of the month for all transactions in the month
                        -- by setting it to the first of the month with date_trunc , we can leave the effective_from and to dates
                        -- caclulated in the next view untouched
                else
                    currency_rate_timestamp
            end                     as effective_from,
            current_timestamp()     as load_date_time
        from

    ranked_rows as (
        --rank rows to identify duplicate exchange rate and only select the first one
        select
            *,
            concat_ws('|', Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
                           Source_Currency, 
                           Target_Currency,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                PARTITION BY Currency_Rate_Timestamp,
                                            Source_Currency,

                                            Currency_Rate_Type
                                            ORDER BY Created_Moment DESC
                                            ) AS row_num

                        OVER (

                            ) , 
                    to_timestamp('2900-12-31 00:00:00 ') 
                    ) 
                )                   as effective_to
        from
            ranked_rows
        where row_num = 1            
    )

      The actuals provided are mainly for Forecasting, however Costs could be added to the filter of the report if needed in future
