) }}

WITH
    journal_lines AS (
        SELECT
            
            f.value:Status::varchar(100)                                    as Status,
            f.value:Intercompany_Initiating_Company::varchar(100)           as Intercompany_Initiating_Company,
            f.value:Ledger::varchar(100)                                    as Ledger,
            f.value:Ledger_Account::varchar(100)                            as account,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',1)::varchar(100)          as account_bk,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',-1)::varchar(100)         as account_name,
            f.value:Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit::number(20,2)          as Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit,
            f.value:Ledger_Debit_Amount::number(20,2)                       as Ledger_Debit_Amount,
            f.value:Ledger_Credit_Amount::number(20,2)                      as Ledger_Credit_Amount,
            f.value:Journal::varchar(1000)                                  as Journal,
            f.value:Journal_Number::varchar(100)                            as Journal_Number,
            IFNULL(f.value:Journal_Number, f.value:Journal)::varchar(1000)  as Journal_BK,
            f.value:Source::varchar(100)                                    as Source,
            f.value:Accounting_Date::varchar(100)                           as Accounting_Date,
            f.value:Accounting_Date::date                                   as date_bk,

            f.value:Line_Memo::varchar(200) Line_Memo,
            f.value:Match_ID::varchar(100) Match_ID,
            -- sales item
                f.value:Sales_Item::varchar(100)                        as Sales_Item,
                f.value:Sales_Item_ID::varchar(100)                     as sales_item_bk,
            -- revenue category
                f.value:Revenue_Category::varchar(100)                  as Revenue_Category,
                f.value:Revenue_Category_ID::varchar(150)               as revenue_category_bk,
            
            f.value:Currency::varchar(100)                              as Currency,
            -- company
                f.value:Company::varchar(100)                           as Company,
                f.value:Company_ID::varchar(100)                        as company_bk,
            -- cost center
                f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(100)                    as Cost_Center_bk,
                f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(100)                       as cost_center,
                f.value:Cost_Center_Hierarchies::varchar(100)           as Cost_Center_Hierarchies,
            -- project
                ifnull(upper(f.value:Project_ID),'ghost')::varchar(100) as project_bk,
                f.value:Project::varchar(150)                           as Project,
                f.value:Project_Week::varchar(100)                      as Project_Week,
            --
                f.value:Customer_ID::varchar(100)                       as client_ID,
                f.value:Customer::varchar(100)                          as client,
            -- Region
                f.value:Region_ID::varchar(100)                         as region_bk,
                f.value:Region::varchar(100)                            as region,
            -- practice
                f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(100)                       as practice_bk,
                f.value:Practice::varchar(100)                          as practice,

            f.value:Worktags::varchar(1000)                             as Worktags,
            f.value:Contract_Lines::varchar(1000)                       as Contract_Lines,

            f.value:External_Reference_ID::varchar(100)                 as External_Reference_ID,
            -- spend category
                f.value:Spend_Category_ID::varchar(100)                 as spend_category_bk,
                f.value:Spend_Category::varchar(100)                    as Spend_Category,
            
            ifnull(f.value:Revenue_Category_ID,
                    f.value:Spend_Category_ID)::varchar(100)            as Category_BK,
            f.value:Last_Updated_Moment::varchar(100)                   as Last_Updated_Moment,
            /*
            */
            METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(100)                             as record_source
        from 
            {{ source('workday', 'ext_journal_lines') }}, 
            table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    final AS (
        select  
            concat_ws('|',
                Project_BK,
                Journal_BK,
                Category_BK,
                Row_Number() Over
                        (Partition By 
                            Project_BK,
                            Journal_BK,
                            Category_BK
                        Order By
                            Project_BK,
                            Journal_BK,
                            Category_BK,
                            Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit
                        )
                    )::varchar(1000)                                    as Journal_Line_BK,
            *,                        
            date_trunc('MONTH', date_bk)                                as month_start_date,
	        replace(client_id,'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')::varchar(100)         as client_bk,
	        position('SFDC_Acct_ID_',client_id)                         as client_salesforce_position,
            current_timestamp                                           as load_date_time
        from
            journal_lines
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday__project_re.description:
This view obtains Forecasting information for Workday Projects, along with who these hours are assigned to via the INT003_Extract_Project_Resources_Forecast custom Workday Report.
    The main information provided via this is:
    Forecasted Hours
    Project Code
    Workday Assigned to these hours
    Contract_Billing_Rate of the Worker in this Specific Project (The worker may charge higher or lower than their ususal rate)
    Project_Role_Cost_Rate which represents the cost rate associated with a given project role. 

    These Forecasted hours and Contract_Billing_Rate can then inform either a Professional Services - Time & Materials project, or just Forecasted hours for a Professional Services - Fixed Price project,

      This report is used to created for the Project Revenue, mainly focusing on the Customer Invoices and Revenue Recognition

      AS per 18th February, now the report also include CANCELED journal lines to be able to update the fact_project_revenue to exclude the canceled journal lines
      and the project_revenue_bk has been changed to using Wokrday Journal Line Id which is unique for each journal line id
model.cr_project.stg_workday__project_re.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_JOURNAL_LINES_NOFILTER REFRESH;",
) }}

WITH
    project_revenue AS (
        SELECT
            f.value:Journal_Line_workdayID::varchar(200)                     as Journal_Line_ID,
            f.value:Status::varchar(100)                                    as Status,
            f.value:Intercompany_Initiating_Company::varchar(100)           as Intercompany_Initiating_Company,
            f.value:Ledger::varchar(100)                                    as Ledger,
            f.value:Ledger_Account::varchar(100)                            as account,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',1)::varchar(100)          as account_bk,
            split_part(f.value:Ledger_Account,':',-1)::varchar(100)         as account_name,
            f.value:Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit::number(20,2)          as Ledger_Budget_Debit_minus_Credit,
            f.value:Ledger_Debit_Amount::number(20,2)                       as Ledger_Debit_Amount,
            f.value:Ledger_Credit_Amount::number(20,2)                      as Ledger_Credit_Amount,
            f.value:Journal::varchar(1000)                                  as Journal_Name,
            f.value:Journal_Number::varchar(100)                            as Journal_Number,
            IFNULL(f.value:Journal_Number, f.value:Journal)::varchar(1000)  as Journal_BK,
            f.value:Source::varchar(100)                                    as Source,
            f.value:Accounting_Date::varchar(100)                           as Accounting_Date,
            f.value:Accounting_Date::date                                   as date_bk,
            f.value:Line_Memo::varchar(2000)                                as Line_Memo,
            f.value:Header_Memo::varchar(1000)                              as Header_Memo,
            f.value:Operational_Transaction::varchar(200)                   as Operational_Transaction,            
            f.value:Match_ID::varchar(100)                                  as Match_ID,
            -- sales item
                f.value:Sales_Item::varchar(100)                        as Sales_Item,
                f.value:Sales_Item_ID::varchar(100)                     as sales_item_bk,
            -- revenue category
                f.value:Revenue_Category::varchar(100)                  as Revenue_Category,
                f.value:Revenue_Category_ID::varchar(150)               as revenue_category_bk,
            
            f.value:Currency::varchar(100)                              as Currency,
            -- company
                f.value:Company::varchar(100)                           as Company,
                f.value:Company_ID::varchar(100)                        as company_bk,
            -- cost center
                f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(100)                    as Cost_Center_bk,
                f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(100)                       as cost_center,
                f.value:Cost_Center_Hierarchies::varchar(100)           as Cost_Center_Hierarchies,
            -- project
                ifnull(upper(f.value:Project_ID),'ghost')::varchar(100) as project_bk,
                f.value:Project::varchar(150)                           as Project,
                f.value:Project_Week::varchar(100)                      as Project_Week,
            --
                f.value:Customer_ID::varchar(100)                       as client_ID,
                f.value:Customer::varchar(100)                          as client,
            -- Region
                f.value:Region_ID::varchar(100)                         as region_bk,
                f.value:Region::varchar(100)                            as region,
            -- practice
                f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(100)                       as practice_bk,
                f.value:Practice::varchar(100)                          as practice,

            f.value:Worktags::varchar(1000)                             as Worktags,
            f.value:Contract_Lines::varchar(1000)                       as Contract_Lines,

            f.value:External_Reference_ID::varchar(100)                 as External_Reference_ID,
            -- spend category
                f.value:Spend_Category_ID::varchar(100)                 as spend_category_bk,
                f.value:Spend_Category::varchar(100)                    as Spend_Category,
            
            ifnull(f.value:Revenue_Category_ID,
                    f.value:Spend_Category_ID)::varchar(100)            as Category_BK,
            f.value:Last_Updated_Moment::varchar(100)                   as Last_Updated_Moment,
            /*
            */
            METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(100)                             as record_source
        from 
            {{ source('workday', 'ext_journal_lines_nofilter') }}, 
            table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    final AS (
        select  
            *,
            Journal_Line_ID                                             as project_revenue_bk,                        
            date_trunc('MONTH', date_bk)                                as month_start_date,
	        replace(client_id,'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')::varchar(100)         as client_bk,
	        position('SFDC_Acct_ID_',client_id)                         as client_salesforce_position,
            current_timestamp                                           as load_date_time
        from
            project_revenue
        where account_bk in ('4000','4001') and upper(source) in ('CUSTOMER INVOICE','REVENUE RECOGNITION')
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday__projects.name: stg_workday__projects
model.cr_project.stg_workday__projects.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Project data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Projects**
    The API data regarding the projects in Workday.
    Some of these fields are discrete and provide Start and End dates etc
    It also provides many mappings to other Workday Business Concepts such as Region, Cost Center, Primary_Project_Hierarchy and more
    The model feeds into the hore hub_project Datavault model and into dim_project
model.cr_project.stg_workday__projects.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_PROJECTS REFRESH;",
) }}
with 
    stg as (
        SELECT 
                -- 2022-07-06 - TOM WALLER - https://versent.atlassian.net/browse/EAG-1912, 
                --Added RTRIM INACTIVE as inactive Workday projects append this string to Project Ids. 
                -- this needs to be removed to normaize the proect_bk
                -- Moved Toms comments here - TN
                upper(
                    REPLACE(
                        f.value:Project_ID::varchar(50), 
                        ' (Inactive)', 
                        ''
                        )
                    )::varchar(200)                                     as project_bk,
                f.value:ID::varchar(300)                                as ID,
                f.value:Project_State::varchar(200)                     as Project_State,
                f.value:Primary_Project_Hierarchy::varchar(200)         as Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
                f.value:Billable::varchar(10)                           as Billable,
                f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(200)                       as Cost_Center,
                f.value:Practice::varchar(50)                           as practice_name,
                f.value:Start_Date::date                                as Start_Date,
                f.value:End_Date::date                                  as End_Date,
                f.value:Salesforce_ID::varchar(200)                     as Salesforce_ID,
                f.value:Customer_Reference_ID::varchar(200)             as Customer_Reference_ID,
                f.value:Customer_ID::varchar(200)                       as Customer_ID,
                f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(50)                     as cost_center_bk,
                f.value:Company_ID::varchar(100)                        as company_bk,
                f.value:Company::varchar(200)                           as Company,
                f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(50)                        as practice_bk,
                f.value:Region_ID::varchar(50)                          as region_bk,
                f.value:Project::varchar(500)                           as Project,
                f.value:Project_Description::string                     as Project_Description,
                f.value:Project_Groups::varchar(1000)                   as Project_Groups,                
                f.value:Project_Region::varchar(200)                    as Project_Region,
                f.value:Project_Owner::varchar(200)                     as Project_Owner,
                f.value:Billable_Amount::varchar(200)                   as Billable_Amount,
                f.value:Contract_Lines::string                          as Contract_Lines,
                f.value:Contract_Lines_group::string                    as Contract_Lines_group,
                NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(UPPER(f.value:Project_Description::string), 
                                'PO NUMBER:', 2), 'DISCOUNT:', 1), '^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$', ''), '')::varchar(200)  as PO_Number,
                TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(f.value:Project_Description, 
                                'Discount:\\s*([0-9.]+)%', 1, 1, 'i', 1), 38, 2)               as Discount,
                TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(f.value:Project_Description, 
                                'Target Profitability:\\s*([0-9.]+)%', 1, 1, 'i', 1), 38, 2)   as Target_Profitability,                                 
                METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(250)                         as record_source,
                current_timestamp()                                     as load_date_time
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_projects') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
        ),
    final as (
        select 
            project_bk,
            ID,
            Project_State,
            Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
            Billable,
            Cost_Center,
            practice_name,
            Start_Date,
            End_Date,
            Salesforce_ID,
            Customer_Reference_ID,
            Customer_ID,
            cost_center_bk,
            company_bk,
            Company,
            practice_bk,
            region_bk,
            Project,
            Project_Description,
            Project_Groups,
            Project_Region,
            Project_Owner,
            Billable_Amount,
            Contract_Lines,
            Contract_Lines_group,
            PO_Number,            
            Discount,
            Target_Profitability,                    
            CASE 
                WHEN SALESFORCE_ID IS NULL THEN 'ghost' 
                ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(SALESFORCE_ID,'SFDC_Opp_ID_',''),'SFID_Opp_ID_','') END    as OPPORTUNITY_BK,
            date_trunc('month', start_date)                                                     as start_date_month,
            date_trunc('month', end_date)                                                       as end_date_month,
            record_source,
            load_date_time
        from stg
    )
select 
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday__public_hol.description: This model extracts raw Public Holiday JSON data from Workday's Public Holiday custom report
model.cr_project.stg_workday__public_hol.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS REFRESH;",
) }}

with
    report_entry as (
        select 
            f.value:Location::varchar(500)                  as Location,
            f.value:Location_Hierarchy::varchar(500)        as Location_Hierarchy,
            f.value:Calendar_Events_group                   as Calendar_Events_group,
            METADATA$FILENAME                               as record_source
        from 
            {{ source('workday', 'ext_public_holidays') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
    ),
    public_holiday_lines as (
        select  
            ifnull(report_entry.Location,report_entry.Location_Hierarchy)   as Location,
            report_entry.Location_Hierarchy,
            f.value:Holiday::varchar(1000)                                  as Holiday,
            f.value:Start_Date::varchar(50)                                 as Start_Date,
            f.value:End_Date::varchar(50)                                   as End_Date,
            report_entry.record_source
        from 
            report_entry, table(flatten(Calendar_Events_group)) f
    ),
    -- handle duplicate holiday records
    unique_rows as (
        select  
            TO_DATE(public_holiday_lines.Start_Date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')      as Date_BK,
            case  -- workaround until the data from Workday is fixed
                when public_holiday_lines.Location = 'Holiday Calendar for Singapore (Manilla)' then 'Manila'
                else public_holiday_lines.Location 
            end                                                         as Location,
            public_holiday_lines.Location_Hierarchy,
            MAX(public_holiday_lines.Holiday)                           as Holiday,
            public_holiday_lines.Start_Date,
            public_holiday_lines.End_Date,
            public_holiday_lines.record_source
        from
            public_holiday_lines
        group by all
    ),
    final as (
        select
            concat_ws('|',
                    Location,
                    Date_BK)        as Public_Holiday_BK,
            Date_BK,
            Location,
            Location_Hierarchy,
            Holiday,
            Start_Date,
            End_Date,
            Record_Source,
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP       as Load_Date_Time
        from
            unique_rows 
    )
select
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday_customer_co.name: stg_workday_customer_contract_lines
model.cr_project.stg_workday_customer_co.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Contract Line data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Find_Customer_Contract_Lines**
    The data is currently used to obtain a Workday Projects Deal Value, as this is a sum of all contract lines, 
    as opposed to Salesforces SOW showing a project  value via  a distinct field
    The contract lines can also be used in the future for calculating PingCloud forecasting, once Revenue Recognition Lines are obtained
    This is due to PingCloud having a single Contract Line for all PingCloud Opportunities as a parent, and a Revenue Recognition Schedule for each client
model.cr_project.stg_workday_customer_co.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_LINES REFRESH;",
) }}
with 
flatten as (
    select
        -- Concept IDs
        f.value:Contract_ID::varchar(50)                                            AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_BK,
        f.value:Contract::varchar(200)                                              AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_NAME,
        f.value:Contract_Line::varchar(200)                                         AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_LINE_BK,
        f.value:Contract_Line_ID::varchar(200)                                      AS CONTRACT_LINE_ID,
        f.value:Customer_Contract_Line_Number::number                               AS CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_LINE_NUMBER,

        -- Concept fields   
        UPPER(f.value:Line_Status::varchar(200))                                    AS LINE_STATUS,
        f.value:Billing_Schedule_ID::varchar(200)                                   AS BILLING_SCHEDULE_ID,
        f.value:Revenue_Recognition_Schedule_ID::varchar(200)                       AS REVENUE_RECOGNITION_SCHEDULE_ID,
        UPPER(f.value:Contract_Line_Type::varchar(200))                             AS CONTRACT_LINE_TYPE,
        UPPER(f.value:Project_Transaction_Source::varchar(200))                     AS PROJECT_TRANSACTION_SOURCE,
        UPPER(f.value:Revenue_Treatment::varchar(200))                              AS REVENUE_TREATMENT,

        -- Relationship BKs

        UPPER(f.value:Billable_Project_group[0].Billable_Project_ID::varchar(50))   AS PROJECT_BK,
        f.value:Currency::varchar(10)                                               AS CURRENCY,
        f.value:Region_ID::varchar(50)                                              AS REGION_BK,
        f.value:Cost_Centre_ID::varchar(50)                                         AS COST_CENTER_BK,
        f.value:Practice_ID::varchar(50)                                            AS PRACTICE_BK,
        f.value:Revenue_Category_ID::varchar(50)                                    AS REVENUE_CATEGORY_BK,
        REPLACE(f.value:Bill_Customer_ID::varchar(50), 'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')          AS BILL_CUSTOMER_BK,
        REPLACE(f.value:Sold_Customer_ID::varchar(50), 'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')          AS SOLD_CUSTOMER_BK,
        REPLACE(f.value:Sold_Customer_ID::varchar(50), 'SFDC_Acct_ID_','')          AS CLIENT_BK,

        -- Names
        f.value:Company::varchar(50)                                                AS COMPANY_NAME,
        f.value:Billable_Project::varchar(200)                                      AS BILLABLE_PROJECT,
        f.value:Renewable::boolean                                                  AS RENEWABLE,
        f.value:Cost_Centre_Hierarchies::varchar(50)                                AS COST_CENTRE_HIERARCHIES,
        f.value:Revenue_Category::varchar(50)                                       AS REVENUE_CATEGORY,
        f.value:Practice::varchar(50)                                               AS PRACTICE,
        f.value:Cost_Centre::varchar(50)                                            AS COST_CENTRE,
        f.value:New_Business::boolean                                               AS NEW_BUSINESS,
        f.value:Billing_Schedule::varchar(300)                                      AS BILLING_SCHEDULE,
        f.value:"Sold-To_Customer"::varchar(300)                                    AS SOLD_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME,
        f.value:"Bill-To_Customer"::varchar(300)                                    AS BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME,
        f.value:Billable_Project_group                                              AS BILLABLE_PROJECT_GROUP,
        f.value:Worktags::varchar(200)                                              AS WORKTAGS,
        f.value:Revenue_Recognition_Schedule::varchar(200)                          AS REVENUE_RECOGNITION_SCHEDULE,
        f.value:Region::varchar(50)                                                 AS REGION,

        -- Amounts
        f.value:Line_Amount::number(20,2)                                           AS AMOUNT,
        f.value:Recognized_Deferred_Revenue::number(20,2)                           AS RECOGNIZED_DEFERRED_REVENUE,
        f.value:Scheduled_Deferred_Revenue_To_Recognize::number(20,2)               AS SCHEDULED_DEFERRED_REVENUE_TO_RECOGNIZE,
        f.value:Adjustment_Amount::number(20,2)                                     AS ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT,
        f.value:Billed_Amount::number(20,2)                                         AS BILLED_AMOUNT,
        f.value:Revenue_Override_Amount::number(20,2)                               AS REVENUE_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT,
        f.value:Deferred_Revenue_Balance::number(20,2)                              AS DEFERRED_REVENUE_BALANCE,

        current_date()                                                              AS DATE_BK,
        current_timestamp()                                                         AS LOAD_DATE_TIME,
        METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(100)                                             AS RECORD_SOURCE
        
    from {{ source('workday', 'ext_customer_contract_lines') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
) ,
active_lines as (
    select
        *
    from
        flatten
    where
        -- TOM WALLER - EAG-2170
        -- Filtering out line_status of cancelled. Explicitly allowing these stauses though incase others are in Workday that we don't know about
        line_status in ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETE')
),
final as (
    select 
        *
    from
        active_lines
)
select 
    *
from
    final

        f.value:Billing_Schedule::varchar(300)                                      AS BILLING_SCHEDULE,
        f.value:"Sold-To_Customer"::varchar(300)                                    AS SOLD_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME,
        f.value:"Bill-To_Customer"::varchar(300)                                    AS BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME,

        f.value:Revenue_Recognition_Schedule::varchar(200)                          AS REVENUE_RECOGNITION_SCHEDULE,
        f.value:Region::varchar(50)                                                 AS REGION,

        -- Amounts
        f.value:Line_Amount::number(20,2)                                           AS AMOUNT,
        f.value:Recognized_Deferred_Revenue::number(20,2)                           AS RECOGNIZED_DEFERRED_REVENUE,
        f.value:Scheduled_Deferred_Revenue_To_Recognize::number(20,2)               AS SCHEDULED_DEFERRED_REVENUE_TO_RECOGNIZE,
        f.value:Adjustment_Amount::number(20,2)                                     AS ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT,

        current_timestamp()                                                         AS LOAD_DATE_TIME,
        METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(100)                                             AS RECORD_SOURCE
        
    from LANDING.landing_workday.ext_customer_contract_lines, table(flatten(value)) f
) ,
active_lines as (
    select
        *
    from
        flatten
    where
        -- TOM WALLER - EAG-2170
        -- Filtering out line_status of cancelled. Explicitly allowing these stauses though incase others are in Workday that we don't know about
        line_status in ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETE')
),
final as (
    select 
        *
    from
        active_lines
)
select 
    *
from
    final

model.cr_project.stg_workday_project_res.name: stg_workday_project_resource_plan
model.cr_project.stg_workday_project_res.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Project Plan data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Extract_Project_Resources**
    Workday Project Plans are a more details version of a Project Forecast and are used closer to a projects start date
    At this time, the Project Forecast is used as it is used earlier than the plan, allowing for more forecasting,albeit slightly more innacuratly
    This data is currently used for Project Roles
model.cr_project.stg_workday_project_res.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_PROJECT_RESOURCE_PLAN REFRESH;",
) }}

with 
    project_resource_plan as (
        select 
        IFNULL(get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_ID::varchar(200),'ghost')      as Project_ID,
        f.value:Project_Role::varchar(200)                                          as Project_Role,
        IFNULL(f.value:End_Date::varchar(50)   ,'1900-01-01')                       as End_Date,
        IFNULL(f.value:Project_Role_ID::varchar(200),'ghost')                       as Project_Role_ID,
        f.value:Project::varchar(250)                                               as Project,
        f.value:Percent_Allocation::varchar(10)                                     as Percent_Allocation,
        f.value:Time_Unit_of_Effort::varchar(200)                                   as Time_Unit_of_Effort,
        f.value:Project_Resource_Plan::varchar(500)                                 as Project_Resource_Plan,
        f.value:Workers::string                                                     as Worker,
        f.value:Contract_Billing_Rate::varchar(50)                                  as Contract_Billing_Rate,
        IFNULL(f.value:Start_Date::varchar(50),'1900-01-01')                        as Start_Date,
        f.value:Project_Resource_Plan1::varchar(500)                                as Project_Resource_Plan1,
        f.value:Rate_Sheet_Billing_Rate::varchar(50)                                as Rate_Sheet_Billing_Rate,
        f.value:Resource_Type::varchar(50)                                          as Resource_Type,
        f.value:Unnamed_Resource::varchar(50)                                       as Unnamed_Resource,
        f.value:Contract_Rate_Currency::varchar(200)                                as Contract_Rate_Currency,
        -- Project and workers come as an array via the API, however only 1 can be selected in the UI.
        -- Therefore get the first in the array
        get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_Currency::varchar(200)                as Project_Currency,
        get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_Salesforce_ID::varchar(200)           as Project_Salesforce_ID,
        get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Primary_Project_Hierarchy::varchar(200)       as Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
        IFNULL(get(f.value:Workers_group, 0):Employee_ID::varchar(200),'ghost')     as Worker_ID,

        f.value:Job_Requisition::varchar(200)                                       as Job_Requisition,
        IFNULL(get(f.value:Project_group, 0):Project_Owner::varchar(200),'ghost')   as Project_Owner,
        METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(200)                                             as Record_Source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_project_resource_plan') }}, table(flatten(value)) f
        
    )
select 
        concat_ws('|', 
            Project_ID, 
            Worker_ID, 
            Project_Role_ID, 
            Start_Date,
            End_Date,
            Row_Number() Over
                    (Partition By 
                        Project_ID, 
                        Worker_ID, 
                        Project_Role_ID, 
                        Start_Date,
                        End_Date
                    Order By
                        Project_ID, 
                        Worker_ID, 
                        Project_Role_ID, 
                        Start_Date,
                        End_Date
                    )
                )                           as Resource_Plan_BK,            
        Upper(Project_ID)                   as Project_BK,
        Project_Role,
        End_Date,
        Project_Role_ID,
        Project,
        Percent_Allocation,
        Time_Unit_of_Effort,
        Project_Resource_Plan,
        Worker,
        Contract_Billing_Rate,
        Start_Date,
        Project_Resource_Plan1,
        Rate_Sheet_Billing_Rate,
        Resource_Type,
        Unnamed_Resource,
        Contract_Rate_Currency,
        Project_Currency,
        Project_Salesforce_ID,
        Worker_ID,
        To_Be_Hired,
        Job_Requisition,
        Project_Owner,
        Record_Source,
        Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
        CURRENT_DATE                            as Plan_Date,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP                       as Load_Date_Time
from 
    project_resource_plan
    -- excluded as requested in EAG-2702
where Primary_Project_Hierarchy not in ('Internal: Admin', 'Internal: Innovation','Internal: Transformation')

model.cr_project.stg_workday_time_block_.name: stg_workday_time_block_audit
model.cr_project.stg_workday_time_block_.description:
This model ingests and standardises the field names of Time Sheet data provided by the Workday Company API **INT003_Time_Block_Audit**
    This data provides real timesheet data clocked against a Project for a worker
    The data is not currently used, but could be for Forecast Ultisiation.

    As 23 September 2025, 
    The timesheet bk cahnges to Time_Block_ID as it represent uniqueness on each entry of the timesheet to avoid any duplication where there are 
    two time entries submitted on a day working on the same project with the same task code or with the delere and recreated entries with same attributes.
    Use the file name with the time stamp for the load_date_time to represent the uqnieu laod date time of the record in case of changes ot any enties.

    As 21st October 2025, 
    The column that represent the status of the timesheet changes to "Status" from "Reported_Time_Block_Historical_Status" inside the nested "Reported_Time_Block_History_group"
    It will show the most recent status of the time block audit and handle the Automatic Approval Status
model.cr_project.stg_workday_time_block_.raw_code:
{{ config(
    pre_hook="ALTER EXTERNAL TABLE {{ env_var('DBT_LANDING_DB') }}.LANDING_WORKDAY.EXT_TIME_BLOCK_AUDIT REFRESH;"
) }}

with
    time_block_audit_line as (
        select         
            IFNULL(f.value:Task_Code,'ghost')::varchar(1000)    as Task_Code,
            IFNULL(f.value:Worker_ID,'ghost')::varchar(50)      as Employee_BK,
            IFNULL(f.value:Project_ID,'ghost')::varchar(50)     as Project_BK,
            f.value:Time_Block_ID::varchar(100)                 as Time_Block_ID,
            f.value:Status::varchar(100)                        as Status,            
            f.value:Worker_Location::varchar(50)                as Worker_Location,
            f.value:Supervisory_Organisation::varchar(100)      as Supervisory_Organisation,
            f.value:Position::varchar(500)                      as Position,
            f.value:Billing_Status::varchar(50)                 as Billing_Status,
            f.value:Billable_Rate::varchar(50)                  as Billable_Rate,
            f.value:Invoice_Number::varchar(100)                as Invoice_Number,
            f.value:Revenue_Status::varchar(100)                as Revenue_Status,
            f.value:Total_Hours__Time_Tracking::number(20,2)    as Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,
            f.value:Cost_Center::varchar(100)                   as Cost_Center,
            f.value:Practice::varchar(100)                      as Practice,
            f.value:Time_Block::varchar(100)                    as Time_Block,
            f.value:Billable_Hours::number(20,2)                as Billable_Hours,
            f.value:Project_Role::varchar(500)                  as Project_Role,
            f.value:Project::string                             as Project,
            f.value:Calculated_Date::Date                       as Calculated_Date,
            f.value:Region::varchar(50)                         as Region,
            f.value:Worker::varchar(100)                        as Worker,
            f.value:Calculation_Tags::varchar(100)              as Calculation_Tags,
            f.value:Cost_Center_ID::varchar(50)                 as Cost_Center_BK,
            f.value:Customer_Billing_Currency::varchar(20)      as Billing_Currency,            
            f.value:Comment::string                             as Comment,
            f.value:Is_Deleted::boolean                         as Is_Deleted,
            f.value:Reported_Time_Block_History_group           as Reported_Time_Block_History_group,
            COALESCE(f.value:Billing_Rate_Rule_Application_group,
                    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())                          as Billing_Rate_Rule_Application_group,
            METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(200)                     as record_source
        from {{ source('workday', 'ext_time_block_audit') }}, table(flatten(value)) f  
        where f.value:Status in ('Approved')                           
    ), 
    final as (
        select
            t.Time_Block_ID,
            t.Status,
            t.Task_Code,
            t.Worker_Location,                                          
            t.Supervisory_Organisation,                                    
            t.Position,                                                   
            t.Billable_Rate,    
            t.Billing_Status,                                                                             
            t.Cost_Center,                                                                                
            t.Time_Block,                                                    
            t.Project,                                                       
            t.Calculated_Date,                                                 
            t.Region,                                                          
            t.Worker,     
            t.Project_BK, 
            t.Employee_BK,               
            IFNULL(t.Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,0)                                            as Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,                                    
            IFNULL(t.Practice,'ghost')                                                        as Practice,            
            IFNULL(t.Billable_Hours,0)                                                        as Billable_Hours,                                                 
            IFNULL(t.Project_Role, 'ghost')                                                   as Project_Role,                                                               
            IFNULL(t.Cost_Center_BK,'ghost')                                                  as Cost_Center_BK,
            IFNULL(t.Invoice_Number, 'ghost')                                                 as Invoice_Number,
            IFNULL(t.Revenue_Status, 'ghost')                                                 as Revenue_Status,
            t.Calculation_Tags,              
            t.Billing_Currency,                                  
            t.Comment,
            t.Is_Deleted,                                         
            f1.value:Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date::Date                                as Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date,
            f1.value:Modified_By::varchar(100)                                                as Modified_By,
            f1.value:Modified_Moment::string                                                  as Modified_Moment,
            f1.value:Reported_Quantity::varchar(50)                                           as Reported_Quantity,
            f1.value:Source::varchar(100)                                                     as Source,
            f1.value:Time_Entry_Code::varchar(100)                                            as Time_Entry_Code,
            COALESCE(f2.value:Rate_To_Bill::varchar(50), NULL)                                as Override_Rate,
            record_source                                                                     as Record_Source,
            TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(
                REPLACE( 
                    REGEXP_SUBSTR(record_source, '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}'),
                        '-', ' '), 
                            'YYYY MM DD HH MI SS')                                            as Load_Date_Time
        from time_block_audit_line t
            , lateral flatten(input => t.Reported_Time_Block_History_group) f1
            , lateral flatten(input => t.Billing_Rate_Rule_Application_group, outer => true) f2
        -- filtered by 'Approved' statuses and added row number to handle instances of multiple approval in the reported_time_block_history_group
        -- final select query will select row_num = 1 which is the latest 'Approved' instance
        qualify Row_Number() Over (
            Partition By 
                t.Time_Block_ID
            Order By 
                f1.value:Modified_Moment DESC) = 1
    )
select   
        Time_Block_ID as Timesheet_BK,
        Task_Code,
        Worker_Location,   
        Supervisory_Organisation,
        Position,
        Billable_Rate,
        Override_Rate,
        Billing_Status,
        Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,
        Upper(Project_BK)                   as Project_BK,
        Cost_Center,
        Practice,
        Time_Block,
        Billable_Hours,
        Invoice_Number,
        Revenue_Status,
        Billing_Currency,
        Project_Role,
        Project,
        Calculated_Date,
        Region,
        Worker,
        Employee_BK,
        Calculation_Tags,
        Cost_Center_BK,
        Comment,
        Is_Deleted,
        Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date,
        Status,
        Modified_By,
        Modified_Moment,
        Reported_Quantity,
        Source,
        Time_Entry_Code,
        Record_Source,
        Load_Date_time     
from
    final

            IFNULL(t.Project_Role, 'ghost')                                                   as Project_Role,                                                               
            IFNULL(t.Cost_Center_BK,'ghost')                                                  as Cost_Center_BK,
            IFNULL(t.Invoice_Number, 'ghost')                                                 as Invoice_Number,
            IFNULL(t.Revenue_Status, 'ghost')                                                 as Revenue_Status,
            t.Calculation_Tags,              
            t.Billing_Currency,                                  
            t.Comment,
            t.Is_Deleted,                                         
            f1.value:Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date::Date                                as Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date,
            f1.value:Modified_By::varchar(100)                                                as Modified_By,
            f1.value:Modified_Moment::string                                                  as Modified_Moment,
            f1.value:Reported_Quantity::varchar(50)                                           as Reported_Quantity,
            f1.value:Source::varchar(100)                                                     as Source,
            f1.value:Time_Entry_Code::varchar(100)                                            as Time_Entry_Code,
            COALESCE(f2.value:Rate_To_Bill::varchar(50), NULL)                                as Override_Rate,
            record_source                                                                     as Record_Source,
            TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(
                REPLACE( 
                    REGEXP_SUBSTR(record_source, '\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}'),
                        '-', ' '), 
                            'YYYY MM DD HH MI SS')                                            as Load_Date_Time
        from time_block_audit_line t
            , lateral flatten(input => t.Reported_Time_Block_History_group) f1
            , lateral flatten(input => t.Billing_Rate_Rule_Application_group, outer => true) f2
        -- filtered by 'Approved' statuses and added row number to handle instances of multiple approval in the reported_time_block_history_group
        -- final select query will select row_num = 1 which is the latest 'Approved' instance
        qualify Row_Number() Over (
            Partition By 
                t.Time_Block_ID
            Order By 
                f1.value:Modified_Moment DESC) = 1
    )
select   
        Time_Block_ID as Timesheet_BK,
        Task_Code,
        Worker_Location,   
        Supervisory_Organisation,
        Position,
        Billable_Rate,
        Override_Rate,
        Billing_Status,
        Total_Hours__Time_Tracking,
        Upper(Project_BK)                   as Project_BK,
        Cost_Center,
        Practice,
        Time_Block,
        Billable_Hours,
        Invoice_Number,
        Revenue_Status,
        Billing_Currency,
        Project_Role,
        Project,
        Calculated_Date,
        Region,
        Worker,
        Employee_BK,
        Calculation_Tags,
        Cost_Center_BK,
        Comment,
        Is_Deleted,
        Reported_Time_Block_Calculated_Date,
        Status,
        Modified_By,
        Modified_Moment,
        Reported_Quantity,
        Source,
        Time_Entry_Code,
        Record_Source,
        Load_Date_time     
from
    final

--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW OVERWATCH_LANDING_DB.XERO.SINGAPORE_CREDIT_NOTES AS
with 
  CreditNotesLineItems AS (
    select
      METADATA$FILENAME::varchar(150)                 as record_source,
      creditNote.value:CreditNoteID::varchar(50)      as document_id,
      creditNote.value:CreditNoteNumber::String       as CreditNoteNumber,
      creditNote.value:Type::varchar(50)              as type, 
      creditNote.value:Contact.Name::String           as Customer,
      creditNote.value:DateString::Date               as date_bk,
      creditNote.value:Status::varchar(50)            as Status,
      flatdata.value:Description::String              as description,
      Lower(flatdata.value:AccountCode::String)       as account_code,
      flatdata.value:Tracking[0].Option::String       as Division,
      flatdata.value:Tracking[1].Option::String       as Region,
      creditNote.value:LineAmountTypes::varchar(50)   as line_amount_types,
      flatdata.value:LineAmount :: Double             as LineAmount,
      flatdata.value:TaxAmount::Double                as TaxAmount,
      creditNote.value:LineAmountTypes::String        as Taxed,
      creditNote.value:CurrencyCode::String           as Currency,
      creditNote.value:CurrencyRate::Double           as ConversionValue,
      creditNote.value:CurrencyRate::Double           as CurrencyRate,
      creditNote.value:UpdatedDateUTC::Datetime       as updatedDate,
      creditNote.value:_sdc_batched_at::Datetime      as batchDate
    FROM 
      {{ source('xero', 'ext_singapore_credit_notes_json') }}  creditNote,
      lateral flatten(input => parse_json(creditNote.value:LineItems)) flatdata
  ),
  final as (
    select
      CreditNotesLineItems.*,
      case
        when account_code IN ('201','201b','202','202a','204','205','206','207','209b','210b') then 'LICENSING REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%201%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%202%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%204%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%205%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%206%' OR 
          account_code LIKE '%207%' 
          then 'LICENSING REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%216%' AND 
          (
          SUBSTRING(
            description,
            CHARINDEX('[', description)+1,
            (CHARINDEX(']', description) - CHARINDEX('[', description))-1
          ) :: String) = '' 
          then 'AWS REVENUE COST'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%260%' then 'STAX SALES REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%261%' then 'OTHER REVENUE'
        when 
          account_code LIKE '%217%' AND (SUBSTRING(description,
      CHARINDEX('[', description)+1,
      (CHARINDEX(']', description) - CHARINDEX('[', description))-1
      ) :: String) = '' then 'REFERRAL FEE INCOME'
      else
        SUBSTRING(
          description,
          CHARINDEX('[', description)+1,
          (CHARINDEX(']', description) - CHARINDEX('[', description))-1
        ) :: String end
        as project_bk,
      case
        when 
          type = 'ACCRECCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types = 'Inclusive' 
          then
            ((LineAmount)-(TaxAmount))/(CurrencyRate)*-1
        when 
          type = 'ACCRECCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types IN ('Exclusive','NoTax') then
          (LineAmount)/(CurrencyRate)*-1
        when 
          type= 'ACCPAYCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types = 'Inclusive' then
          (((LineAmount)-(TaxAmount))/(CurrencyRate))
        when 
          type = 'ACCPAYCREDIT' AND 
          line_amount_types IN ('Exclusive','NoTax') then
          ((LineAmount)/(CurrencyRate))
      end
      as revenue_amount
    from
      CreditNotesLineItems
    where 
      status in ('PAID','AUTHORISED')
  )
select 
  distinct 
  final.*
from 
  final

--           FROM CreditNotesLineItems group by CreditNoteID, AccountCode) lineItemRecord --replaced LineAmount with accountCode

      payment.value:Amount::Double                              as amount,
      payment.value:Invoice.CurrencyCode::string as Currency,
      payment.value:CurrencyRate::Double as ConversionValue,
      case
        when payment.value:PaymentType IN ('ARCREDITPAYMENT','AROVERPAYMENTPAYMENT','ARPREPAYMENTPAYMENT','ACCRECPAYMENT') then payment.value:BankAmount::Double
        when payment.value:PaymentType IN ('APCREDITPAYMENT', 'APPREPAYMENTPAYMENT', 'APOVERPAYMENTPAYMENT', 'ACCPAYPAYMENT') then (payment.value:BankAmount::Double)*-1
        else
          (payment.value:BankAmount::Double)
        end
        as revenue_amount,
      payment.value:UpdatedDateUTC::Datetime as updatedDate,
      payment.value:_sdc_batched_at::Datetime as batchDate
    FROM LANDING.landing_xero.ext_versent_payments_json payment
   )
select * 
from
  payment
where status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'DELETED', 'VOIDED')

snapshot.cr_project.snapshot_standard_co.description:
# Model: snapshot_standard_cost_rate

## Business Purpose
This snapshot tracks changes to the standard cost rate for project roles in Workday over time. It enables historical analysis and auditing of cost rate changes for project roles.

## Business Logic & Key Calculations
- Captures all records from the staging model `stg_workday__standard_cost_rate`.
- `standard_cost_rate_bk` (a composite key of Project_Role_ID, Effective_From, and Currency) is used as the unique key.
- Follows a timestamp strategy to record changes whenever the effective date or other tracked fields are updated.

## Sources & Dependencies
- Source: `stg_workday__standard_cost_rate` (staging model for Workday standard cost rate data)
- Depends on the external Workday data source and the staging transformation logic.

## Key Fields
- `Project_Role_ID`: Unique identifier for the project role.
- `Effective_From`: Date when the cost rate became effective.
- `Project_Role`: Name of the project role.
- `Standard_Cost_Rate`: Standard cost rate for the project role.
- `record_source`: Source file for the record.
- `load_date_time`: Timestamp when the record was loaded.

## Update Frequency
- Updated whenever the source data in Workday changes and the dbt snapshot is run (typically daily or as scheduled).

## Additional Notes
- Ensures historical tracking of cost rate changes for compliance and reporting.
- Follows dbt and project style guide conventions for naming, structure, and documentation.

snapshot.cr_project.snapshot_time_sheet.name: snapshot_time_sheet
snapshot.cr_project.snapshot_time_sheet.description:
## Overview

The `time_sheet` snapshot tracks historical changes to timesheet records sourced from the `stg_workday_time_block_audit` model. This snapshot enables auditing and analysis of timesheet data over time, capturing every change to key business attributes.

For reporting purposes, this snapshot also joins and includes the IDs for project role and practice, as these are not present in the original source but are required for downstream analytics and business consumption.

## Purpose

- Maintain a full history of timesheet records for compliance and auditability.
- Detect and record changes to important timesheet fields, such as hours worked, billing rates, and statuses.
- Support reporting on both current and historical states of timesheet data.

## Change Detection Strategy
This snapshot uses the **check strategy** with a set of business-critical columns. A new record is created whenever any of these columns change for a given timesheet key (`TIMESHEET_BK`). 
The snapshot records the validity period for each version using `dbt_valid_from` and `dbt_valid_to` fields.
The snaphost use 'hard_deleted = `ignore` because the Time_Block_Audit report is using high water mark and it also uses is_deleted field to identify deletion.

### Tracked Columns

- `TASK_CODE`
- `TOTAL_HOURS__TIME_TRACKING`
- `BILLABLE_HOURS`
- `BILLING_CURRENCY`
- `BILLABLE_RATE`
- `BILLING_STATUS`
- `REVENUE_STATUS`
- `INVOICE_NUMBER`
- `OVERRIDE_RATE`
- `CALCULATED_DATE`
- `IS_DELETED`

## Additional Notes

- The snapshot is refreshed as part of the dbt run process.
- Ensure that the source staging model (`stg_workday_time_block_audit`) is up to date for accurate snapshotting.
- For more information, refer to the [dbt snapshot documentation](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/build/snapshots).

SELECT
  REP_REVENUE.DIM_OPPORTUNITY_SID,
  MAX(bridge_opportunity_project.OPPORTUNITY_BK) as OPPORTUNITY_BK,
  MAX(bridge_opportunity_project.project_bk) as project_bk,
  MAX(int_project_current.Primary_Project_Hierarchy) as Primary_Project_Hierarchy,
  SUM(REP_REVENUE.AMOUNT) as revenue_amount,

  -- Create PIT for current view of world as this is the only timeframe we can affect

-- creates a cte called all_relationships that will either use "with recursive" or loops depending on the DW


with recursive direct_relationships as (
    select
        *
    from dbt_project_evaluator.int_direct_relationships
    where resource_type <> 'test'
),

-- should this be a fct_ model?

-- recursive CTE
-- one record for every resource and each of its downstream children (including itself)
all_relationships (
    parent_id,
    parent,
    parent_resource_type,
    parent_model_type,
    parent_materialized,
    parent_access,
    parent_is_public,
    parent_source_name,
    parent_file_path,
    parent_directory_path,
    parent_file_name,
    parent_is_excluded,
    child_id,
    child,
    child_resource_type,
    child_model_type,
    child_materialized,
    child_access,
    child_is_public,
    child_source_name,
    child_file_path,
    child_directory_path,
    child_file_name,
    child_is_excluded,
    distance,
    path,
    is_dependent_on_chain_of_views
) as (
    -- anchor
    select distinct
        resource_id as parent_id,
        resource_name as parent,
        resource_type as parent_resource_type,
        model_type as parent_model_type,
        materialized as parent_materialized,
        access as parent_access,
        is_public as parent_is_public,
        source_name as parent_source_name,
        file_path as parent_file_path,
        directory_path as parent_directory_path,
        file_name as parent_file_name,
        is_excluded as parent_is_excluded,
        resource_id as child_id,
        resource_name as child,
        resource_type as child_resource_type,
        model_type as child_model_type,
        materialized as child_materialized,
        access as child_access,
        is_public as child_is_public,
        source_name as child_source_name,
        file_path as child_file_path,
        directory_path as child_directory_path,
        file_name as child_file_name,
        is_excluded as child_is_excluded,
        0 as distance,
        array_construct( resource_name ) as path,
        cast(null as boolean) as is_dependent_on_chain_of_views

    from direct_relationships
    -- where direct_parent_id is null 

    union all

    -- recursive clause
    select
        all_relationships.parent_id as parent_id,
        all_relationships.parent as parent,
        all_relationships.parent_resource_type as parent_resource_type,
        all_relationships.parent_model_type as parent_model_type,
        all_relationships.parent_materialized as parent_materialized,
        all_relationships.parent_access as parent_access,
        all_relationships.parent_is_public as parent_is_public,
        all_relationships.parent_source_name as parent_source_name,
        all_relationships.parent_file_path as parent_file_path,
        all_relationships.parent_directory_path as parent_directory_path,
        all_relationships.parent_file_name as parent_file_name,
        all_relationships.parent_is_excluded as parent_is_excluded,
        direct_relationships.resource_id as child_id,
        direct_relationships.resource_name as child,
        direct_relationships.resource_type as child_resource_type,
        direct_relationships.model_type as child_model_type,
        direct_relationships.materialized as child_materialized,
        direct_relationships.access as child_access,
        direct_relationships.is_public as child_is_public,
        direct_relationships.source_name as child_source_name,
        direct_relationships.file_path as child_file_path,
        direct_relationships.directory_path as child_directory_path,
        direct_relationships.file_name as child_file_name,
        direct_relationships.is_excluded as child_is_excluded,
        all_relationships.distance+1 as distance,
        array_append(all_relationships.path, direct_relationships.resource_name) as path,
        case
            when
                all_relationships.child_materialized in ('view', 'ephemeral')
                and coalesce(all_relationships.is_dependent_on_chain_of_views, true)
                then true
            else false
        end as is_dependent_on_chain_of_views

    from direct_relationships
    inner join all_relationships

{# flatten the sets of permissable primary key test sets to one level for later iteration #}
{%- set test_macro_list = [] %}
{%- set test_macro_names_list = [] %}
{%- for test_set in var('primary_key_test_macros') -%}
      {%- for test in test_set %}
            {%- do test_macro_list.append(test) -%}
      {%- endfor %}
{%- endfor -%}
{% for test in test_macro_list %}
        {%- do test_macro_names_list.append(test.split('.')[1]) -%}
{%- endfor -%}
{%- if "test_unique" not in test_macro_names_list -%}
    {%- do test_macro_list.append("dbt.test_unique") -%}
{%- endif -%}
{%- set test_macro_set = set_strict(test_macro_list) -%}

{%- set quoted_directory_pattern = wrap_string_with_quotes(get_directory_pattern()) %}

with unioned as (

    {{ dbt_utils.union_relations([
        ref('stg_nodes'),
        ref('stg_exposures'),
        ref('stg_metrics'),
        ref('stg_sources')
    ])}}

),

naming_convention_prefixes as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_naming_convention_prefixes') }}
), 

naming_convention_folders as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_naming_convention_folders') }}
), 

unioned_with_calc as (
    select 
        *,
        case 
            when resource_type = 'source' then  {{ dbt.concat(['source_name',"'.'",'name']) }}
            when coalesce(version, '') != '' then {{ dbt.concat(['name',"'.v'",'version']) }} 
            else name 
        end as resource_name,
        case
            when resource_type = 'source' then null
            else {{ dbt.split_part('name', "'_'", 1) }}||'_' 
        end as prefix,
        {{ get_dbtreplace_directory_pattern() }} as directory_path,
        regexp_replace(file_path,'.*{{ get_regexp_directory_pattern() }}','') as file_name
    from unioned
    where coalesce(is_enabled, True) = True and package_name != 'dbt_project_evaluator'
), 

joined as (

    select
        unioned_with_calc.unique_id as resource_id, 
        unioned_with_calc.resource_name, 
        unioned_with_calc.prefix, 
        unioned_with_calc.resource_type, 
        unioned_with_calc.file_path, 
        unioned_with_calc.directory_path,
        unioned_with_calc.is_generic_test,
        unioned_with_calc.file_name,
        case 
            when unioned_with_calc.resource_type in ('test', 'source', 'metric', 'exposure', 'seed') then null
            else nullif(naming_convention_prefixes.model_type, '')
        end as model_type_prefix,
        case 
            when unioned_with_calc.resource_type in ('test', 'source', 'metric', 'exposure', 'seed') then null
            when {{ dbt.position(dbt.concat([quoted_directory_pattern, 'naming_convention_folders.folder_name_value', quoted_directory_pattern]),'unioned_with_calc.directory_path') }} = 0 then null
            else naming_convention_folders.model_type 
        end as model_type_folder,
        {{ dbt.position(dbt.concat([quoted_directory_pattern, 'naming_convention_folders.folder_name_value', quoted_directory_pattern]),'unioned_with_calc.directory_path') }} as position_folder,  
        nullif(unioned_with_calc.column_name, '') as column_name,
        {% for test in test_macro_set %}
        unioned_with_calc.macro_dependencies like '%macro.{{ test }}%' and unioned_with_calc.resource_type = 'test' as is_{{ test.split('.')[1] }},  
        {% endfor %}
        unioned_with_calc.is_enabled, 
        unioned_with_calc.materialized, 
        unioned_with_calc.on_schema_change, 
        unioned_with_calc.database, 
        unioned_with_calc.schema, 
        unioned_with_calc.package_name, 
        unioned_with_calc.alias, 
        unioned_with_calc.is_described, 
        unioned_with_calc.model_group, 
        unioned_with_calc.access, 
        unioned_with_calc.access = 'public' as is_public, 
        unioned_with_calc.latest_version, 
        unioned_with_calc.version, 
        unioned_with_calc.deprecation_date, 
        unioned_with_calc.is_contract_enforced, 
        unioned_with_calc.total_defined_columns, 
        unioned_with_calc.total_described_columns, 
        unioned_with_calc.exposure_type, 
        unioned_with_calc.maturity, 
        unioned_with_calc.url, 
        unioned_with_calc.owner_name,
        unioned_with_calc.owner_email,
        unioned_with_calc.meta,
        unioned_with_calc.macro_dependencies,
        unioned_with_calc.metric_type, 
        unioned_with_calc.label, 
        unioned_with_calc.metric_filter,
        unioned_with_calc.metric_measure,
        unioned_with_calc.metric_measure_alias,
        unioned_with_calc.numerator,
        unioned_with_calc.denominator,
        unioned_with_calc.expr,
        unioned_with_calc.metric_window,
        unioned_with_calc.grain_to_date,
        unioned_with_calc.source_name, -- NULL for non-source resources
        unioned_with_calc.is_source_described, 
        unioned_with_calc.loaded_at_field, 
        unioned_with_calc.is_freshness_enabled, 
        unioned_with_calc.loader, 
        unioned_with_calc.identifier,
        unioned_with_calc.hard_coded_references, -- NULL for non-model resources
        unioned_with_calc.number_lines, -- NULL for non-model resources
        unioned_with_calc.sql_complexity, -- NULL for non-model resources
        unioned_with_calc.is_excluded -- NULL for metrics and exposures

    from unioned_with_calc
    left join naming_convention_prefixes
        on unioned_with_calc.prefix = naming_convention_prefixes.prefix_value

    cross join naming_convention_folders   

), 

calculate_model_type as (
    select 
        *, 
        case 
            when resource_type in ('test', 'source', 'metric', 'exposure', 'seed') then null
            -- by default we will define the model type based on its prefix in the case prefix and folder types are different
            else coalesce(model_type_prefix, model_type_folder, 'other') 
        end as model_type,
        row_number() over (partition by resource_id order by position_folder desc) as folder_name_rank
    from joined
),

final as (
    select
        *
    from calculate_model_type
    where folder_name_rank = 1
)

select 
    *
from final

model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_rejoinin.name: fct_rejoining_of_upstream_concepts
model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_rejoinin.description: "All cases where one of the parent's direct children (child) is ALSO the direct child of ANOTHER one of the  parent's direct children (parent_and_child). Only includes cases where the model "in between" the parent and child  has NO other downstream dependencies.
model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_rejoinin.raw_code:
with all_relationships as (
    select  
        *
    from {{ ref('int_all_dag_relationships') }}
    where parent_resource_type not in ('exposure', 'metric')
    and child_resource_type not in ('exposure', 'metric')
    and not parent_is_excluded
    and not child_is_excluded
),

-- all parent/child relationships where the parent is BOTH the direct parent of the child and the second level parent of the child 
rejoined as (
    select
        parent,
        child
    from all_relationships
    group by 1, 2
    having (sum(case when distance = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 1 
        and sum(case when distance = 2 then 1 else 0 end) >= 1)
),

-- resources with only one direct child
single_use_resources as (
    select
        parent
    from all_relationships
    where distance = 1
    group by 1
    having count(*) = 1
),

-- all cases where one of the parent's direct children (child) is ALSO the direct child of ANOTHER one of the parent's direct childen (parent_and_child)
triad_relationships as (
    select 
        rejoined.parent,
        rejoined.child,
        direct_child.parent as parent_and_child
    from rejoined
    left join all_relationships as direct_child
        on rejoined.child = direct_child.child
        and direct_child.distance = 1
    left join all_relationships as direct_parent
        on rejoined.parent = direct_parent.parent
        and direct_parent.distance = 1
    where direct_child.parent = direct_parent.child
),

-- additionally, only includes cases where the model "in between" the parent and parent_and_child has NO other downstream dependencies
-- Note: when the "in between" model DOES have downstream dependencies, it's possible this DAG choice has been made to avoid duplicated code and as such is OKAY
final as (
    select
        triad_relationships.*,
        case 
            when single_use_resources.parent is not null then true 
            else false
        end as is_loop_independent
    from triad_relationships
    left join single_use_resources 
        on triad_relationships.parent_and_child = single_use_resources.parent
),

final_filtered as (
    select * from final
    where is_loop_independent
)

        child
    from all_relationships
    group by 1, 2
    having (sum(case when distance = 1 then 1 else 0 end) >= 1 
        and sum(case when distance = 2 then 1 else 0 end) >= 1)
),

-- resources with only one direct child
single_use_resources as (
    select
        parent
    from all_relationships
    where distance = 1
    group by 1
    having count(*) = 1
),

-- all cases where one of the parent's direct children (child) is ALSO the direct child of ANOTHER one of the parent's direct childen (parent_and_child)
triad_relationships as (
    select 
        rejoined.parent,
        rejoined.child,
        direct_child.parent as parent_and_child
    from rejoined
    left join all_relationships as direct_child
        on rejoined.child = direct_child.child
        and direct_child.distance = 1
    left join all_relationships as direct_parent
        on rejoined.parent = direct_parent.parent
        and direct_parent.distance = 1
    where direct_child.parent = direct_parent.child
),

-- additionally, only includes cases where the model "in between" the parent and parent_and_child has NO other downstream dependencies
-- Note: when the "in between" model DOES have downstream dependencies, it's possible this DAG choice has been made to avoid duplicated code and as such is OKAY
final as (
    select
        triad_relationships.*,
        case 
            when single_use_resources.parent is not null then true 
            else false
        end as is_loop_independent
    from triad_relationships
    left join single_use_resources 
        on triad_relationships.parent_and_child = single_use_resources.parent
),

final_filtered as (
    select * from final
    where is_loop_independent
)

model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_document.description: This model calculates the percent of enabled models in the project that have a configured description.  We recommend you describe at least 75 percent of your models.

documentation_coverage_pct.name: documentation_coverage_pct
documentation_coverage_pct.description: the number of models in the project with a description divided by the total number of models in the project

model.dbt_project_evaluator.fct_document.compiled_code:
with

models as (
    select * from dbt_project_evaluator.int_all_graph_resources
    where resource_type = 'model'
    and not is_excluded
),

conversion as (
    select
        resource_id,
        case when is_described then 1 else 0 end as is_described_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'staging' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_staging_model,
            case when is_described and model_type = 'staging' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_described_staging_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'intermediate' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_intermediate_model,
            case when is_described and model_type = 'intermediate' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_described_intermediate_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'datavault__business' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_datavault__business_model,
            case when is_described and model_type = 'datavault__business' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_described_datavault__business_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'datavault__raw' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_datavault__raw_model,
            case when is_described and model_type = 'datavault__raw' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_described_datavault__raw_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'marts' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_marts_model,
            case when is_described and model_type = 'marts' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_described_marts_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'other' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_other_model,
            case when is_described and model_type = 'other' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_described_other_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'reporting' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_reporting_model,
            case when is_described and model_type = 'reporting' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_described_reporting_model
        

    from models
),

final as (
    select
        convert_timezone('UTC', current_timestamp()) as measured_at,
        cast(count(*) as integer) as total_models,
        cast(sum(is_described_model) as integer) as documented_models,
        round(sum(is_described_model) * 100.00 / count(*), 2) as documentation_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_described_staging_model) * 100 ) / nullif( ( count(is_staging_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as staging_documentation_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_described_intermediate_model) * 100 ) / nullif( ( count(is_intermediate_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as intermediate_documentation_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_described_datavault__business_model) * 100 ) / nullif( ( count(is_datavault__business_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as datavault__business_documentation_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_described_datavault__raw_model) * 100 ) / nullif( ( count(is_datavault__raw_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as datavault__raw_documentation_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_described_marts_model) * 100 ) / nullif( ( count(is_marts_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as marts_documentation_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_described_other_model) * 100 ) / nullif( ( count(is_other_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as other_documentation_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_described_reporting_model) * 100 ) / nullif( ( count(is_reporting_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as reporting_documentation_coverage_pct
        

    from models
    left join conversion
    on models.resource_id = conversion.resource_id
)

select * from final

with

test_counts as (
    select * from dbt_project_evaluator.int_model_test_summary
    where resource_type = 'model'
),

conversion as (
    select
        resource_name,
        cast(case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 then 1 else 0 end as boolean) as is_tested_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'staging' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_staging_model,
            case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 and model_type = 'staging' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_tested_staging_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'intermediate' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_intermediate_model,
            case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 and model_type = 'intermediate' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_tested_intermediate_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'datavault__business' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_datavault__business_model,
            case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 and model_type = 'datavault__business' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_tested_datavault__business_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'datavault__raw' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_datavault__raw_model,
            case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 and model_type = 'datavault__raw' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_tested_datavault__raw_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'marts' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_marts_model,
            case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 and model_type = 'marts' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_tested_marts_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'other' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_other_model,
            case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 and model_type = 'other' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_tested_other_model,
        
            case when model_type = 'reporting' then 1.0 else NULL end as is_reporting_model,
            case when number_of_tests_on_model > 0 and model_type = 'reporting' then 1.0 else 0 end as is_tested_reporting_model
        

    from test_counts
),

final as (
    select
        convert_timezone('UTC', current_timestamp()) as measured_at,
        cast(count(*) as integer) as total_models,
        cast(sum(number_of_tests_on_model) as integer) as total_tests,
        sum(cast(is_tested_model as integer)) as tested_models,
        round(sum(cast(is_tested_model as integer)) * 100.0 / count(*), 2) as test_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_tested_staging_model) * 100.0 ) / nullif( ( count(is_staging_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as staging_test_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_tested_intermediate_model) * 100.0 ) / nullif( ( count(is_intermediate_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as intermediate_test_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_tested_datavault__business_model) * 100.0 ) / nullif( ( count(is_datavault__business_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as datavault__business_test_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_tested_datavault__raw_model) * 100.0 ) / nullif( ( count(is_datavault__raw_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as datavault__raw_test_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_tested_marts_model) * 100.0 ) / nullif( ( count(is_marts_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as marts_test_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_tested_other_model) * 100.0 ) / nullif( ( count(is_other_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as other_test_coverage_pct,
        
            round(
                
    ( sum(is_tested_reporting_model) * 100.0 ) / nullif( ( count(is_reporting_model) ), 0)

            , 2) as reporting_test_coverage_pct,
        
        round(sum(number_of_tests_on_model) * 1.0000 / count(*), 4) as test_to_model_ratio
